title: QA / Usability Tester — Web App & Chrome Extension ($10 Paid Trial)
description:
We’re looking for 2–3 testers to give honest first-use feedback on Adlicio and our Reddit Comment Scraper Chrome extension.



Website: 





This is a small paid usability test, not a full QA audit. The initial trial pays US$10 fixed for approximately 25–30 minutes total, including the recording and short notes. Please apply only if that scope works for you. Additional testing may be available by separate agreement.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Start as a new user and explain what you think the website does and who it is for.

- Sign up and attempt one research task in the web app.

- Install the Chrome extension and try to export comments from one Reddit thread.

- Explain anything confusing about onboarding, navigation, pricing, or how the web app and extension work together.



We’ll provide the product links, a task prompt and any necessary test access or credits. You will not need to purchase a subscription. We want to see what you can work out without step-by-step coaching. If you get stuck, record where and why rather than spending extra time trying to finish.



DELIVERABLES

- One screen recording with clear spoken English explaining your first attempt and what you expected at each step.

- A short list of up to five useful observations: what worked, what was confusing, and any bugs. Include reproduction steps or timestamps for issues.

- Your operating system and Chrome version, and whether you completed each task.



REQUIREMENTS

- A Windows or Mac computer with Google Chrome and a microphone.

title: Operations & Automation Lead
description:
OPERATIONS & AUTOMATION LEAD



Remote | Full-Time | US-Based Residential Construction Company

$15–$22/hour depending on experience | Exceptional candidates up to approximately $25/hour

Performance bonuses and profit sharing available based on performance and contribution





ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a US-based residential construction company that is actively scaling and wants to be on the cutting edge of practical AI, automation, and systems integration.



We are seeking a senior Operations & Automation Lead who can both help run day-to-day operations and build the systems that increasingly automate those operations.



This is intentionally a dual-function role:



1. OPERATIONS

Coordinate people, contractors, systems, information, follow-up, exceptions, and day-to-day workflow across the business.



2. AUTOMATION

Build, maintain, and continuously improve advanced AI agents, automations, APIs, integrations, and connected systems.



Operations informs automation, and automation improves operations.



We are not looking for a prompt writer or basic automation specialist. We are looking for someone with top-level, hands-on expertise building sophisticated AI-enabled operating systems.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Architect and maintain advanced multi-agent AI systems

- Design agent roles, delegation, memory, context, permissions, approval gates, and escalation logic

- Build and maintain APIs, webhooks, system integrations, and automated workflows

- Connect AI systems to company files,
, calendars, CRM, project-management tools, financial systems, databases, and other platforms

- Recommend new software and integrations that reduce manual work and improve operations

- Monitor integrations, automations, and agents for failures, errors, and performance issues

- Build evaluation, logging, tracing, retry, fallback, and exception-handling processes

- Coordinate with team members, contractors, vendors, and outside partners

- Follow up on outstanding tasks, decisions, approvals, documents, and dependencies

- Identify stalled work, missed handoffs, bottlenecks, and recurring process failures

- Maintain and improve SOPs, workflows, templates, and operating rules

- Handle operational work and exceptions that AI cannot yet reliably perform

- Continuously identify what should remain human-controlled, what should become AI-assisted, and what can become substantially automated





THE SYSTEM WE WANT TO BUILD TOWARD

We are interested in building an AI operating architecture similar in concept to advanced hierarchical agent organizations: an AI “chief of staff” coordinating functional agents, specialized subordinate agents, persistent organizational context and memory, connected business tools, autonomous monitoring, and defined human approval points.



One example of this concept is discussed by Allie K. Miller here:







We are not looking for someone to copy this system literally. We want someone capable of designing the right architecture for our business and continuously improving it.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

You must have expert-level, hands-on experience with:



- Multi-agent AI architecture and orchestration

- Context engineering and persistent memory

- Retrieval systems

- Tool/function calling

- APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and authentication

- Workflow automation

- Databases and structured data

- Systems integration

- Human-in-the-loop approvals

- Monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and failure handling

- Process design and business operations



Experience with tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI/Codex, n8n, Make, Zapier, Python, JavaScript, APIs, CRMs, project-management systems, and databases is valuable.



We care much more about what you have personally built than about a particular software stack.



Strong operations experience is also required. Construction experience is not required, but experience in construction, architecture, engineering, professional services, or another project-based business is a significant advantage.





WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

This role is not intended for someone whose experience is primarily:



- writing prompts

- creating custom GPTs

- building simple chatbots

- basic Zapier or n8n workflows

- personal-productivity AI use



Those skills may be useful, but they are not sufficient for this role.





COMPENSATION

$15–$22/hour depending on experience and demonstrated capability.



Exceptional candidates with advanced real-world AI-agent architecture, automation engineering, systems integration, and operations leadership experience may be considered at approximately $25/hour.



Performance bonuses and profit sharing will be available to the right candidate based on demonstrated results and contribution as the company scales.



This is a full-time role with substantial overlap with US Central Time.





APPLICATION QUESTIONS

1. Describe the most sophisticated multi-agent AI system you have personally architected and deployed.



2. Describe one real business operation you personally redesigned and automated, including what remained human-controlled.



3. Describe the most significant API or systems integration you have personally built or managed.



4. What AI, automation, programming, database, and integration tools do you use at an expert level?



5. Please provide examples, diagrams, screenshots, case studies, repositories, or other evidence of advanced systems you personally built. Confidential information may be removed.

title: YouTube Software Tutorial Creator — Screen Recording & English Voiceover
description:
We’re looking for a creator to make clear, practical screen-recorded tutorials for Adlicio, including our web app and Reddit Comment Scraper Chrome extension. The videos will be used on YouTube and our product/help pages.



Website: 



We want someone who can learn a software tool, demonstrate a useful outcome and explain the steps naturally in English. Clear teaching, readable screen recordings and clean audio matter more than elaborate effects. No on-camera appearance is required.



PAID TRIAL

Start with one 3–5 minute tutorial showing how to export Reddit comments and use them for a simple research task. We’ll agree on the exact workflow, deliverables, deadline and fixed price before work begins, and provide product access and any necessary credits. Please quote for the complete trial, including preparation, recording and light editing. Do not create a new unpaid sample to apply.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Learn and test the workflow before recording so the demonstration works from start to finish.

- Prepare a short outline and confirm it with us.

- Record the actual product screen with your own clear English voiceover, explaining what you are doing and why.

- Show the useful result early, then teach the steps at a comfortable pace.

- Lightly edit mistakes and long pauses; use simple zooms or callouts when needed for readability.

- Deliver the finished video and the original screen/voice recordings.



TRIAL DELIVERABLES

- One 3–5 minute, 16:9 tutorial in at least 1080p, ready for YouTube.

- Clear narration with low background noise and readable interface text.

- Raw screen and voice recordings, the outline, and any editable project files used.

- One reasonable round of corrections within the agreed brief; please include this in your quote.



REQUIREMENTS

- An existing example of a software walkthrough, tutorial or narrated screen recording you created.

- Clear spoken English and the ability to explain software to a beginner.

- A reliable computer, microphone and screen-recording/editing tools.

- Attention to factual accuracy: demonstrate real features and results, and flag anything unclear before recording.



For commissioned work, we need permission to publish, edit and reuse the paid videos and recordings on our channels and website. We’ll agree on usage rights before starting. Use only assets you have permission to include and keep personal information out of the recording.



PAY AND FUTURE WORK

Paid per video, with the rate agreed before each assignment. Please provide your fixed quote for the trial and your typical rate for a 5–8 minute tutorial. If the trial is a good fit, there may be recurring tutorials; this initial gig does not guarantee weekly hours or a set number of videos.



TO APPLY

1. Share 1–3 relevant samples with English narration. Tell us which parts you personally created.

2. List your recording and editing tools.

3. Quote your fixed price for the 3–5 minute paid trial, what it includes and your turnaround time.

4. Suggest one useful tutorial topic for someone researching Reddit comments.



Please apply with existing work samples rather than a general video-editing portfolio alone.

title: Revit/AutoCAD Architectural & MEP Drafter, USA Construction Plans (Part-Time / Per-Project)
description:
LONGHORN HOME & LAND LLC

Central Texas custom home builder and land developer

 

We build custom homes, barndominiums, remodels, additions, and light commercial projects in the Austin, Texas area. We are looking for an experienced architectural and MEP drafter to work with us on a part-time, per-project basis.

 

This is ongoing work rather than a one-time job. We run multiple projects per year and we want one drafter we can rely on long term.

 

This is a contractor position, not employment.

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL DRAFT

 

Residential and light commercial drawing sets, including:

 

- Floor plans, foundation and slab plans, roof plans

 

- Exterior elevations, building sections, wall sections and construction details

 

- Door and window schedules, interior elevations, cabinetry and millwork layouts

 

- Reflected ceiling and lighting plans

 

- Electrical and power plans: receptacles, switches, dedicated circuits, panel locations, smoke and CO detectors

 

- Plumbing plans: fixtures, supply routing, DWV, stacks, water heater, cleanouts

 

- HVAC and mechanical plans: equipment locations, duct routing, supply and return, exhaust, thermostats

 

- MEP coordination across all of the above

 

- 3D models and interior and exterior renderings

 

- Full construction document sets developed from our sketches, field measurements, redlines, and existing plans

 

You are not responsible for stamped engineering, engineering calculations, or licensed architectural services. When those are required, we engage a US-licensed architect or engineer. Your job is accurate, coordinated, buildable drawings.

 

 

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BE GOOD AT

 

This job has two halves and we need both.

 

First, you must be able to design and lay out a plan well. A floor plan that works, flows, and looks right matters to us and to our clients.

 

Second, you must understand how a building actually goes together, and catch problems before they reach the field. Ductwork fighting with beams and ceiling systems. Plumbing running through structural members. Lighting conflicting with diffusers. Equipment placed with no service clearance. MEP penetrations hitting structure.

 

Required experience:

 

- Residential and commercial drafting. We need both, not only one.

 

- Stick-built American wood-frame construction

 

- Metal buildings and steel-frame construction. Barndominiums are a large part of our work.

 

- US construction document standards and sheet organization

 

- Revit and/or AutoCAD required. Chief Architect, SketchUp, Archicad, Lumion, Enscape, or Twinmotion are a plus.

 

- Ability to export to the CAD formats our engineers require: .dwg, .dxf, .rvt, .ifc, .pdf

 

IF YOU ARE READING THIS, INCLUDE THE WORD BARNDO IN YOUR APPLICATION. There is a second word at the very end of this posting. We need both.

 

 

BUILDING CODES

 

You do not need to know Austin area code from memory, and you do not need to buy anything. We maintain an ICC Digital Codes subscription and give you access to the code editions we hold.

 

Our subscription will not cover everything. Projects land in different jurisdictions with their own adopted codes, local amendments, and requirements we do not already have on hand. When that happens, you need to be willing to go find the answer. Look up the jurisdiction, read what applies, and learn a code you have not worked with before.

 

If your response to an unfamiliar code is to wait for someone to hand it to you, this position will frustrate both of us.

 

What we do require is that you actually draft to those codes. Ceiling heights, egress, stair and landing dimensions, window sizing and emergency escape openings, smoke and CO detector placement, receptacle spacing, required GFCI and AFCI locations, fixture clearances, ventilation and exhaust requirements, and framing and header calls where we provide them.

 

These need to be right in the drawings, not approximated. If you are unsure whether something meets code, look it up in the access we give you, or ask us. Do not guess, and do not carry a detail over from a previous project just because it worked somewhere else.

 

 

COMMUNICATION AND AVAILABILITY

 

- Fluent written and spoken English. You will be on calls and video with us directly.

 

- Reachable by text,
, phone, and video chat.

 

- WILLING TO USE WHATSAPP,
, OR A SIMILAR MESSAGING APP WITH US DAILY. Most of our day-to-day back and forth happens by text rather than
. A quick question about a dimension, a photo from the field, a redline we need eyes on. Tell us which apps you already use.

 

- A VIDEO INTERVIEW WITH YOUR CAMERA ON IS REQUIRED. During the call we will ask you to read a short technical paragraph aloud and talk through your own work. This job runs on phone and video calls about dimensions and details, and we need to be sure we can understand each other. If you are not willing to be on camera, this is not the right position for you.

 

- YOU MUST WORK US CENTRAL TIME BUSINESS HOURS, 8:00 AM TO 5:00 PM, MONDAY THROUGH FRIDAY. In Philippine time that is roughly 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM. This is a night shift for you. We need you available during our workday, not the following morning. Plans move fast here, and a question that waits 14 hours costs us a day on the schedule. Please do not apply if you are not willing to work these hours consistently.

 

- RESPOND WITHIN ABOUT TWO HOURS during our working hours. Not the next business day. When we send a question, a redline, or an answer you were waiting on, work should resume that morning. A 24-hour round trip on every question adds weeks to a project, and our clients are not on that schedule.

 

- SEND PROACTIVE UPDATES ON PROGRESS. We should not have to ask where a set stands.

 

 

ASK QUESTIONS. DO NOT GUESS.

 

Our sketches and field notes will sometimes be incomplete or contradictory. When information you need is missing or does not add up, ask us. Do not fill the gap with an assumption and keep drawing.

 

We want to be very direct about why this matters, because it is the most expensive thing a drafter can get wrong.

 

When you guess instead of asking, the guess does not stay on paper. It gets ordered, cut, poured, and welded. We find out at the framing stage that a header is in the wrong place, an opening is the wrong size, or a beam does not land where the plan says it does. On a custom home, a single error of that kind costs between $5,000 and $30,000 to correct, and it can push a client's move-in date by weeks.

 

That money comes out of our business, and the damage to our reputation with that client lasts a lot longer than the invoice.

 

A question takes us two minutes to answer. The same question, unasked, can cost us more than you will earn from us in a year. That is why we take this so seriously, and why we would rather answer twenty questions a day than receive one set built on assumptions.

 

WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU GUESS ANYWAY

 

We are not going to send you a bill for a framing error. That is not realistic and it is not what we are asking for. What we will do is this:

 

- You correct every error, omission, and coordination failure in your work at your own expense, on your own time, with no extension to the deadline. This is in our subcontract agreement.

 

- We may charge the cost of correcting your work against amounts we owe you, as our subcontract allows.

 

- If it keeps happening, or if we find you have been filling in gaps instead of asking, we end the agreement immediately.

 

- We leave honest feedback on your OnlineJobs.ph profile, which every future employer will read, and we report serious misconduct to the platform.

 

- Our subcontract reserves all of our other legal remedies.

 

We want to be fair about this, so we will say it plainly. We are not looking to punish anyone for a mistake. Everyone makes them, and an honest error that you flag yourself is a completely different thing from a gap you papered over and said nothing about. The first one we fix together. The second one ends the relationship.

 

You will never be penalized for asking, no matter how many questions you have or how basic they seem.

 

If you do have to proceed on an assumption to keep moving, write it on the drawing so we can see it. This is an obligation in our subcontract agreement, not a preference.

 

 

CAPACITY AND SCHEDULE

 

Tell us honestly how many hours per week you can commit and what you realistically need for a full set.

 

Be straight with that number. Do not pad it to leave yourself room for other clients, and do not shorten it to win the job. We build our own estimate of how long the work should take, we compare it to yours, and we settle on a date together. A number that is padded by a week is obvious to us, and it costs you credibility on the first project.

 

We move fast because we have made commitments to our clients. A realistic date that we agree on together is what we will hold you to.

 

 

REVISIONS

 

- Corrections to errors, omissions, or missed coordination in your own work are not revisions and are not billable. They are part of the deliverable.

 

- Each project includes a minimum of three rounds of client-driven revisions at no extra charge.

 

- Scope changes and revision rounds beyond that are billable and agreed in writing first.

 

 

CONTRACT, TAX, AND CONFIDENTIALITY REQUIREMENTS

 

Please read this section carefully before applying. These are firm requirements and they are not negotiable. If any of them is a problem for you, this is not the right position, and we would rather know now than after two interviews.

 

 

1) YOU WILL SIGN A MASTER SUBCONTRACTOR AGREEMENT (MSA) BEFORE ANY WORK BEGINS.

 

The MSA is our standing contract with you. Each individual project is then issued as its own work order under it, with the scope, price, and due dates in writing. The MSA covers, at minimum:

 

- Independent contractor status. You are a contractor, not an employee.

 

- Ownership and assignment of all work product to Longhorn Home & Land

 

- Confidentiality and non-disclosure of client and project information

 

- Data security and network requirements

 

- Revision and correction obligations

 

- Payment terms and schedule

 

- Turnaround commitments and what happens if a committed date is missed

 

- Termination and file handover

 

You will receive the full MSA to read before you sign. Please ask questions about it. We would rather explain a clause than have you sign something you did not read.

 

 

2) FILE AND WORK PRODUCT OWNERSHIP. PLEASE READ THIS ONE TWICE.

 

All drawings, models, renderings, and files you produce for us are the property of Longhorn Home & Land. This includes the native working files (.rvt, .dwg, .dxf, .skp, .pln, and rendering scene files), not only the exported PDFs. Native files are delivered to us at each milestone and at the end of every project, whether or not the project is completed.

 

You do not retain ownership, licensing rights, or any claim to the files. You may not withhold native files for any reason, including a payment dispute. You may not reuse our drawings, plans, models, or renderings in your portfolio, on your website, on social media, or in any application to another client without our written permission.

 

Please do not apply if you are not comfortable with this. Some drafters keep native files as leverage or as portfolio material. That does not work here, and it is the fastest way to end the relationship.

 

 

3) W-8BEN OR W-8BEN-E IS REQUIRED BEFORE YOUR FIRST PAYMENT.

 

Individuals file W-8BEN. If you work through a registered company or entity, W-8BEN-E. We cannot pay you until we have it on file.

 

 

4) YOU ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR YOUR OWN TAXES.

 

We do not withhold anything, we do not provide benefits, and we do not provide equipment or software. You cover your own hardware, software licenses, and internet. We cover code access as described above.

 

 

5) CONFIDENTIALITY AND DATA SECURITY.

 

Our clients' plans, home addresses, and project details are private information, and protecting them is a contract obligation. You must:

 

- Work on a private, password-protected network. No public Wi-Fi, no shared connection, no internet cafe, no hotel or coworking network.

 

- Work on a device you personally own or control, password or biometric locked, with current security updates. Nobody else uses that device while our files are on it.

 

- Keep all project files in the shared drive we provide. Not on personal cloud accounts, personal
, third-party file transfer sites, messaging apps, or flash drives.

 

- Never share login credentials we issue you with anyone.

 

- Never paste, upload, or submit our drawings, models, sketches, client addresses, or project information into any third-party AI tool or online service that stores or trains on what you submit. This includes ChatGPT, AI drafting and rendering services, and free online converters. If you want to use an AI tool in your workflow, ask us first and we will tell you yes or no.

 

- Tell us within 24 hours if a device or account holding our files is lost, stolen, accessed by someone else, infected, or if you suspect it has been compromised.

 

- Never discuss, post, or share any client information, project location, or drawing with anyone.

 

- When a project ends, or when we ask, permanently delete our files from all your devices, accounts, and backups, and confirm in writing that you did.

 

 

6) BE HONEST ABOUT YOUR SCHEDULE.

 

Tell us the truth about your workload. If you take on more than you can deliver and our plans sit while you finish someone else's, we will find out, and we will end the agreement. We are not asking you to work only for us. We are asking you to commit only to what you can actually deliver.

 

 

PAY

 

$3 to $5 per hour depending on experience. We raise it as you prove out. Reliability, accuracy, and how little we have to redline your work are what move that number.

 

On plan sets we also pay per square foot, which is how plan work is commonly priced in the US. The rate is agreed per project before work begins, plus flat fees for assignments outside a plan set.

 

For the right person we are open to a salary arrangement instead of hourly, once we have worked together long enough to know what the volume looks like.

 

Payment is made through Wise or your preferred method. When you apply, tell us your hourly rate and your per-square-foot rate.

 

Please read this next part carefully, because we would rather you know it now.

 

On project-based work, our subcontract follows standard US construction practice. Our obligation to pay is tied to our receipt of payment from the client for that work. This is normal in US construction contracting and it applies to every trade we hire. It also means that if a client project does not move forward, payment on that work order follows what we collect.

 

On hourly work, payment is not tied to client payment and is made on our normal schedule.

 

We will tell you before each work order which basis applies, and it will be in writing in the work order. If this is not something you are comfortable with, please tell us before you sign rather than after.

 

 

DAILY PROGRESS REPORT

 

While you have active work with us, send a short progress note at the end of each of your working days. Three or four lines is plenty:

 

- What you completed

 

- What you are working on next

 

- Anything blocking you, or any question you need answered to keep moving

 

We are not asking for this to check up on you. We are asking because when we know where a set stands, we can answer your questions before they cost you a day. A drafter who goes quiet for four days and then delivers is a drafter we cannot plan around.

 

 

ABOUT AI

 

Use AI to help you learn something, look something up, or check your own work. That is your business and we do not mind.

 

What we will not accept is AI writing your messages to us. Not in your application, not on your first day, not ever.

 

Here is the reason. Almost all of our daily communication is text and
. When we ask how a set is going, we need to know what you actually think. Whether you are stuck. Whether something in the sketch does not make sense. Whether you are going to miss a date. An AI-written update is confident, polished, and tells us nothing. We find out you were stuck three days later, when the schedule is already gone.

 

Three broken sentences telling us you are confused about a dimension are worth more to us than a perfect paragraph that hides it.

 

So:

 

- Your application, your video, and every message after you are hired must be your own words. AI writing is easy to spot and we read with that in mind. More importantly, you will be on a live video call discussing what you wrote. If your writing is polished and you cannot talk about it in your own words, that is an immediate no, and there is no way around it.

 

- This applies from your first message and every day after. If your writing reads like a language model and your calls do not sound like the same person, that ends the working relationship.

 

- Never put our drawings, models, sketches, client addresses, or project information into any AI tool or online service that stores or trains on what you submit. This is a term of our subcontract.

 

TO BE CLEAR ABOUT OUR STANDARD, BECAUSE THESE TWO THINGS WORK TOGETHER:

 

Your English needs to be good enough that we understand you the first time, in writing and on the phone. If we have to schedule a call to work out what a message meant, or ask you three times to explain something, that costs us more time than the work saves. Strong written and spoken English is a requirement of this position.

 

At the same time, it has to be your English. We are not asking for perfect grammar or advanced vocabulary. Plain, clear, direct sentences are exactly right. Small mistakes are fine and we will never mention them.

 

We need to understand you, and we need to know that it is actually you. A polished AI paragraph fails the second test. Unclear writing fails the first. Write simply, in your own words, and you will pass both.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Reply with this subject line:

 

DRAFTER, [YOUR NAME], [WORD 1] [WORD 2]

 

Two code words appear in this posting. Include both, in order, in your subject line and in the first line of your message.

 

We do this because this job is about reading a full set of documents carefully and catching what is in them. If you cannot get through one job posting, the drawings will be a problem.

 

Applications missing either word, or missing answers to any question below, are not reviewed.

 

PLEASE ANSWER EVERY QUESTION. Number your answers so we can follow them.

 

 

Q1. How many years have you drafted US residential plans? US commercial plans?

 

Q2. Which software do you use daily, and which version?

 

Q3. Have you drafted metal building or steel-frame projects such as barndominiums, shops, or mixed-use metal buildings? Describe one.

 

Q4. Have you drafted stick-built wood-frame homes? Describe one.

 

Q5. Have you drafted full MEP plans covering electrical, plumbing, and HVAC, or only architectural? Please be honest. We ask this specifically.

 

Q6. Give one example of a coordination conflict you caught in a drawing set before it reached the field, and how you resolved it.

 

Q7. Our hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central, which is roughly 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM your time. Are you willing and able to work that schedule consistently? Have you worked a US night shift before, and for how long?

 

Q8. Are you comfortable with Longhorn Home & Land owning all work product including native .rvt and .dwg files, with no portfolio use without written permission? Yes or no.

 

Q9. How many hours per week can you commit to us, and how many other clients are you currently drafting for?

 

Q10. What is your realistic turnaround on a complete construction document set for a 2,000 square foot custom home, working from our sketches?

 

Q11. What is your hourly rate in USD? Do you also price per square foot, and if so, what is your rate?

 

Q12. Provide three references: name, company, and
 or phone. We will contact them about your drafting and rendering work.

 

Q13. Attach or link a portfolio showing full construction document sets, not only renderings. We want to see sheets: plans, sections, details, schedules, and MEP.

 

Q14. Describe a project where you produced a plan set from hand sketches, field measurements, or redlines rather than an existing CAD file. What information was missing, and how did you handle it?

 

Q15. Are you willing to complete a paid test assignment and walk us through your file on a video call? Yes or no.

 

Q16. Which messaging apps do you use? WhatsApp,
, Viber, or something else. We will be texting you most days.

 

 

REQUIRED: SHORT VIDEO

 

APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO LINK ARE NOT REVIEWED. This is not optional and we do not make exceptions.

 

Record a video of yourself, 60 to 90 seconds, and include the link in your reply. Upload it as an unlisted YouTube video, or as a Google Drive link set so that anyone with the link can view it.

 

Requirements:

 

- Your face visible and well lit, speaking directly to the camera

 

- One continuous take. No editing, no cuts, no voice-over.

 

- Your own voice. Not a reading by someone else, not text-to-speech, not AI-generated.

 

Please do these three things, in this order.

 

STEP 1. Say your full name, then say both code words from this posting out loud.

 

STEP 2. Read this aloud, exactly as written:

 

"The slab is 48'-0" x 32'-0" with a 4" thickened edge at the garage openings. Wall studs are 2x6 at 16" o.c., and the top plate sits at 10'-4 1/2". The roof is a 6/12 pitch with a 2'-0" overhang. Supply the header schedule before framing, and confirm the rough opening for the 3'-0" x 6'-8" exterior door."

 

STEP 3. Then, without reading from anything, answer this in your own words for about thirty seconds:

 

"Tell me about a drawing set you worked on where the information you were given was wrong or missing, and what you did about it."

 

We are not judging your accent. We are checking that we can understand each other clearly on a phone call about dimensions, because that is how this job runs every day. Speak at a normal pace and do not over-prepare. Step 3 is meant to be unscripted, and we would rather hear you think than hear you recite.

 

 

SKILLS VERIFICATION: REQUIRED

 

Before we award any real project, every shortlisted candidate completes a paid test assignment. This is not optional and there are no exceptions, regardless of how strong your portfolio or references are.

 

Here is exactly what it involves:

 

- We send you a hand sketch, rough field measurements, and basic project notes. This is the same kind of information you will actually receive from us on a live job.

 

- You produce three sheets from it: exterior elevations with 3D views, a foundation plan, and a second floor framing plan with a staircase elevation.

 

- You also submit a written, numbered list of every discrepancy, missing dimension, and conflict you found in the sketches, with the question you would ask us about each.

 

- The deadline is 3 days.

 

- You are paid a flat fee for this assignment whether or not we hire you. We do not ask anyone to work for free. This is a fixed fee for a reduced-scope sample exercise built from rough field sketches. It is not our rate for production plan sets and you should not read it as one. Rates for real project work are negotiated with you separately, per project, before any work starts.

 

- You will then get on a video call and walk us through your own file, live, sharing your screen. We will ask you why you made specific decisions.

 

We want to be clear about why we do this. Most of the work you will do for us starts as a sketch on paper, a photo of a napkin, or a set of measurements taken in the field, rather than as a clean file handed to you. We need to see that you can take incomplete information, ask the right questions, and produce a coordinated and buildable set.

 

A portfolio shows us finished work. It does not show us whether you personally did it, or whether you understand it.

 

The screen-share walkthrough is part of the test. If you cannot explain your own drawing decisions, we will know.

 

 

LAST TWO THINGS

 

APPLY POINTS: please use 12 Apply Points when you send your application. Applications sent with fewer than 12 will not be reviewed. We are hiring one drafter for ongoing work, and we want to hear from people who are choosing this job rather than applying to everything.

 

YOU REACHED THE END. THE SECOND WORD IS PECAN. Include both BARNDO and PECAN in your application, in your subject line and in the first line of your message.

 

If you are sending the same application to many job posts, this is where it stops. We read every reply, and a message without both words tells us everything we need to know.

 

We look forward to hearing from the people who actually read this.

title: Bookkeeper & Administrative Virtual Assistant for Key To The Coast
description:
Bookkeeper & Administrative Virtual Assistant 



Company: Key To The Coast 

Location: Remote / Work From Home 

Employment: Part-Time initially, with potential for increased hours 

Industry: Tourism, Events & Hospitality 



About Key To The Coast 



Key To The Coast is a Gold Coast (Australia) based tourism and events company specialising in group experiences including bachelorette parties, bachelor weekends, birthdays, corporate groups, accommodation, transport, nightlife, yachts, tours and other Gold Coast activities. 



We are a growing business and are looking for a reliable Bookkeeper (XERO) & Administrative Virtual Assistant to join our team and help manage our increasing workload. 



This is a long-term position for someone who is organised, trustworthy, detail-oriented and capable of working independently. 



The Role 



The primary responsibility of this position will be bookkeeping and financial administration, combined with general administrative and customer support. 



You will help keep our financial records accurate and up to date while also assisting the team with invoicing, payment follow-ups, customer communication and general office administration. 



The ideal person will be someone who doesn't need to be constantly told what to do. We want someone who can identify what needs attention and take care of it. 



Key Responsibilities 



Bookkeeping & Accounts 



Maintain accurate bookkeeping records 



Maintain receipts, invoices and financial documentation 



Identify discrepancies and follow up on missing information 



Enter and categorise transactions 



Reconcile bank accounts and credit cards 



Process and record customer payments 



Process supplier invoices 



Track accounts payable and accounts receivable 



Assist with GST-related bookkeeping 



Prepare information for our Australian based accountant 



Assist with basic financial reporting when required 



Experience with Xero is a must. 



Invoicing & Payment Follow-Up 



Prepare and send customer invoices 



Monitor outstanding invoices 



Follow up customers for overdue payments 



Keep payment records up to date 



Communicate professionally with customers regarding balances and payments 



Follow up deposits and final payments 



Coordinate payment information with the sales team 



Customer Communication 



Help respond to customer
s and messages when required 



Provide customers with booking and payment information 



Follow up customers for missing information 



Assist with customer requests and general enquiries 



Escalate sales or complex customer issues to the appropriate team member 



You will not be primarily responsible for sales. Our sales team will continue to handle the majority of new enquiries and sales.  



General Administration 



Data entry 



Updating customer and booking records 



Maintaining spreadsheets 



Organising documents 



Filing invoices and receipts 



Updating CRM records 



Checking booking information 



Assisting with supplier administration 



General administrative support for management and the team 



Other reasonable administrative tasks as required 



What We Are Looking For 



The successful candidate will have: 



Previous bookkeeping experience with XERO 



Strong knowledge of accounting principles 



Good understanding of Australian bookkeeping/GST practices 



Excellent attention to detail 



Strong written English 



Professional customer communication skills 



Good computer skills 



Strong organisational skills 



Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines 



Ability to work independently 



Good problem-solving skills 



A reliable internet connection 



A suitable computer and home working environment 



Personality & Work Style 



We are looking for someone who is: 



Reliable — You do what you say you will do. 



Organised — You keep things under control and don't allow tasks to fall through the cracks. 



Proactive — You see something that needs to be done and take care of it. 



Detail-oriented — Small financial and customer-service errors matter. 



Professional — You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, suppliers and our team. 



Trustworthy — You will be working with confidential financial and customer information. 



Experience That Would Be an Advantage 



Experience with any of the following would be highly regarded: 



Xero 



Australian businesses 



Australian GST/BAS bookkeeping 



Tourism or hospitality 



Travel businesses 



Event companies 



Online bookings 



CRM systems such as HubSpot 



Google Workspace 



Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets 



Accounts receivable and debt collection 



Working Hours 



Working hours can be accommodated, but morning start is preferred.  This role will start initially a part-time position, with hours to increase with demonnstration of ability. 



We are looking for someone who will work consistently during agreed hours and communicate with the team during their working period. 



Applicants should state their preferred working hours and availability in their application. 



Salary / Rate 



We are looking for a long-term team member to our team and are prepared to pay a fair rate for the right person with the appropriate experience and skills. A paid company familiarisation trip to Australia is available to the right candidate.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: Performance Driven Team Leader
description:
About Us



We are a retention-first customer experience agency supporting fast-growing health, wellness, and eCommerce brands.



We specialize in protecting revenue, improving customer experience, and building high-performing contact center operations. We move quickly, operate by the numbers, and expect our leaders to own performance—not simply report it.



We’re looking for an experienced, data-driven Team Leader to lead a performance-driven team.



About the Role



This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for approximately 30 customer support specialists across multiple campaigns.



You’ll own daily performance, staffing, coaching, SLA delivery, quality, and productivity. More importantly, you must be able to read the data, identify what is driving performance, and quickly take action when results fall below target.



This is not an entry-level leadership opportunity. We are looking for someone with proven Team Lead experience who can step in and lead with minimal hand-holding.



What You’ll Do



Performance Management: Own daily KPIs including SLA, productivity, CSAT/DSAT, FCR, AHT, QA, attendance, adherence, and closure rates.



Data Analysis: Analyze daily, weekly, and monthly performance data to identify trends, bottlenecks, outliers, and opportunities for improvement.



Reporting: Build and maintain clear operational reports and dashboards that tell us not only what happened, but why it happened and what needs to happen next.



Team Leadership: Lead, motivate, and develop approximately 30 agents while creating a culture of accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement.



Performance Coaching: Conduct regular 1:1 coaching, performance reviews, and targeted interventions designed to produce measurable improvement.



Multi-Campaign Management: Balance staffing, workload, and priorities across
, Chat, Messaging, and Back-Office campaigns as volumes fluctuate.



Queue Management: Monitor queues throughout the day and proactively redistribute resources to protect SLAs and prevent backlogs.



Workforce Management: Monitor attendance, schedule adherence, shrinkage, utilization, productivity, and staffing requirements.



Quality Management: Partner with QA to identify performance and quality gaps and turn findings into actionable coaching plans.



Escalation Management: Serve as the first leadership point of contact for agent, customer, workflow, and campaign escalations.



Process Improvement: Identify inefficiencies, recommend solutions, and continuously improve workflows, SOPs, reporting, and team execution.



What We’re Looking For — Non-Negotiable

3+ years of recent Team Leader/Supervisor experience in a BPO, Shared Services, or Contact Center environment

Proven experience managing 25–30+ agents

Strong Non-Voice experience across
, Live Chat, Messaging, and/or Back-Office

Demonstrated history of improving underperforming teams and hitting KPIs

Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

Strong reporting and data-analysis skills

Ability to independently analyze performance and turn data into an action plan

Experience managing multiple campaigns, queues, or competing priorities

Strong coaching, performance management, and conflict-resolution skills

Exceptional written and spoken English

Highly organized with outstanding attention to detail

Proactive, accountable, and comfortable working autonomously

Strong Advantage

Intercom experience strongly preferred

Experience with Zendesk, Gorgias, Freshdesk, or similar CRM/ticketing platforms

Experience with WFM and QA platforms

title: Amazon Operations Assistant, growing into Operations Lead (Full Time, Long Term)
description:
I'm Michael. I run an Amazon business in the US by myself. I buy products from retail stores when the price is right, ship them to a warehouse, and sell them on Amazon for more. Before this I worked inside Amazon itself for 4 years. Now I run my own store, and I also coach other sellers.



I'm hiring ONE person to become my right hand.



This is not data entry VA work. You'll learn to actually run a real ecommerce business, the same one I built after 4 years inside Amazon.



What you'll do at first

• Sit with me on screen every day while I run the business, so you see exactly how it works

• Learn to find products that make money using my tools (Keepa, SellerAmp, and an AI system I built)

• Place the buy orders I approve, log them in our sheets, and keep the numbers clean

• Check prices, stock, and shipments each morning and flag what looks wrong

• When the Amazon work is light, help with my social media: posting, captions, replying to people. No experience needed.



What this grows into (6 to 12 months)

• You run the daily buying on your own

• You manage the warehouse, the inventory, and the numbers

• I check in once a day, then once a week

• You become the person who runs the business day to day, with pay and bonuses that grow with it



Who this is for

• You are punctual. You show up on time, every time. This matters more to me than experience.

• You are organized. Messy spreadsheets bother you.

• You like numbers. Every decision here is "does this make money, yes or no."

• You follow instructions exactly, and you ask when something is unclear

• You are honest when you make a mistake, so we can fix it fast

• You want a long term job with one employer, not a side gig

• You have your own laptop (not a phone) and stable internet with a backup, because screen share drops are the one thing that won't work here



You do NOT need

• Amazon experience. I will teach you everything.

• A degree or certificates

• Perfect English. Clear and simple is enough.



Hours

• 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday

• Your shift must overlap with US Central time (Chicago) for at least 4 hours a day, so we can work together on screen. Example: 8am to 12pm Chicago is 9pm to 1am in Manila. This leans night shift. Tell me in your application which block works for you.

• Paid every two weeks by Wise or PayPal, your choice

• This is a remote contractor role with a US business, not local Philippine employment.

• Chicago time moves with US daylight saving, and your shift moves with it.



Pay

• $5 to $7 USD an hour depending on skill, and that rate starts from the paid trial week

• Raise review every 3 months as you take on more

• Monthly bonuses of $100 to $400 based on results, once you're buying on your own. If the business grows, you grow with it.

• Paid time off for Philippine holidays after 90 days



Tools we use (I'll train you on all of them)

• Google Sheets, Gmail, WhatsApp

• Amazon Seller Central, Keepa, SellerAmp

• Claude (an AI assistant that does most of our admin work)



How to apply

OnlineJobs.ph removes outside links from job posts, so apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph and I'll send you the application form.

1. Start your application with the word SOURCING in the very first line. Applications that don't start with it will not be read.

2. In your application, tell me two things: which 4 hour block overlapping Chicago time you can work, and one thing you organized that was a mess before you got to it (a few sentences).

3. Within 3 days I'll send everyone who did steps 1 and 2 a short online application. It takes about 30 minutes and includes one real task that takes about 15 minutes (sorting a messy product list into a sheet). It's not a trick; it's the actual work.



Shortlisted people get a video call of about 20 minutes with me, then a paid trial week.



Thanks for reading all of this. That already tells me something good about you.



Michael

description:

This is a dual role. Your primary responsibility is post-production coordination — keeping our editors equipped, our projects organised, and our galleries delivered to clients on time. Your secondary responsibility is social media editing — producing 3 posts per week across Instagram, 
 and
 that reflect the Love Poets brand and connect with our audience.



We need someone who is systematic and operational by nature, but has a genuine creative eye for short-form content and understands the wedding space deeply.



What You'll Be Doing:



Production Coordination (Primary Role):

- Importing and backing up footage

- Organising footage into Adobe Premiere Pro

- Creating and managing proxy files for editing

- Uploading proxy files to Google Drive for our editing team

- Using AI tools to generate story notes and compiling detailed project notes for editors

- Troubleshooting and locating missing proxies and project assets

- Exporting completed wedding films once approved

- Uploading final films to VidFlow and managing client deliveries

- Coordinating and scheduling projects through NoBacklog

- Assigning weekly editing tasks and managing editor workloads

- Overseeing project progress through our custom production management software

- Helping ensure projects remain on schedule and delivered on time



Social Media Editing (Secondary Role):

- Producing 3 social media posts per week, published to Instagram, 
 and

- Working from a weekly content brief — we'll identify which weddings best suit each piece of content

- Pulling your own selects from full wedding footage based on the brief

- Editing within our defined brand style and format

- Staying across current trends in the wedding and short-form video space

- Proactively suggesting on-brand content ideas and creative approaches — we want someone who brings fresh thinking, not   just someone who executes instructions

- Adapting content appropriately for each platform



What We're Looking For:



- Exceptional organisational and project management skills — this is the number one priority

- Background in video editing with strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro — you understand the software because you've edited with it, not just managed files in it

- Genuine feel for short-form social media content — you understand what performs on Instagram Reels and TikTok, particularly in the wedding space

- A creative eye that goes beyond execution — you notice trends, you have ideas, and you're not afraid to bring them to us

- Ability to spot problems before they become problems

- Confidence working independently in a remote environment

- Clear written communication and ability to collaborate with a distributed team

- A proactive mindset — someone who improves workflows without being asked

- Genuine care for the quality of the final product even when working behind the scenes

- Essential Requirements

- Demonstrated experience in a production coordination or project management role

- Background in video editing with strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro — you understand the software because you've edited with it, not just managed files in it

- Demonstrated experience creating short-form social media content — Instagram Reels and TikTok specifically

- An understanding of the wedding industry and what resonates with couples and wedding audiences

- If you're also proficient in Final Cut Pro X (FCPX), that's a significant advantage. If you're strong in both Premier Pro and FCPX, make sure you tell us.

- Comfortable working via TeamViewer remote desktop

- Availability to work with a minimum of 6 hours overlap with Australian Eastern Time (AEST/AEDT)

- Reliable high-speed internet connection suitable for remote desktop access

- A computer capable of running remote production workflows efficiently



Software You'll Be Using:



- Adobe Premiere Pro

- Adobe Media Encoder

- Final Cut Pro X (FCPX) — advantageous but not necessary

- TeamViewer

- Slack

- Google Drive

- VidFlow

- Meta (Instagram,
)

- TikTok

- AI tools for story note generation

- Love Poets' custom production management software



Working Hours & Time Zone Overlap:



This role requires at least 6 hours of overlap with Australian Eastern Time (AEST/AEDT) each weekday for team communication and project coordination. Remaining hours can be worked flexibly.



What Success Looks Like:



Our editors always have organised, well-noted projects ready to work on. Clients receive their films on time. Nothing falls through the cracks. Our social media consistently reflects the quality of our work and grows our audience. You'll work closely with the company director — this is a role with real visibility and direct communication, not a faceless task queue. We want someone who takes that seriously and grows with us.



Before applying, take a look at our Instagram 
 — to understand the work you'll be supporting and the audience you'll be speaking to.



Employment & Compensation:



This role is offered as full legal employment through an employer of record — not a freelance or contractor arrangement. title: Cold Calling & Appointment Setting Virtual Assistant
description:
# Cold Calling & Appointment Setting Virtual Assistant



**Pay:** $5 USD/hour + $5 bonus per qualified appointment booked  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines preferred  

**Schedule:** U.S. Eastern Time business hours  

**Starting Hours:** Part-time with opportunity to increase hours based on performance



## About the Position



We are hiring a confident English-speaking Virtual Assistant to handle outbound cold calling and appointment setting for two growing U.S.-based businesses.



### Business #1 – Commercial Cleaning Services



A professional commercial cleaning company serving local businesses and commercial properties. Services include recurring office cleaning, janitorial services, and customized commercial cleaning solutions.



### Business #2 – AI Automation & Technology Services



An AI automation company helping local businesses improve lead response, missed-call handling, appointment booking, customer follow-up, customer communication, and repetitive business processes through AI and automation.



Your primary responsibility will be **outbound B2B cold calling and appointment setting**.



You are **not expected to close the sale**.



Your job is to:



**Call → Reach the Decision-Maker → Qualify → Create Interest → Book the Appointment → Update the CRM**



Our team will handle the sales appointment, quote/demo, and closing.



## Compensation



**$5 USD per hour**



PLUS



**$5 bonus for every qualified appointment booked**



There is no fixed limit on appointment bonuses.



Example:



20 hours worked = **$100 base pay**



10 qualified appointments = **$50 bonus**



**Total earnings = $150**



Strong performance can lead to additional hours, increased responsibility, and higher performance incentives.



## What Counts as a Qualified Appointment?



An appointment qualifies for the bonus when:



- You speak with the prospect or appropriate decision-maker

- The prospect has a legitimate potential need for our service

- The prospect understands why the appointment is being scheduled

- The prospect voluntarily agrees to a specific appointment date and time

- Accurate contact information is entered into our system

- Clear notes about the conversation are provided

- The appointment is not fake, duplicate, or obviously unqualified



We care about **quality appointments**, not simply filling a calendar.



## Campaign #1 – Commercial Cleaning



You will contact businesses that may require recurring commercial cleaning services, including:



- Professional offices

- Medical and dental offices

- Property management companies

- Commercial buildings

- Retail businesses

- Gyms and fitness facilities

- Daycares

- Warehouses

- Other commercial facilities



Your goal is to identify the person responsible for cleaning or janitorial services and determine whether they would be open to receiving a competitive quote.



You may speak with:



- Business owners

- Office managers

- Property managers

- Facility managers

- Operations managers

- Other decision-makers



The primary goal is:



**Schedule a free commercial cleaning walkthrough/quote.**



You are not expected to sell the cleaning contract over the phone.



## Campaign #2 – AI Automation Services



You will contact local businesses such as:



- HVAC companies

- Roofing companies

- Plumbing companies

- Electrical companies

- Dentists

- Med spas

- Law firms

- Auto businesses

- Other local service businesses



Your job is to identify potential problems such as:



- Missed incoming calls

- Slow response to new leads

- Leads that never receive proper follow-up

- Manual appointment scheduling

- Repetitive customer communication

- Old leads sitting unused in a database

- Lack of automated follow-up

- Staff spending too much time on repetitive administrative work



You will briefly introduce how AI and automation can help solve these problems and determine whether the prospect is interested in learning more.



The primary goal is:



**Schedule a discovery/demo appointment with our team.**



You do not need to be an AI expert.



We will provide training on our services, scripts, offers, qualification process, and common objections.



## Daily Responsibilities



Your typical responsibilities will include:



- Making outbound calls from provided lead lists

- Following our cold-call scripts

- Getting past receptionists and gatekeepers

- Reaching owners, managers, and decision-makers

- Asking qualification questions

- Handling basic objections

- Booking qualified appointments

- Following up with interested prospects

- Recording detailed call notes

- Updating lead statuses in our CRM

- Completing a short end-of-day performance report



## Performance Metrics



We will track:



**Dials → Connections → Decision-Makers → Qualified Conversations → Appointments → Shows → Sales**



We care about performance and continuous improvement—not simply the number of hours logged.



## Requirements



The ideal candidate has:



- Strong spoken English

- Clear and professional communication

- Previous cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

- Confidence speaking with U.S. business owners

- B2B calling experience preferred

- Ability to handle rejection professionally

- Ability to follow a script without sounding robotic

- Good listening and qualification skills

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Quality headset/microphone

- Quiet working environment

- Reliable computer

- Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

- Strong organization and attention to detail



## How to Apply



Start your application with:



**READY TO CALL**



Then answer the following questions:



1. How many years of cold-calling or appointment-setting experience do you have?

2. Have you cold-called U.S. businesses before?

3. What industries have you called?

4. How many outbound calls can you comfortably make during a 4-hour shift?

5. What dialers and CRM systems have you used?

6. How would you respond if a business says, “We're happy with our current provider”?

7. Are you available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours?

8. Do you have a quiet workspace, quality headset, and reliable internet?

9. What is your current internet speed?

10. Please provide a **30–60 second voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining your cold-calling experience.



## Paid Trial



Selected applicants may be offered a **paid trial period** before we select our long-term team member.



During the trial, we will evaluate:



- English communication

- Call confidence

- Ability to follow scripts

- Ability to get past gatekeepers

- Quality of conversations

- Qualification ability

- Appointment quality

- CRM accuracy

- Reliability and attendance

- Coachability



## Long-Term Growth



This position can grow beyond cold calling.



A high-performing team member may eventually take on responsibilities involving:



- Lead research

- CRM management

- SMS and
 follow-up

- Appointment confirmations

- Lead reactivation

- Sales pipeline management

- AI-assisted prospect research

- Managing additional appointment setters



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term working relationship and grow with our businesses.

If you’re driven by insights, live for scroll-stopping content, and thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities:



Create strategic creative briefs informed by brand objectives, audience behavior, and past performance.

Lead the ideation and storyboarding of direct-response ad campaigns tailored to paid media platforms.

Collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, and video editors to bring concepts to life with high creative impact.

Monitor campaign performance to identify opportunities for iteration, optimization, or scaling.

Run brainstorm sessions and pitch creative concepts internally or directly to clients.

Stay ahead of trends on Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms to inspire innovative creative strategies.

Translate brand messaging into adaptable narratives suited for different formats, placements, and target segments.



Requirements:



2–5 years of experience in a creative strategy or performance marketing role, preferably within an agency or fast-paced DTC environment.

Deep understanding of performance metrics (CTR, CVR, ROAS) and how creative drives outcomes.

Strong conceptual thinking and ability to visually and verbally communicate ideas.

Familiarity with paid media platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Google Ads).

Proficiency with creative collaboration tools such as Figma, Google Slides, Notion, or similar.

Comfortable working in agile, data-driven environments with fast feedback loops.

Experience scripting and concepting for video creatives is a plus.

Understanding of creative testing frameworks (e.g. modular creative, thumbstop testing) is a plus.

Light editing/design skills or familiarity with tools like Canva, CapCut, or Adobe Creative Suite is a plus.



This role is part of our passive recruitment efforts, and while an immediate opening may not be available, we welcome experienced and motivated candidates to express their interest. We look forward to connecting with you should a suitable opportunity arise.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator



Position Type: Part-Time / Contract

Location: Remote with preference for someone available during Eastern Time business hours

Reports To: Founder / Owner



About the Role



We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator to support a busy entrepreneur managing multiple business initiatives, including the launch and operation of an FS8 fitness and wellness studio, recruiting projects, community partnerships, events, marketing initiatives, and personal administrative responsibilities.



This is not a traditional administrative assistant role. The ideal candidate is someone who can anticipate needs, keep multiple projects moving forward, follow up without being asked, and create structure around a fast-moving workload.



The right person will be comfortable managing both business and personal priorities while helping ensure that deadlines, communications, events, partnerships, and projects do not fall through the cracks.



Key Responsibilities

Executive Inbox & Follow-Up Management

Monitor and organize
 communications.

Flag messages requiring the Founder’s personal response or decision.

Draft routine responses for review and approval.

Follow up on unanswered vendor, partnership, client, and business communications.

Maintain a running follow-up list with deadlines and next steps.

Help identify communications that require urgent attention.

Calendar & Schedule Management

Schedule calls, meetings, interviews, appointments, and events.

Coordinate availability with vendors, candidates, clients, and partners.

Maintain an organized calendar and prevent scheduling conflicts.

Add important deadlines, events, permit dates, school dates, and business milestones.

Send reminders and help prepare for upcoming meetings.

FS8 Project Coordination



Support the opening and ongoing operations of the FS8 studio by maintaining and updating project trackers related to:



Studio opening checklist

Permits and licensing

Vendors and contractors

Equipment and operational needs

Partnerships and collaborations

Presale initiatives

Marketing deliverables

Events

Grand-opening activities

Deadlines and outstanding action items



The coordinator should regularly identify what is outstanding, who owns each task, and what follow-up is required.



Event & Community Partnership Coordination



Assist with events such as Pilates collaborations, wellness events, pop-ups, vendor activations, and community partnerships.



Responsibilities may include:



Maintaining event timelines and checklists.

Coordinating participating vendors and partners.

Managing vendor contact information and confirmations.

Tracking RSVPs and registrations.

Requesting certificates of insurance and required documentation.

Coordinating signage, giveaways, promotional items, and event materials.

Confirming logistics leading up to events.

Managing post-event thank-you messages and follow-up opportunities.

Partnership Outreach & CRM Management

Maintain a partnership and community outreach tracker.

Track organizations and businesses contacted.

Record the date of the last communication.

Identify next steps and follow-up dates.

Track potential event and collaboration opportunities.

Maintain statuses such as Contacted, Follow-Up Needed, Meeting Scheduled, Confirmed, or Closed.

Support outreach to local businesses, wellness brands, hospitality partners, retailers, and community organizations.

Recruiting Administration



Support recruiting operations while the Founder remains responsible for higher-level candidate screening, interviewing, client relationships, and hiring strategy.



Responsibilities include:



Scheduling candidate interviews.

Sending interview confirmations and reminders.

Following up with candidates.

Organizing resumes and candidate information.

Updating recruiting spreadsheets and applicant trackers.

Maintaining accurate candidate pipelines.

Preparing candidate packets or summaries.

Coordinating interviews with hiring managers and clients.

Tracking outstanding feedback and next steps.

Documents, Spreadsheets & Canva Support



Assist with the creation and organization of business materials including:



Proposals

Spreadsheets and trackers

Google Forms

Event one-sheets

Vendor information sheets

Hiring materials

Recruiting documents

Presentation materials

Basic Canva updates

Flyers using existing brand templates

Formatting documents and presentations



Strong attention to formatting, organization, and brand consistency is important.



Social Media Coordination



This role will support execution and organization rather than own the overall social media strategy.



Responsibilities may include:



Organizing content calendars.

Gathering photos and video assets.

Maintaining folders of approved content.

Scheduling approved posts.

Coordinating giveaways and collaboration posts.

Ensuring partners and vendors are properly tagged.

Tracking agreed-upon social media deliverables.

Following up with partners for photos, logos, captions, or other assets.

Personal Administrative Support



Provide occasional personal administrative support, including:



School deadlines and important dates.

Appointment scheduling.

Forms and registrations.

Travel organization.

Reservations.

Reminders.

Family calendar coordination.

Other logistical tasks that can be delegated.

What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



Extremely organized and detail-oriented.

Proactive rather than reactive.

Comfortable following up repeatedly and professionally.

Able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Strong at creating systems, trackers, and checklists.

Comfortable working in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment.

Able to distinguish between what requires immediate attention and what can wait.

An excellent written communicator.

Professional when communicating with executives, clients, vendors, candidates, and community partners.

Comfortable handling confidential business and personal information.

Able to work independently without requiring constant direction.

Naturally inclined to ask, “What is the next step?”

Preferred Skills & Experience

Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Project Coordinator, Operations Coordinator, or similar role.

Experience supporting an entrepreneur, founder, or small business owner strongly preferred.

Experience coordinating events or community partnerships.

Recruiting or HR administrative experience is a plus.

Strong Google Workspace skills, including Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Forms, and Drive.

Experience with Canva.

Familiarity with project-management or CRM tools.

Comfortable learning new technology and systems quickly.

Experience with fitness, wellness, hospitality, recruiting, or small-business environments is a plus.

Success in This Role Looks Like



Within the first several months, the successful candidate should:



Know what needs follow-up without constantly being reminded.

Keep the Founder’s inbox and calendar organized.

Maintain accurate project, partnership, event, and recruiting trackers.

Reduce missed deadlines and unanswered communications.

Keep FS8 opening initiatives moving forward.

Ensure events and partnerships are organized well in advance.

Create more time for the Founder to focus on strategy, relationships, interviewing, business development, and high-level decision-making.
