title: AI Automation Engineer — Creator Partnerships CRM and MCP Integration
description:
AI AUTOMATION ENGINEER — CREATOR PARTNERSHIPS CRM AND MCP INTEGRATION



Remote | Project-Based With Potential Ongoing Maintenance



6FT CLUB® is a Los Angeles-based men’s confidence and footwear brand. We are looking for an experienced AI Automation Engineer to design and build a creator-partnership management system that can be accessed and operated through Claude, ChatGPT, or another MCP-compatible AI assistant.



This is a hands-on implementation project—not a strategy, prompt-writing, or generic virtual-assistant position.



BUSINESS OBJECTIVE



We work with two categories of creators:



1. Los Angeles-based male models and video creators who can visit our Downtown Los Angeles studio to produce content featuring our height-increase shoes. These shoes must remain at the studio.



2. U.S.-based TikTok, Instagram, Amazon, and UGC creators who can receive our height-increase insoles by mail and create short-form video content remotely.



We want a centralized system that helps us discover, evaluate, contact, manage, and follow up with these creators without relying on disconnected spreadsheets, inbox searches, and manual reminders.



WHAT WE WANT BUILT



The finished system should combine:



* A central creator CRM or database.

* AI-assisted creator qualification and brand-fit scoring.

* Personalized outreach drafting.

* Human approval before important external actions.

*
 sending and reply tracking.

* Follow-up reminders and pipeline management.

* Creator campaign and deliverable tracking.

* An MCP server that allows Claude or ChatGPT to safely access and operate the system.



We are open to practical recommendations regarding the technology stack. Possible tools include Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, Supabase, Gmail, n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI, Anthropic, and custom TypeScript or Python development.



We do not require every tool listed above. We want the simplest secure system that solves the business problem without unnecessary monthly software costs.



CORE WORKFLOW



The system should help us with the following:



1. ADD AND ORGANIZE CREATORS



* Add creators manually, through approved data sources, or by importing a CSV.

* Store the creator’s name, location, platforms, profile links, contact information, follower count, engagement information, content category, rates, sizes, and notes.

* Detect and prevent duplicate creator records.

* Distinguish between LA studio talent and U.S.-based remote UGC creators.



2. EVALUATE BRAND FIT



Use AI and predefined criteria to assess whether a creator matches the 6FT CLUB brand.



Our audience primarily includes men interested in:



* Confidence and self-improvement.

* Dating and social life.

* Men’s style and grooming.

* Fitness and looksmaxxing.

* Career and personal presentation.



Strong creator candidates are generally male, approximately 21–35, and capable of producing natural, contemporary short-form video. Creators with an Amazon Storefront or Amazon video experience are especially valuable.



The AI should provide a fit score with an understandable explanation. It should not make unexplained or irreversible decisions.



3. GENERATE PERSONALIZED OUTREACH



* Create personalized
 and direct-message drafts based on each creator’s profile and content.

* Use separate outreach templates for LA studio shoots and mailed-insole collaborations.

* Allow a human to review and edit messages before sending.

* Track when outreach was drafted, approved, sent, answered, or ignored.

* Recommend appropriate follow-up messages.

* Prevent duplicate or excessive outreach.



 automation may use approved Gmail integrations. Instagram and TikTok workflows must comply with the platforms’ current APIs, terms, rate limits, and account restrictions.



If direct automated messaging is not officially supported, the system should create a safe manual approval or copy-and-send workflow instead. We do not want browser bots or scraping methods that could place our accounts at risk.



4. MANAGE THE CREATOR PIPELINE



The system should support stages such as:



* Discovered.

* Needs Review.

* Approved for Outreach.

* Contacted.

* Follow-Up Due.

* Responded.

* Negotiating.

* Product Shipment Needed.

* Content in Production.

* Content Delivered.

* Approved.

* Declined.

* Do Not Contact.



We should be able to see which creators require attention and what action should happen next.



5. TRACK CAMPAIGN DETAILS



For each creator, we may need to track:



* Agreed compensation.

* Product and size requested.

* Shipping information.

* Tracking number.

* Content brief.

* Due date.

* Usage rights.

* Revision allowance.

* Completed deliverables.

* Payment status.

* Past performance.

* Whether we would work with the creator again.



MCP REQUIREMENTS



Build an authenticated MCP server that exposes narrowly defined tools to an approved AI client.



Suggested MCP tools include:



* Search creators.

* Add a creator.

* Find duplicate creators.

* Score creator brand fit.

* Show creators awaiting review.

* Draft personalized outreach.

* Show messages awaiting human approval.

* Send an approved
.

* Log a response.

* Update a pipeline stage.

* List overdue follow-ups.

* Create a shipping task.

* Record content delivery.

* Generate a campaign-status summary.



The MCP should not give the AI unrestricted access to the underlying database or
 account.



Important actions—such as sending messages, changing payment information, deleting records, or marking an agreement as final—must require human confirmation or be protected by role-based permissions.



REQUIRED DELIVERABLES



PHASE 1: DISCOVERY AND ARCHITECTURE



Before building, provide:



* A workflow diagram.

* Recommended technology stack.

* Expected software subscriptions and monthly costs.

* Available official APIs and their limitations.

* Security and authentication plan.

* Proposed database structure.

* List of MCP tools and their permissions.

* Fixed project estimate and implementation timeline.



PHASE 2: WORKING MVP



Build and demonstrate a functioning system that can:



* Store and search creator records.

* Score creators against our brand criteria.

* Draft personalized outreach.

* Send approved
s.

* Track replies and follow-up dates.

* Update creator pipeline stages.

* Surface outstanding actions.

* Allow Claude or ChatGPT to perform approved actions through MCP.



PHASE 3: TESTING AND HANDOFF



Provide:



* End-to-end testing.

* Error handling and activity logs.

* Duplicate and rate-limit protection.

* Setup and deployment documentation.

* A recorded walkthrough.

* Source code and ownership transfer.

* Credential-rotation instructions.

* At least 30 days of post-launch bug support.

* Clear instructions allowing another developer to maintain the system.



SECURITY REQUIREMENTS



* Use OAuth or properly secured API credentials whenever available.

* Never hard-code passwords or API keys.

* Store secrets in environment variables or an appropriate secrets manager.

* Use least-privilege permissions.

* Maintain logs of AI-initiated actions.

* Include human approval for sensitive or external actions.

* Do not use prohibited scraping, browser bots, purchased accounts, or tools that violate platform terms.

* The business must own the source code, database, automation accounts, and deployment environment.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Applicants should have demonstrable experience with several of the following:



* Building production MCP servers.

* TypeScript, Node.js, or Python.

* OAuth and third-party API integrations.

* Gmail API or Google Workspace automation.

* Airtable, Supabase, or another structured database.

* n8n, Make, Zapier, or comparable workflow platforms.

* AI structured outputs and tool calling.

* CRM or lead-management automation.

* Webhooks, queues, logging, and retry handling.

* Secure credential and permission management.



Experience with influencer marketing, creator CRMs, e-commerce, Shopify, or social-media workflows is a major advantage.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words: AI Automation Engineer



Please answer all of the following:



1. Describe one MCP server or AI automation system you personally built. What could it read, and what actions could it take?



2. Which parts of this project would you build with custom code, and which parts would you build with tools such as n8n, Make, Airtable, or Supabase?



3. How would you prevent an AI assistant from a
 sending an unapproved
, deleting records, or contacting the same creator twice?



4. How would you handle Instagram and TikTok outreach if their official APIs do not support the required messaging workflow?



5. What database or CRM would you recommend for this project, and why?



6. Provide a simple proposed architecture for the system.



7. Identify the major technical risks or limitations you expect.



8. Provide links, screenshots, repositories, or recorded demonstrations of relevant work. Clearly explain which portions you personally built.



9. Provide your proposed price for the discovery and architecture phase. You may provide a preliminary range for the MVP, but we understand that the final quote may depend on discovery.



10. State your availability and time-zone overlap with Los Angeles.



Generic applications, copied proposals, and applications that do not address the platform and security limitations will not be considered.

title: Operations Assistant / Chief of Staff to Founder
description:
We are looking for a highly organized, resourceful, and proactive Operations Assistant / Chief of Staff to Founder to support several growing businesses across retail, e-commerce, hospitality, and consumer products.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant role.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of projects, research solutions independently, communicate with vendors and partners, keep priorities organized, and help move multiple businesses forward at the same time.



The ideal person is comfortable working in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment where priorities can shift quickly. You should be someone who sees what needs to be done, asks smart questions, follows through, and is comfortable using AI and modern software tools to work efficiently.



Businesses You’ll Support



The role will support projects across:



Konna Athletics — activewear, product development, and e-commerce

Root + Realm Café — café operations, sourcing, menu development, and launch

International Market — retail marketplace and vendor operations

Amazon, Faire, Shopify, and other e-commerce channels

Additional business and special projects as they arise



Key Responsibilities

-Operations & Project Management

-Help manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities across different businesses

-Create and maintain organized task lists, trackers, SOPs, and project plans

-Follow up on outstanding tasks and make sure projects continue moving forward

-Coordinate between suppliers, contractors, vendors, employees, and external partners

-Keep documents, quotes, invoices, contacts, and project information organized

-Identify problems or delays early and proactively recommend solutions

-Help turn ideas into clear action plans with next steps, owners, and deadlines

-Maintain visibility into what is complete, in progress, blocked, or overdue



Supplier & Vendor Management

-Research manufacturers, suppliers, products, equipment, and service providers

-Contact vendors to request pricing, samples, lead times, minimum order quantities, and specifications

-Compare supplier quotes and summarize the best options

-Follow up with suppliers until questions, orders, or issues are resolved

-Help source products from the U.S., China, Vietnam, and other international markets

-Track orders, samples, production timelines, and shipments

-Maintain organized supplier records and communication history

-Help negotiate pricing, terms, timelines, and order details when appropriate



E-Commerce

-Assist with Amazon, Faire, Shopify, and other online sales platforms

-Help manage listings, product information, pricing, inventory, and product launches

-Research competitors, keywords, pricing, and market opportunities

-Coordinate product photography, descriptions, packaging, and launch materials

-Help organize fulfillment and inventory information

-Monitor platform issues and help research solutions

-Assist with product uploads, listing updates, catalog organization, and marketplace requirements

-Support launch planning and ongoing optimization of e-commerce products



Café & Retail Operations

-Assist with sourcing café equipment, packaging, ingredients, furniture, and supplies

-Research products and vendors and compare specifications and pricing

-Help organize recipes, costing, menu information, and operational documents

-Support vendor communications for International Market

-Help maintain vendor records, inventory information, and retail documentation

-Assist with launch preparation, staffing research, systems, and operational projects

-Research commercial equipment, packaging, suppliers, and operational solutions

-Help coordinate contractors, service providers, purchasing, and project follow-ups as needed


 & Administrative Support

-Help manage and organize business
s

-Draft professional responses to vendors, landlords, partners, suppliers, and customers

-Follow up on unanswered
s and outstanding requests

-Schedule meetings and organize important information

-Maintain organized digital files and documentation

-Help prepare spreadsheets, presentations, summaries, and reports

-Track important conversations and make sure follow-ups do not get missed

-Organize information so decisions can be made quickly



Marketing & Content Coordination

-Assist with social media planning and marketing coordination

-Research content ideas, trends, competitors, and potential partnerships

-Help organize photos, videos, brand assets, and campaign materials

-Coordinate with designers, photographers, creators, or marketing partners when needed

-Help prepare product descriptions, promotional copy, and launch materials

-Support influencer, partnership, and outreach research

-Help organize content calendars and marketing projects



AI & Technology



AI will be an important part of this role.



You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT to:



Research unfamiliar topics

Compare vendors and products

Draft
s and documents

Organize information

Analyze options

Build spreadsheets and processes

Troubleshoot problems

Develop ideas and recommendations

Summarize complex information

Complete work more efficiently



We are not looking for someone who simply copies and pastes AI-generated answers.



You should be able to use AI as a tool, evaluate the information it provides, verify important details when necessary, and turn research into useful recommendations and action.



You do not need to already know every tool we use, but you must be comfortable learning new software quickly.



Experience with tools such as the following is helpful:



ChatGPT

Notion

Google Workspace

Microsoft Office

Canva

Shopify

Amazon Seller Central

Faire

Square

QuickBooks

Project management tools

Excel / Google Sheets

What We’re Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you are:



Extremely organized

Proactive and resourceful

Comfortable working independently

Good at researching and solving problems

Detail-oriented

Reliable with follow-through

Comfortable managing several projects at once

A strong written communicator

Comfortable communicating professionally with vendors and partners

Able to take a broad assignment and figure out the next steps

Comfortable asking questions when necessary but not dependent on constant instructions

Tech-savvy and willing to learn

Experienced using AI tools to improve productivity

Comfortable working directly with a founder

Able to adapt when priorities change

Strong at keeping track of details without losing sight of the bigger picture



We value judgment, initiative, ownership, and follow-through more than simply completing assigned tasks.



If you notice something that needs to be handled, researched, followed up on, or improved, we want you to take ownership of it.



Experience



Previous experience in the following is preferred:



Executive assistance

Operations

Project management

E-commerce

Amazon

Shopify

Retail

Hospitality

Vendor management

Procurement or sourcing

Startups or small businesses



Experience working directly with a founder, executive, or entrepreneur is a strong advantage.



Candidates do not need experience in every industry listed above. Strong organizational ability, judgment, research skills, communication, and willingness to learn are more important.



Location



This is a remote position.



We are especially interested in candidates based in the Philippines.



You must have:



Reliable high-speed internet

A dependable computer

A quiet and professional work environment

Strong English communication skills

Reliable availability during agreed-upon working hours



Some overlap with U.S. business hours will be required for meetings, communication, and collaboration.



You will not be expected to work a full U.S. overnight schedule. The goal is to establish a schedule that works well for both the candidate and the businesses while maintaining enough overlap for real-time communication when needed.



Compensation & Benefits



Starting compensation is expected to be approximately $800–$1,500 USD per month, depending on experience, availability, and level of responsibility.



The position may also include:



Unlimited paid time off, within reason and with appropriate advance notice

Paid holidays

Performance-based bonuses

Compensation review after approximately 6 months

Opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation as the businesses grow



We believe in flexibility and trust.



PTO is not tracked against a fixed annual allowance, but employees are expected to use good judgment, communicate planned time off in advance whenever possible, and ensure responsibilities, deadlines, and important projects are appropriately covered.



This role has the potential to grow significantly for the right person.



Schedule: Full-time preferred.



The position offers flexibility in working hours, but some overlap with U.S. business hours is required to allow for communication, meetings, vendor coordination, and time-sensitive projects.



The exact schedule can be discussed based on the candidate and business needs.



We care more about reliability, communication, ownership, and results than requiring someone to sit online during a rigid schedule.



Because this role supports multiple businesses and ongoing projects, you should be responsive during agreed-upon working hours and communicate clearly if your availability changes.



As long as responsibilities are handled, deadlines are met, and you are available during agreed-upon overlap hours, there is flexibility in how your workday is structured.



Growth Opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of the businesses.



For the right person, this role can grow into a significantly larger operations, project management, or Chief of Staff position over time.



As trust and experience grow, you may take ownership of larger projects, manage vendors or team members, help build systems, and become increasingly involved in business operations and decision-making.



The goal is to develop someone who understands the businesses well enough to eventually anticipate needs, solve problems independently, and take meaningful responsibilities off the founder's plate.



How to Apply



Please send your application through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line:



Operations / Chief of Staff Application – [Your First Name]



Please include the following in your message:



A link to your current résumé/CV

Your current location

Your expected monthly salary in USD

Your preferred working hours and availability

Your experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools

The software and platforms you have experience using

An example of a project you managed independently from start to finish



Please also answer the following questions directly in your application:



1. You are asked to find a manufacturer for a product you have never sourced before. Walk us through exactly how you would approach the assignment.



2. You contact a supplier requesting pricing and receive no response. What would you do next?



3. You are given five projects that all appear urgent. How would you determine what to work on first?



4. How do you currently use AI tools in your work? Please give specific examples.



5. You receive a task with limited instructions and are unsure how to complete it. What would you do before asking for additional direction?



Applications that do not follow these instructions or do not answer all five questions may not be considered.



Who This Role Is Best For



This role is best for someone who enjoys variety, problem-solving, and working behind the scenes to make businesses run better.



You will not be doing the same task every day.



One day you may be comparing suppliers. Another day you may be organizing a café equipment purchase, researching an Amazon issue, drafting vendor
s, updating a project tracker, or helping prepare for a product launch.



You should enjoy learning new industries, figuring things out, and bringing structure to a fast-moving environment.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted operational partner, not someone who is simply looking for a list of daily administrative tasks.

title: Roblox Video Creator — Faceless YouTube Channel
description:
We are looking for a creative and highly experienced Roblox player to produce entertaining videos for a faceless YouTube channel. This is not simply a position for playing Roblox or recording ordinary gameplay. You must understand how to transform gameplay into structured, engaging YouTube content that holds viewers’ attention.



The ideal candidate understands Roblox culture, YouTube storytelling, viral gaming concepts, and the visual pacing required for successful faceless content.



Responsibilities

Create Roblox videos based on assigned topics, scripts, and creative briefs

Plan how each concept should be presented visually before recording

Capture specific scenes, challenges, demonstrations, reactions, and cinematic shots

Stage or recreate gameplay moments when needed to support the story

Record multiple angles, takes, and variations for the editing team

Identify the most entertaining moments and remove unusable footage

Create videos with a clear hook, progression, payoff, and satisfying conclusion

Research trending Roblox games, updates, challenges, memes, and video formats

Suggest original video ideas with strong click and retention potential

Coordinate additional Roblox players or accounts when a scene requires multiple characters

Organize and clearly label all footage, project files, and supporting assets

Work closely with writers, editors, thumbnail designers, and channel managers

Revise or re-record footage based on feedback

Consistently meet the channel’s production schedule

Required Skills

Extensive experience playing Roblox and knowledge of its community

Strong understanding of faceless gaming videos on YouTube

Ability to recognize what makes a video entertaining rather than merely informative

Understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, viewer retention, and visual variety

Ability to translate a written script into compelling gameplay scenes

Experience recording smooth, high-quality gameplay

Ability to stage scenes and control characters for storytelling purposes

Familiarity with OBS Studio or comparable recording software

Strong attention to framing, camera movement, graphics settings, and visual clarity

Ability to follow detailed creative instructions while contributing original ideas

Reliable communication, organization, and time management

A capable gaming computer and stable high-speed internet connection

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience producing Roblox or gaming videos for YouTube

Basic or intermediate video-editing experience

Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar software

Knowledge of YouTube analytics, especially click-through rate and audience retention

Experience writing video outlines, scripts, hooks, or titles

Experience directing other players during multiplayer recordings

Ability to use multiple Roblox accounts for staged scenes

Familiarity with several popular Roblox games and content categories

What We Are Looking For



We want someone who thinks like a video creator, not only a Roblox player. You should naturally consider questions such as:



Is the opening visually interesting within the first few seconds?

Does every scene help move the video forward?

Is there enough visual variety to maintain attention?

What footage will the editor need to make the moment more entertaining?

Is the payoff worth watching until the end?

How could the concept, title, or thumbnail be made more clickable?



This is a behind-the-scenes role for a faceless channel. You will not be required to appear on camera. Depending on the video format, you may be asked to provide gameplay, voiceover, scripts, rough edits, or complete videos.



Application Questions



Please answer each question when applying:



How many years have you played Roblox?

Which Roblox games and content categories do you know best?

Have you previously created videos for YouTube or another social platform? Please provide links.

Have you worked on a faceless YouTube channel before? If so, describe your responsibilities.

What do you believe makes a Roblox video entertaining and capable of retaining viewers?

How would you turn an ordinary gameplay session into a structured YouTube video?

What should happen during the first 15–30 seconds of a gaming video?

Are you comfortable following a script and recreating specific scenes inside Roblox?

Can you coordinate other players or operate multiple accounts for staged scenes?

Which recording and editing programs do you use?

Are you capable of delivering edited videos, or do you specialize in recording and preparing footage for an editor?

What are your computer specifications and internet speed?

How many completed videos could you realistically produce each week?

What is your weekly availability?

Have you reviewed the salary rate and understand/agree?



Practical Test



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid trial assignment. The assignment may involve developing a Roblox video concept, creating a short outline, recording the necessary scenes, and assembling a sample video or organized footage package.

title: Video Game Catalogue & Pricing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Video Game Catalogue & Pricing Specialist to maintain and update our product catalogues across Roblox, Path of Exile, Diablo, and other online games.



Your primary responsibility will be ensuring that every listed item, currency, service, variation, and price remains accurate and competitive. This is a daily operational role requiring consistent market research, strong gaming knowledge, and exceptional attention to detail.



Responsibilities

Review and update prices across all assigned games every day

Maintain accurate catalogues of currencies, items, equipment, services, and other game-specific products

Research current market prices using approved marketplaces, competitor websites, community resources, and in-game data

Compare market pricing against acquisition costs, availability, and required profit margins

Identify products that are overpriced, underpriced, unavailable, outdated, or missing

Add newly released items, currencies, game modes, seasons, leagues, servers, and platforms

Remove or deactivate obsolete and unavailable products

Maintain correct product names, images, descriptions, categories, quantities, and variations

Ensure products are assigned to the correct game, platform, server, region, league, season, and game mode

Distinguish between similarly named items and game-specific variants

Monitor game updates, patches, expansions, seasonal resets, and marketplace changes that may affect pricing or demand

Maintain internal pricing spreadsheets, trackers, and change logs

Document the sources and reasoning behind significant price changes

Report unusual price movements, supply shortages, new opportunities, and potential catalogue errors

Coordinate with suppliers, fulfillment staff, customer-service agents, and management when availability or pricing is unclear

Conduct routine catalogue audits to ensure customers are seeing accurate and purchasable products

Game-Specific Responsibilities

Roblox

Maintain separate catalogues for the Roblox games we support

Track game-specific items, currencies, bundles, pets, weapons, ranks, and services

Prevent products from different Roblox experiences from being incorrectly combined

Path of Exile and Path of Exile 2

Maintain currency, equipment, unique-item, crafting, and service catalogues

Separate products by game, platform, league, and game mode

Monitor new leagues, balance changes, drop-rate changes, and rapidly shifting economies

Update prices frequently during league launches and other volatile periods

Ensure item modifiers, variants, quantities, and listing descriptions are accurate

Diablo

Maintain item, material, gold, equipment, and service catalogues

Separate products by game, platform, season, mode, and server or region when applicable

Monitor seasonal resets, patches, balance changes, and item availability

Verify item attributes and variations before publishing listings

Other Games

Learn the economy and catalogue structure of newly assigned games

Identify the attributes customers need to select the correct product

Build and maintain organized product catalogues using reliable sources

Adapt quickly when games introduce new content or change their trading systems

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of online games, virtual items, currencies, and player-driven economies

Experience with Roblox, Path of Exile, Diablo, MMOs, ARPGs, or similar games

Excellent internet research and price-comparison skills

Advanced attention to detail and the ability to identify small listing discrepancies

Comfortable working with large product catalogues and repetitive daily audits

Proficiency with Google Sheets, Excel, or similar spreadsheet software

Ability to learn internal catalogue-management and e-commerce systems

Basic understanding of costs, margins, markups, and competitive pricing

Ability to evaluate whether a pricing source is reliable and current

Strong written English and accurate data-entry skills

Ability to work independently and complete daily updates on schedule

Reliable computer and internet connection

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience managing products for a gaming marketplace or e-commerce website

Experience pricing virtual goods, game currencies, or digital services

Familiarity with competitor marketplaces and game-economy tracking websites

Experience using Shopify, WooCommerce, marketplace dashboards, or product-management systems

Advanced spreadsheet skills, including filters, formulas, conditional formatting, and lookup functions

Experience working with rapidly changing seasonal economies

Knowledge of multiple games rather than only one title

Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by:



Accuracy of product information and pricing

Completion of daily catalogue checks

Speed in responding to market changes

Reduction in outdated, unavailable, or incorrectly priced products

Accuracy of game, platform, region, league, season, and item variations

Quality and organization of pricing records

Ability to identify profitable products and catalogue gaps

Reliability in meeting daily deadlines



This position requires active judgment. The specialist should not blindly copy competitor prices. You must consider the reliability of the source, product quantity, exact variation, current availability, acquisition cost, market movement, and our required margin before making a change.



Application Questions



Please answer every question:



Which of the following do you know well: Roblox, Path of Exile, Path of Exile 2, Diablo, MMOs, or other online games?

For each game you listed, how long have you played it?

How would you determine the current market price of an in-game item?

What would you do if competitor pricing conflicted with supplier pricing or internal availability?

How would you organize products across different games, platforms, regions, leagues, seasons, and servers?

Describe a situation where your attention to detail helped you identify an error.

Rate your Google Sheets or Excel ability from 1 to 10 and list the functions or features you regularly use.

Are you comfortable performing structured and repetitive catalogue checks every day?

What hours and days are you available?

Have you reviewed the salary rate and agree?



Practical Test



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a paid test involving a sample game catalogue. The test may require the applicant to:



Research several products using multiple sources

Match exact item variations

Recommend updated prices

Identify inaccurate or missing information

Organize the findings in a spreadsheet

Explain the reasoning and sources behind each recommendation

title: TikTok Shop & Creator Affiliate Manager
description:
Remote | Part Time with Opportunity to Grow



We are Violate The Dress Code, a US based women's activewear brand built around standing out, breaking the rules, and creating products people actually want to be seen in.



We are looking for someone to take ownership of our TikTok presence and TikTok Shop growth.



This is NOT just a social media posting position.



We want someone who understands TikTok Shop, creator affiliate marketing, content, community engagement, and how all of those pieces work together to drive SALES.



Our goal is to find someone who can eventually own this side of the business rather than waiting for us to tell them every single thing to do.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

TIKTOK SHOP & SELLER CENTER



You will help manage the day to day operations of our TikTok Shop, including:



Managing TikTok Shop Seller Center

Managing our affiliate and creator programs

Setting up and optimizing Open and Target Collaborations

Managing creator commission opportunities

Managing sample requests and creator collaborations

Keeping our products and promotions organized

Identifying opportunities within TikTok Shop to increase sales

Monitoring TikTok Shop performance and reporting what is working

Staying up to date on new TikTok Shop tools, programs, and opportunities



We do not want someone who simply maintains the account.



We want someone actively looking for ways to GROW it.



CREATOR RECRUITMENT & AFFILIATE MANAGEMENT



A major part of this position will be finding creators who can sell our products.



You will be responsible for:



Finding creators who fit the Violate brand and customer

Consistently reaching out to new creators

Sending targeted collaboration invitations

Reviewing creator profiles, content, engagement, and sales potential

Building relationships with creators who perform well

Following up with creators who have received or purchased products

Encouraging creators to produce additional content

Identifying our highest performing affiliates

Developing stronger partnerships with creators who generate sales

Keeping creator outreach and results organized

Helping us build a growing network of creators consistently promoting Violate



We are NOT interested in blindly sending free clothing to hundreds of people.



We want someone who understands how to identify creators with actual potential, build relationships with them, and turn creator partnerships into revenue.



TIKTOK CONTENT



You will also help manage the Violate TikTok account itself.



Responsibilities include:



Posting consistently

Writing hooks and captions that fit our brand

Identifying trends that actually make sense for Violate

Working with our video editor and existing content library

Repurposing existing footage into TikTok content

Identifying content we should create next

Testing different posting styles, hooks, products, and concepts

Monitoring which videos drive views, engagement, product clicks, and sales

Using performance data to improve future content



You will NOT be expected to professionally edit every video yourself.



We have a dedicated video editor.



Part of your job will be helping identify WHAT we should create and communicating those needs to our editor.



COMMUNITY & ENGAGEMENT



We want Violate to feel like an actual brand and community on TikTok, not an account that posts and disappears.



You will be responsible for:



Responding to comments

Engaging with relevant creators and potential customers

Engaging with videos featuring Violate products

Identifying opportunities for video replies

Helping build relationships within our TikTok community

Monitoring questions, feedback, and conversations around our products

Keeping the brand active and present on the platform

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is proactive.



If your preferred way of working is waiting for a list of tasks every morning, this probably isn't the right position.



We want someone who can look at our TikTok Shop and say:



"This isn't working. Here's what I think we should test."



Or:



"This creator is performing really well. I reached out to her about making more content."



Or:



"This product is getting clicks but isn't converting. Here's what I'm seeing."



That is the type of ownership we are looking for.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You should have experience with:



TikTok Shop

TikTok Shop Seller Center

TikTok Shop Affiliate Center

Creator outreach

Open and Target Collaborations

TikTok content strategy

Community management

Ecommerce or direct to consumer brands

Understanding TikTok analytics



Experience with women's fashion, activewear, fitness, beauty, or lifestyle brands is a major plus.



YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

Actually understand TikTok culture

Understand that views are not the same thing as sales

Know how TikTok Shop affiliates work

Are comfortable reaching out to creators every day

Can recognize good creators before they become huge

Understand basic ecommerce metrics

Are extremely organized

Communicate consistently

Take initiative

Can work independently

Are comfortable testing ideas and learning from what does not work

Care about results, not just completing tasks

HOURS



We would like to begin part time.



There is significant opportunity for this position to grow if TikTok becomes a larger revenue channel for the company.



COMPENSATION



Compensation will depend on experience.



We are open to discussing a base hourly rate with the opportunity for additional performance based compensation as the channel grows.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with:



I'M READY TO VIOLATE TIKTOK



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



Then please answer the following:



Tell us about your experience managing TikTok Shop.

Which parts of TikTok Shop Seller Center and Affiliate Center have you personally managed?

Have you recruited TikTok Shop creators or affiliates before? Explain your process.

What do you look for when d
 whether a creator is worth reaching out to?

Have you managed product samples, commissions, Open Collaborations, or Target Collaborations?

Tell us about a TikTok Shop account or ecommerce brand you have helped grow. Include results if you are able to share them.

If we gave you access to our TikTok account tomorrow, what are the first 3 things you would look at?

What TikTok Shop metrics do you believe matter most when the goal is increasing revenue?

Approximately how many hours per week are you available?

What is your expected hourly rate?



Please include any examples, screenshots, case studies, or accounts that demonstrate your previous work.



One last question:



Imagine we have a new pair of leggings launching in two weeks.



We already have product photos, raw video content, a video editor, inventory ready to sell, and a TikTok Shop account.



Walk us through what YOU would do during those two weeks to use TikTok, TikTok Shop, and creators to make the launch successful.



Be specific.



We are much more interested in how you think than receiving a perfectly written answer.



Please do not send us a generic or AI generated application. We want to hear from you.

title: Bookkeeper / Accounting & Finance Coordinator — U.S. Businesses

Maintaining separate books for multiple business entities

Accounts payable and accounts receivable

title: Accounts Payable Specialist - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Accounts Payable Specialist is the operational backbone of MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions' vendor payment process — the person who makes sure every bill is entered right, every check run goes out on time, and every vendor and client interaction reflects the accuracy and dependability our finance operation is built on.



This is an individual-contributor role for someone who's detail-obsessed and doesn't just process what's in front of them — you notice when something's off, and you bring it up. You'll work closely with our Accounting Program Manager to spot and fix process gaps, and report to our Accounting Team Lead.



Key Responsibilities:



Accounts Payable & Vendor Payments



Enter vendor bills accurately and in a timely manner

Process weekly check runs

Provide vendor remittances as needed

Ensure all payable records are properly coded and matched before payment



Client & Vendor Support



Manually upload client invoices to third-party portals

Support finance-related tasks for clients and vendors, including direct client- and vendor-facing communication

Respond to vendor and client inquiries with accuracy and professionalism



Process Improvement



Partner with the Accounting Program Manager to identify and implement accounts payable process improvements

Flag recurring errors or inefficiencies before they become bigger problems



Qualifications



Required:



3-5 years of experience in accounts payable and/or finance operations

Accounts payable AND customer service experience — this role is regularly client- and vendor-facing

Hands-on Salesforce experience

Strong verbal and written English communication skills



Nice-to-Have:



Experience with process improvement initiatives in an AP or finance operations setting

Familiarity with AI-enabled finance/AP tools



Compensation & Benefits:



Starting Rate: $5.00–$6.00/hour.

90-Day Review: Upon successful completion of the first 90 days, compensation may be reviewed for a performance-based rate increase based on results, reliability, ownership, and overall contribution to the team.

Permanent work-from-home

40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST — overlap with our Naperville, IL accounting team)

Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

Work Anniversary Bonus

No work with pay on US Holidays

Paid Leaves after 6 months of employment



Basic Technical Requirements:



Your own laptop/desktop PC with the following minimum specs: i5 5th gen and above/AMD equivalent; 8GB RAM; Mozilla or Chrome installed; Windows 10 upwards

A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

Noise-canceling headset/headphones

A quiet and dedicated workspace at home



Application Process

1. To submit your application, please
 the following to 

2. Your most updated resume

3. Use the following subject line:

[Your Full Name] – Accounts Payable Specialist – Remote



Please ensure your resume is attached before submitting your application.



Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Quickbooks Online Bookkeeper and A/R Specialist
description:
**QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper & A/R Specialist | Service Business**



# Job Description



Bluewater Pool Care is a fast-growing pool service and repair company in the Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas area. We are looking for an experienced **QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper & Accounts Receivable Specialist** to take ownership of keeping our books accurate, organized, and up to date.



This is **not a general virtual assistant position.**



We are specifically looking for someone who understands **bookkeeping, QuickBooks Online, accounts receivable, and customer payment collections.**



You must be comfortable **speaking with customers over the phone in English** regarding overdue invoices and payment issues.



Our business has recurring monthly service revenue, repair revenue, payroll, marketing expenses, vehicles, chemicals, equipment, software expenses, credit card processing fees, and other operating expenses.



We need someone who can make sure all of this is being recorded and categorized correctly while also helping us keep our accounts receivable under control.



## YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will be responsible for tasks including:



* Maintaining accurate books in QuickBooks Online

* Categorizing transactions correctly

* Reconciling bank accounts

* Reconciling credit card accounts

* Reviewing deposits and matching payments

* Monitoring accounts receivable

* Reviewing customer invoices and payments

* Identifying duplicate or incorrectly recorded transactions

* Identifying unusual transactions or discrepancies

* Maintaining a clean Chart of Accounts

* Reviewing uncategorized transactions

* Properly separating income and expense categories

* Helping distinguish operating expenses, assets, liabilities, owner transactions, and other classifications

* Reviewing credit card processing fees

* Helping ensure payroll-related transactions are recorded correctly

* Performing month-end bookkeeping procedures

* Preparing accurate monthly financial reports



# ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE & CUSTOMER COLLECTIONS



**This is an important part of the position.**



We need someone who will actively monitor our outstanding accounts receivable and help make sure Bluewater gets paid for the work we perform.



Responsibilities will include:



* Reviewing overdue invoices regularly

* Maintaining an organized list of overdue customer accounts

* Sending professional payment reminder
s and text messages

* **Calling customers with overdue balances**

* Professionally asking customers when payment can be expected

* Helping customers understand which invoices are outstanding

* Following up on failed or declined payments

* Documenting customer conversations and payment commitments

* Following up when a customer promises payment but does not pay

* Escalating seriously overdue or disputed accounts to management

* Identifying recurring payment problems

* Helping keep our overall accounts receivable as low as possible



You should be comfortable making calls such as:



**“Hi, this is [Name] with Bluewater Pool Care. I'm calling regarding an outstanding balance on your account. I wanted to make sure you received the invoice and see when we can expect payment.”**



You should be **professional, polite, confident, and persistent without being rude.**



We are not looking for someone who is afraid to pick up the phone.



## COMMUNICATION REQUIREMENTS



Because you will communicate directly with our customers:



* **Strong spoken English is required**

* Strong written English is required

* You must be comfortable making outbound phone calls

* You must be comfortable discussing invoices and balances

* You must communicate professionally with customers

* You must be able to clearly explain account balances

* You must document conversations accurately

* You must know when to escalate an issue instead of arguing with a customer



Previous **accounts receivable or collections experience is strongly preferred.**



## MONTHLY FINANCIAL REPORTING



At the end of each month, we want accurate reporting including:



* Profit & Loss

* Balance Sheet

* Cash Flow Statement

* Accounts Receivable

* Revenue trends

* Major expense categories

* Month-over-month comparisons

* Any unusual transactions or financial issues requiring management's attention



We want someone who can help make sure the numbers in QuickBooks actually reflect what is happening in the business.



## BILLING & SERVICE SOFTWARE



Our pool service operations are managed through **Skimmer**.



You do not need previous Skimmer experience, but you should be comfortable learning enough about the system to help verify that our financial records are accurate.



This may include:



* Cross-checking customer billing

* Verifying payments

* Identifying billing discrepancies

* Identifying completed work that may not have been invoiced

* Comparing customer balances between systems

* Helping verify recurring service billing

* Reviewing repair and additional-service billing



We can train you on the relevant parts of Skimmer.



## WHAT WE REALLY WANT



We are not looking for someone who simply categorizes transactions without thinking about them.



If something doesn't make sense, **we want you to notice it.**



Examples:



**“This expense is significantly higher than normal this month.”**



**“This deposit doesn't appear to match the customer payments.”**



**“This customer has been overdue for 30 days and hasn't responded to two reminders.”**



**“This customer promised to pay Friday, but we still haven't received payment.”**



**“This transaction appears to have been duplicated.”**



**“This expense is being categorized incorrectly.”**



We want someone who will investigate discrepancies, ask questions, follow up, and bring potential problems to management's attention.



## REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Applicants should have strong experience with:



* **QuickBooks Online**

* Bookkeeping

* Accounts receivable

* Customer payment collections

* Bank reconciliations

* Credit card reconciliations

* Transaction categorization

* Chart of Accounts management

* Profit & Loss statements

* Balance Sheets

* Cash Flow Statements

* Month-end bookkeeping



Experience working with a **U.S.-based service business or home-service company** is strongly preferred.



### BONUS QUALIFICATIONS



* QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification

* Previous A/R or collections experience

* Experience calling U.S. customers

* Experience with home-service businesses

* Experience with recurring monthly billing

* Experience with Skimmer or other field-service software

* Experience with Stripe or other payment processors

* Experience with payroll accounting

* Experience preparing books for a CPA/tax professional

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills



## HOURS



This will initially be a **part-time position**, approximately **5–10 hours per week**.



Some availability during **U.S. Central Time business hours will be required**, especially for customer payment calls.



Hours may increase as the company grows and as you take ownership of additional financial responsibilities.



## ACCESS & RESPONSIBILITY



You will receive the access necessary to perform your responsibilities.



Initially, you will **not** have authority to:



* Move company money

* Send payments

* Change payroll

* Add bank accounts

* Issue refunds without approval

* Write off customer balances without approval

* Make major accounting changes without approval



We believe in giving people more responsibility as trust is established.



## LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone who can become our **long-term bookkeeping and A/R specialist**, not someone looking for a temporary project.



If you are reliable, accurate, proactive, and help us maintain excellent financial records and low accounts receivable, there will be opportunities for increased compensation and responsibility as Bluewater grows.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. How many years of bookkeeping experience you have

2. How many years you have used QuickBooks Online

3. Whether you are a **QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor**

4. Your experience working with U.S. businesses

5. Your previous accounts receivable or collections experience

6. Whether you have personally called customers regarding overdue invoices

7. Your experience with home-service or recurring-revenue businesses

8. An example of a bookkeeping error or discrepancy you discovered and how you found it

9. Your desired hourly rate

10. Your weekly availability



Please begin your application with:



**“BLUE BOOKS”**



Applications that do not begin with those words will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will complete an interview and a **short paid skills test** before we make our final hiring decision.



Because this position involves customer phone calls, shortlisted candidates may also be asked to provide a **short voice recording** or complete a brief mock customer call during the interview.



We care about **accuracy, competence, attention to detail, integrity, proactive communication, and professionalism with our customers.**

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



If you have never worked a graveyard shift before, think carefully before applying. We will ask you specifically how you plan to structure your sleep, and how you'll make the schedule work alongside your family or partner. "I'll figure it out" is not an answer that gets you hired. This shift is sustainable for people who plan for it and difficult for people who don't.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

Sometimes a seat opens a month or two later. If you're a strong fit, we'll keep you in our pipeline and reach out when there's an opening.
