title: Experienced Airbnb / Short-Term Rental Virtual Assistant
description:
Experienced Airbnb / Short-Term Rental Virtual Assistant

2+ Years Recent STR Experience Required



We are looking for two experienced Virtual Assistants to join our short-term rental operations team.



This is a full-time, long-term position for someone who already understands how Airbnb / STR operations work and can confidently handle guests, reservations, vendors, property coordination, and daily operational tasks.



This is not an entry-level position.



Who We Are Looking For



You should have:



• At least 2 years of recent hands-on experience in Airbnb / Short-Term Rental management

• Current STR experience or no employment gap longer than 6 months

• Experience working with Airbnb and other booking platforms

• Strong written and spoken English

• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

• Ability to multitask and stay organized

• Experience coordinating cleaners, maintenance, and vendors

• Ability to work independently and follow established SOPs

• Strong attention to detail



We are looking for someone who already understands the daily realities of short-term rental operations.



You should not need to be taught the basics of Airbnb management.



About the Position



You will be part of a small operations team responsible for managing the day-to-day activities of our short-term rental portfolio.



Your primary responsibility is to make sure guests receive fast, professional support and that operational tasks are completed correctly and on time.



You will work closely with an Operations Supervisor who oversees the department, systems, documentation, and overall performance.



Your role is focused on execution, communication, coordination, and follow-through.



Main Responsibilities

1. Guest Communication & Reservation Management



You will work daily with platforms such as:



• Airbnb

• 

• VRBO

• Guesty

• Other booking and property-management systems



Responsibilities include:



• Responding quickly and professionally to guest messages

• Handling booking inquiries

• Managing reservation changes and extensions

• Answering guest questions

• Following up on unresolved issues

• Sending and confirming check-in / check-out information

• Monitoring upcoming arrivals and departures

• Assisting guests during their stay

• Handling basic guest complaints

• Escalating serious issues to the Operations Supervisor

• Supporting strong guest satisfaction and review scores



2. Guest Calls & Pre-Arrival Preparation



Phone communication is part of this position.



You will:



• Call guests when required

• Conduct mandatory pre-arrival calls

• Review important property information with guests

• Walk guests through the Guidebook when required

• Confirm check-in expectations

• Make sure guests understand parking, access, house rules, and other important property information



You must be comfortable speaking with guests directly in English.



3. Property Operations



You will help coordinate daily operations across multiple properties.



Responsibilities include:



• Coordinating cleaners

• Coordinating handymen and maintenance providers

• Following up with vendors

• Monitoring turnovers

• Confirming cleaning completion

• Making sure properties are ready before check-in

• Reporting maintenance problems

• Tracking issues until they are resolved

• Coordinating urgent service when necessary

• Maintaining clear communication between guests and service providers



You are expected to follow through until a task is actually completed — not simply send a message and assume it has been handled.



4. Smart Home & Property Technology



You may work with:



• Smart locks

• Access codes

• Cameras

• Ring systems

• Noise monitoring systems

• Smart-home devices

• Digital Guidebooks

• Property-management software



You will be expected to troubleshoot basic operational issues and escalate technical problems when necessary.



5. Payments & Financial Administration



Responsibilities may include:



• Tracking guest payments

• Tracking security deposits

• Assisting with Stripe transactions

• Monitoring OTA payouts

• Tracking outstanding balances

• Helping prepare reimbursement requests

• Collecting documentation for damage claims

• Maintaining financial spreadsheets

• Assisting with invoices and vendor payments

• Preparing basic weekly and monthly reports



Attention to detail is extremely important when working with financial information.



6. Reviews & Guest Experience



You will help maintain the quality of our guest experience by:



• Following up after stays

• Managing review-related tasks

• Identifying recurring guest complaints

• Reporting common operational problems

• Helping prevent negative reviews

• Escalating situations where management involvement is necessary



7. Documentation & Task Management



You will work with systems such as:



• Notion

• Trello

• Google Workspace

• Guesty

• Internal spreadsheets and checklists



Responsibilities include:



• Keeping assigned tasks updated

• Recording important information

• Updating property notes

• Following Company SOPs

• Maintaining clear internal documentation

• Keeping operational records organized



Important information should never exist only inside a WhatsApp conversation or someone's memory.



8. New Property Onboarding



As the portfolio grows, you may assist with launching new properties.



This can include:



• Preparing property information

• Testing check-in instructions

• Testing smart locks

• Preparing Guidebook information

• Helping organize cleaners and vendors

• Updating property-specific documentation

• Reviewing automated messages

• Testing workflows before the first guest arrives



9. Operational Improvement



We want team members who notice problems and communicate them.



You are encouraged to suggest improvements related to:



• Guest communication

• Check-in procedures

• Property instructions

• Cleaning coordination

• Vendor communication

• Internal workflows

• Automation

• Documentation

• Upsells and guest services

• Repeat and direct bookings



You are not expected to redesign the entire business, but we value people who think beyond simply completing a task.



What Success Looks Like



You are performing successfully when:



• Guest messages are handled professionally and on time

• Reservations are properly monitored

• Guests receive correct information before arrival

• Properties are ready before check-in

• Cleaners and vendors are properly coordinated

• Problems are followed through until resolution

• Important issues are escalated quickly

• Documentation stays accurate

• Tasks do not get lost

• Operational mistakes decrease

• Guests consistently receive a high-quality experience



Interview Process



Candidates who meet our requirements will be invited to a video interview.



During the interview, you may be asked to:



• Share your screen

• Demonstrate your experience with Airbnb, Guesty, or another STR platform

• Explain how you handled previous reservations and guest issues

• Discuss situations involving cleaners or maintenance

• Demonstrate your knowledge of STR operations

• Walk us through how you would handle realistic guest situations



We are looking for real hands-on experience, not only theoretical knowledge.



Work Conditions



• Full-time position

• 9-hour shifts

• Remote work

• Hubstaff time tracking required

• Long-term opportunity

• We are hiring 2 Virtual Assistants

• You will work with an experienced Operations Supervisor

• Opportunity to grow as the portfolio expands



Important



This role is best suited for someone who has already worked inside a real Airbnb / STR operation.



If your experience is primarily general customer service, e-commerce, appointment setting, or unrelated VA work, this position may not be a good fit.



If you have real Airbnb / STR experience and understand guest communication, reservations, cleaners, maintenance, and daily property operations, we would like to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please contact me ONLY through WhatsApp.



I do not regularly review applications sent through OnlineJobs or
.



WhatsApp: +1 (213)
Oleg

title: Social Media Clipper Needed — Marketing Agency for Contractors (TikTok/Instagram)
description:
Type: Part-time to start, with potential to move to full-time as workload grows | Remote



Platforms: TikTok, Instagram Reels



About Us:

We're a marketing agency that helps contractors (home services businesses — landscaping, remodeling, roofing, pools, etc.) grow through content and lead generation. Part of our strategy is building our own agency page — real, relatable content that builds trust with contractors before they ever talk to us directly. We're not trying to look like a billboard.



What We Need:

A reliable clipper to turn raw footage into short-form content. Most of our footage comes from on-site interviews with contractors — real conversations filmed in person — plus us talking on camera while on-site, b-roll of job sites and finished projects, and straight talking-head clips. If you're reading this closely, start your application message with the word BLUE as the very first word — it tells us you actually read the whole post instead of skimming. Your job as the clipper is to find the strongest moments in this raw footage and turn them into clips with strong hooks, clean captions, and tight pacing.



This starts as a part-time role, but as we scale our content and add more clients, we're looking to grow this into a full-time position for the right person.



What You'll Be Doing:



Review raw interview and on-site footage

Identify the best hooks and moments — a sharp quote, a surprising stat, a contrarian line, whatever grabs attention in the first 1-2 seconds

Edit with captions, trims, and pacing (CapCut or similar)

Mix in b-roll and talking-head footage as needed

Follow reference accounts/style guides we'll provide



Requirements:



Experience editing short-form content for TikTok/Instagram

Strong sense for finding "the moment" in raw, unstructured footage — matters more than fancy editing

Comfortable with CapCut (or similar)

Good English comprehension

Reliable communication and turnaround



How to Apply:

We're not looking at portfolios alone — we want to see how you work with our actual content. Message us with your experience and rate expectations. We'll send you a short raw footage clip, and you'll edit it into 2-3 short clips (hook + captions) to send back along with your application.

Job Description:



Wise Consulting Enterprise Inc. is a high-volume credit repair and financial consulting company based in Florida serving clients across all 50 states. We are hiring a sharp, proven Sales Closer to take pre-qualified leads and turn them into enrolled clients.



This is not an entry-level role. You will be speaking with people who are tired of getting denied and are ready to fix their credit. Your job is to ask the right questions, uncover the real problem, and close them into the right program. If you already know how to do this, keep reading.

Following up with leads until they enroll or disqualify

Hitting weekly and monthly enrollment targets

Quiet home office, reliable high-speed internet, quality headset

Available full-time during U.S. Eastern business hours

Individuals only. No agencies

Base pay plus commission on every enrollment

Ongoing sales training and a proven closing system

A stable company with room to grow into senior and leadership roles

title: AI Marketing & Paid Lead Generation Specialist
description:
AI Marketing & Paid Lead Generation Specialist



Remote — Philippines | Part-Time or Full-Time | Long-Term



Covered Bridge Brands is an AI marketing and lead-generation company working with local businesses, including our own mortgage company, Valor Home Loans Direct.



We are looking for an exceptional digital marketer and lead-generation specialist who knows how to generate actual leads and customers—not simply create social media posts.



This position is heavily focused on paid advertising, marketing strategy, lead generation, creative testing and customer acquisition.



This is NOT primarily a social media posting job.



We are looking for someone who can take a goal such as:



"Generate 50 qualified first-time-homebuyer leads."



…and independently figure out the strategy, offer, advertising platform, creative, messaging, lead capture and optimization process needed to accomplish it.



You should be comfortable testing ideas, analyzing results, identifying problems and improving campaigns without waiting for someone to tell you every step.



What You'll Be Doing



You may work across several areas of digital marketing, including:



 / Instagram advertising

Meta Ads Manager

Google Ads

YouTube advertising

Lead-generation campaigns

 marketing and cold

Retargeting

Landing-page strategy

Ad copywriting

Offer development

Marketing hooks and creative concepts

Short-form video advertising

Lead-list research and prospecting

Campaign analytics and optimization

AI-assisted marketing and content creation

Developing and testing new lead-generation strategies



You do NOT need to be an expert at every platform.



We would rather hire someone who is exceptionally good at marketing and customer acquisition and can learn new platforms quickly than someone who claims to know 25 platforms but has little evidence of producing results.



The Most Important Requirement: PROVEN RESULTS



We want to see evidence of campaigns you have personally built and managed.



When applying, please provide 1–3 examples of campaigns you personally worked on.



For each campaign, tell us:



What was the business/product?

What was the advertising platform?

What was the campaign objective?

Approximately how much was spent?

How many leads, sales or appointments were generated?

What was the approximate CPL, CPA or cost per appointment?

What was the approximate revenue generated, if known?

What did YOU personally do?

What did you change or optimize?

What was the final result?

IMPORTANT:



If possible, provide screenshots from the advertising platform showing campaign results.



You may blur or remove confidential information.



We are much more interested in seeing actual evidence than hearing that you are "experienced with
 ads."



We Want a Marketer Who Thinks



We don't want someone who simply waits for instructions such as:



"Create a
 ad."



We want someone who asks:



Who are we trying to reach?



What problem are they trying to solve?



What offer would make them respond?



What would make them stop scrolling?



What creative should we test?



Where should the lead go?



How should we follow up?



How will we know whether the lead was actually valuable?



What does the data tell us to change?



Example Assignment



One of our businesses is a mortgage company specializing in first-time homebuyers.



We offer down-payment assistance and help borrowers who may have less-than-perfect credit understand their available options.



Assume we give you a $1,000 monthly advertising budget.



Tell us:



What platform(s) would you use?

What would you advertise?

Give us 3 different advertising angles/hooks.

What type of creative would you use for each?

Write the primary ad copy for one of them.

Where would you send the traffic?

How would you capture the lead?

What would happen immediately after the lead submits?

What metrics would you watch?

How would you determine which ad to scale?

What would you do if you generated inexpensive leads but very few appointments?



We are interested in your thinking, not a perfect answer.



AI Experience



Tell us which AI tools you currently use and exactly how you use them in marketing.



Examples might include:



ChatGPT

Claude

Gemini

AI video tools

AI image tools

AI copywriting tools

AI research tools

AI automation tools



We are particularly interested in someone who uses AI to increase marketing output and improve decision-making, rather than simply using AI to write social media captions.



Tell Us About a Campaign That FAILED



This is important.



Tell us about a marketing or advertising campaign that did not perform as expected.



What happened?



How did you determine what was wrong?



What did you change?



What did you learn?



What We Are Looking For



The ideal person is:



A strong marketer

Highly analytical

Creative

Experienced with paid advertising

Comfortable with numbers and campaign metrics

A strong copywriter

Comfortable testing and experimenting

Able to research independently

Comfortable using AI

Able to learn new platforms quickly

Highly proactive

Results-oriented

Comfortable taking ownership of a goal



Communication and English ability are important.



You will be communicating directly with the business owner and must be able to clearly explain what you are doing and why.



Compensation



We are open to either part-time or full-time depending on the candidate.



Please tell us:



Your preferred number of hours per week

Your hourly rate

Your availability

Your preferred working hours

Whether you are currently working for other clients



We are willing to pay more for someone with demonstrated ability to produce results.

title: Shopify DTC Manager — CRO, Paid Media & Retention (Full-Time Remote)
description:
Read this part first



Most of our revenue comes from marketplaces. That makes our Shopify stores the most under-built, highest-upside part of the business — and it means we are hiring someone to fix that, not to babysit it.



You will own direct-to-consumer ecommerce across  10+ Shopify stores within a portfolio of ~21 brands — about 9 private-label supplement brands we own outright and ~12 exclusive client brands. Conversion rate, site experience, paid acquisition, attribution,
 and SMS, and subscription retention: all of it rolls up to you.



Supplements are a subscription-and-LTV business. If you understand that the second purchase matters more than the first, you are the person we are looking for.



About Brandgate



Brandgate is a South Florida–based brand management company. We own and operate a portfolio of private-label supplement brands, and we act as the exclusive ecommerce partner for a portfolio of client brands.



We have an in-house creative department, a supply chain and logistics team, an AI development function building internal tooling, and dedicated marketplace teams for Amazon and TikTok Shop. You will not be alone on an island — but you will be the person accountable for DTC.



The scope: what you will actually own

1. Conversion rate optimization — the core of the job

Own site conversion rate across every store. Baseline it, set targets, and improve it. This is the number you will be judged on more than any other.

Run a continuous testing program — landing pages, product page layouts, offer framing, bundle and subscription presentation, above-the-fold hierarchy, social proof placement, cart and checkout flow, upsells and post-purchase offers.

Own the Shopify theme and site experience. Page speed, mobile experience (which is most of the traffic), navigation, collection structure, and app bloat. You should be comfortable in theme settings and in Liquid, or willing to get there fast.

Build and maintain high-converting landing pages for paid traffic — advertorials, listicles, quiz funnels, and direct-response PDPs. Tools like Replo, Shogun, PageFly, or GemPages are fine; results are what matter.

Manage the app stack — reviews, subscriptions, upsells, bundles, loyalty. Know what each app costs and whether it earns it.

2. Paid media buying and acquisition

Own paid acquisition across Meta, Google, and TikTok — campaign structure, budget allocation, audience strategy, and creative rotation. Supplement advertising on Meta is a compliance minefield and you need to know how to navigate it without getting accounts restricted.

Set and hit blended ROAS and CAC targets per brand, and understand the difference between platform-reported ROAS and reality.

Run the creative testing program in partnership with our in-house creative department and our UGC/creator pipeline. You brief, they produce, you test, you scale the winners, you kill the rest quickly.

Use AI aggressively — ad copy variants, angle generation, audience research, competitor ad analysis, landing page copy drafting, performance summarization. We provide the tools and expect you to use them to move faster than a team your size should be able to.

3. Tracking and attribution



This is broken at most companies and we would like it not to be broken at ours.



Own the full tracking stack — GA4, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, TikTok Pixel and Events API, Google Ads conversion tracking, server-side tagging where it helps.

Implement and maintain a reliable attribution view — post-purchase surveys, UTM discipline, and a third-party attribution tool if you can justify it. We want to know what is actually driving revenue, not what each platform claims.

Build the reporting that ties ad spend to contribution margin, not just to revenue. Cost of goods, shipping, payment processing, and discounts all belong in the model.

4.
, SMS, and retention

Own the lifecycle program end to end — welcome series, abandoned cart and browse abandonment, post-purchase, replenishment reminders, winback, and VIP flows.

Run the campaign calendar — promotional sends, product launches, educational content, and seasonal pushes, segmented properly rather than blasted to the whole list.

Own list growth — popups, quizzes, lead magnets, and the tradeoff between capture rate and list quality.

Own subscription performance. For supplement brands this is the whole ballgame: subscription opt-in rate, churn rate, average subscription length, and the flows that reduce cancellations. Improving churn by two points is worth more than most ad optimizations you will make.

Own LTV. Repeat purchase rate, time between orders, and average order value. Report on it monthly and have a plan to move it.

5. Cross-channel and cross-functional

Coordinate with the Amazon and TikTok Shop teams on pricing, promotions, and inventory so we are not competing with ourselves or cannibalizing margin.

Work with logistics on shipping rates, delivery promises, and fulfillment SLAs — both of which directly affect conversion.

Work with the creative department on ad creative, site assets, and
 design.

Work with AI development on internal tooling and automation for reporting and campaign management.

Deliver monthly client-facing recaps for the exclusive brands and show up to the daily executive meeting with numbers and recommendations.

Your first 90 days



Days 1–30 — Diagnose. Full audit of every store: conversion funnel with drop-off at each step, site speed, mobile experience, tracking integrity (assume it is broken until you prove otherwise), current paid performance, and the state of the
 and SMS program. Deliver a prioritized fix list with estimated revenue impact.



Days 31–60 — Fix the foundation. Tracking and attribution working and trusted. Core lifecycle flows live and optimized. First CRO tests shipped. Paid restructured against real blended targets. Contribution-margin reporting in place.



Days 61–90 — Scale. A continuous CRO testing cadence running. Paid scaling profitably on proven creative. Subscription opt-in and churn both moving in the right direction. A clear roadmap for the next two quarters.



What we are looking for

Must-haves

3+ years running DTC ecommerce on Shopify, ideally across multiple stores or at an agency.

Hands-on paid media buying experience — Meta at minimum, ideally Google and TikTok too — with a track record you can put actual numbers to.

Demonstrated CRO results. Tell us a conversion rate you took from X to Y, what you tested, and what won. "I redesigned the site" is not an answer.

Strong Klaviyo skills (or a comparable ESP) — flow building, segmentation, deliverability, and the ability to write
s that convert.

Real understanding of tracking and attribution — GA4, pixels, Conversions API, UTM hygiene, server-side tagging.

Comfort in Shopify admin and theme customization. HTML/CSS required, basic Liquid strongly preferred.

Unit economics fluency. You should be able to build a contribution margin model per SKU and tell us what CAC we can afford.

Genuine daily use of AI tools for copy, analysis, research, and reporting.

Excellent written English — client-facing reports and customer-facing copy both come from you.

Reliable high-speed internet, working computer, quiet space for video calls.

Nice-to-haves

Supplements or health and wellness DTC experience — especially subscription models and Meta ad compliance in this category.

Experience with subscription apps (Recharge, Skio, Loop, Stay AI) and hands-on churn reduction work.

Experience with SMS marketing (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS).

Experience with attribution tools (Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros).

Experience with page builders (Replo, Shogun, PageFly, GemPages) and with A/B testing tools.

Direct-response copywriting ability — advertorials, VSLs, long-form sales pages.

Basic design or video editing so you can ship something without waiting in a queue.

Experience with multi-store or agency environments.

Familiarity with ClickUp.

Who this role is NOT for

Someone who calls themselves a "growth marketer" but has never actually built a landing page or fixed a pixel.

Someone who only looks at platform-reported ROAS.

Someone who wants to redesign the site for six weeks instead of running ten tests.

Someone who treats
 as an afterthought. On a supplement brand, retention is the business.

Why work here

Real upside. DTC is underdeveloped here on purpose — we have been focused on marketplaces. The wins available to you are large and obvious.

Full ownership. Site, paid,
, retention, attribution. No one is going to split this role into four and make you wait on the others.

In-house creative team plus a creator pipeline feeding you UGC and ad assets.

AI tooling and a dev team that builds what you ask for.

Performance bonus paid monthly against blended ROAS, contribution margin, and LTV.

Growth path to Head of DTC with a team under you.

Direct access to leadership. Decisions in hours, not weeks.

Compensation and benefits

Base: $2,000 – $3,500 USD/month, based on experience

Performance bonus: up to $1,500 USD/month against blended ROAS, contribution margin, and LTV growth

Reviews: at 6 months and annually

Paid time off: [INSERT: e.g. 15 days PTO + local public holidays]

Tools and training covered: Shopify apps, Klaviyo, page builders, AI subscriptions, and relevant courses or certifications

Long-term, full-time, stable.

How to apply



We read every application. Copy-paste gets skipped. Do all four:



1. Subject line / application title Use exactly: SHOPIFY DTC — [YOUR NAME] — CVR



2. Answer these in writing. Real numbers.



Which Shopify stores have you run, in what category, and at what monthly revenue?

Give us one specific CRO test you ran: the hypothesis, what you changed, the before and after conversion rate, and the sample size.

What monthly ad spend have you personally managed, on which platforms, and at what blended ROAS?

Our tracking is unreliable and Meta is claiming more revenue than Shopify shows. Walk us through exactly how you would diagnose and fix that.

A supplement brand has a 12% subscription opt-in rate and 30% churn after the second shipment. Give us your first five moves, in order of expected impact.

How do you use AI in your DTC work today? One concrete example.

Monthly salary expectation in USD, and start date.



3. Send us proof. Links to three Shopify stores you have worked on, with a one-line description of what you specifically owned on each.



4. Record a 3–5 minute Loom. Pull up one of our brand sites — [INSERT: your store URL] — and give us your honest teardown. Three things you would change first and why. Do not be polite about it. This is the part of the application we read most closely.



Shortlisted candidates get a paid trial task: a full CRO audit of one of our stores with prioritized recommendations. Paid regardless of outcome.



We move fast. Strong applicants hear back within 3 business days.

 and Database Marketing

Join Our Compassionate & Collaborative Team: Full-Time Virtual ParalegalThe Paraclete Law Center, LLC.



Life is too short to start your day with dread. At The Paraclete Law Center, we understand that legal issues can be overwhelming and often create significant stress for our clients. Our firm is committed to easing our client’s  burdens: we thoroughly analyze the complexities of their matters and develop sound, comprehensive strategies to pursue the favorable outcome they deserve so they can move forward with confidence. 



 We guide clients through a transitional time of remarkable growth and transformation, supporting them in a manner consistent with their values using non-adversarial techniques when possible. We are committed to a firm culture where every tea
mber is valued and invested in, working collaboratively, strategically, and creatively to bring cases toward resolution.



We are seeking a highly motivated, dedicated, and experienced Virtual Paralegal to join our growing legal team. This is a full-time, 40-hour per week remote position where you will manage a caseload from inception to closure. This role requires a self-starter with exceptional organizational and communication skills, ready to take initiative with minimal hand-holding. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in Family Law and Probate Litigation.-----Key Responsibilities

Legal Document Preparation: Draft, proofread, and meticulously format a wide range of legal documents and correspondence, including pleadings, motions, discovery requests, affidavits, and agreements, ensuring grammatical accuracy and legal precision.

Case Management & Organization: Manage case files, ensuring all documents are properly filed, and all deadlines are met with 100% accuracy. Maintain and update the firm’s case management system.

Client & Stakeholder Communication: Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, providing regular case updates and ensuring they feel valued and supported. Coordinate with opposing counsel and court personnel as needed.

Research & Case Development: Conduct basic legal research using various databases to compile relevant information. Initiate and follow up on requests for medical/employment records and perform thorough background checks.

Time Management & Billing: LOG ALL TIME CONTEMPORANEOUSLY, providing a clear and precise record of hours spent on each task and case. Log a minimum of 25 hours per week dedicated to paralegal duties.

Administrative Support: Assist with filing, scanning, and organizing legal documents electronically and handle virtual mail and courier deliveries.

Compensation & Benefits





We offer a highly competitive compensation package commensurate with experience, as well as opportunities for ongoing professional development and training. Our tea
mbers also enjoy generous paid time off to ensure a healthy work-life balance.

Qualifications

Experience: Prior experience as a paralegal is required, preferably in family law and probate litigation.

Communication: Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Skills: Strong organizational skills, impeccable attention to detail, and the ability to multitask and manage time effectively in a fast-paced, remote environment.

Mindset: A positive attitude, commitment to exceptional customer service, and the proven ability to work independently and take initiative.

Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and comfortable learning new case management software.

Virtual Setup: Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace.

How to Apply



We are excited to learn more about your qualifications and experience. To help us better understand your suitability for this role, we kindly request that you provide the following two items as part of your application:

Writing Sample: Please submit a recent writing sample (memo, brief, or other document) that showcases your legal research, drafting, and communication skills.

Video Introduction (2-3 minutes): Create a brief video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be an excellent fit for our firm. We are particularly interested in hearing about your:

Motivation: Why you are interested in this position and what attracts you to working in family law and probate litigation.

Relevant Experience: Examples of your organizational skills and how you have managed tasks and deadlines.

Skills & Strengths: Focus on your customer service abilities, time management, and self-motivation.

Problem-Solving: Share an example of a challenging situation you faced professionally and how you resolved it.

Professionalism: Explain how you maintain professionalism and ensure high-quality work in a virtual setting.

We look forward to welcoming a new member to our team who shares our passion for helping families and providing outstanding legal services.

title: Mathematician — Critical Review of an Algebraic Accounting Formalism
description:
We're K3Labs.ai, a US software company. We've built Laoh, an accounting system whose core claim is unusual: the books are provably correct by mathematics rather than by trust. There's a research paper behind it and a pending US patent.



We need someone to attack that claim properly.



This is an adversarial review role. Your job is not to confirm that our math works — it's to find where it doesn't, where the formalism is weaker than we say it is, or where the gap between the mathematical model and real accounting practice hides an assumption we haven't stated.



What you'll do:



Read the algebraic accounting paper closely and independently reconstruct the core arguments

Check definitions, lemmas, and proofs for correctness, circularity, and unstated assumptions

Stress-test the claims: where does the model break down, and under what conditions?

Examine whether the algebraic structure genuinely gives the guarantees we claim, or whether some of the work is being done by implementation rather than by mathematics

Review the cryptographic layer — hash chaining, Merkle period roots, anchoring — for whether the proofs of integrity are as strong as stated

Write up findings clearly enough that a non-mathematician engineer can act on them



Requirements:



Graduate-level background in mathematics. Abstract algebra especially — groups, monoids, homomorphisms, and the ability to read a formal construction and tell whether it holds. A master's or PhD, or a very strong undergraduate record plus evidence of independent work.

Willingness to say "this is wrong" to the person paying you. That's the entire value of the role.

Clear technical writing.

Useful but not required: cryptography (hash functions, Merkle trees, commitment schemes), order theory or category theory, any exposure to formal verification or proof assistants.



On AI tools: use them freely. We use them constantly. The one hard requirement is that you understand every step of the argument yourself and can defend it without the tool in front of you. We will ask you to walk through your reasoning live. Anyone submitting review work they can't personally explain is the failure mode this role exists to prevent.



Accounting background is not required. We'll explain the domain. We'd rather have a real mathematician who has to learn double-entry bookkeeping than an accountant with a rusty math background.



How to apply:



Skip the cover letter. Instead:



Tell me your mathematical background — degree, institution, area of focus, and anything you've worked on that involved checking someone else's proof.

Describe a time you found an error in a published or professional piece of technical work. What was it, and how did you find it?

In a few sentences: given that double-entry bookkeeping requires every transaction's debits and credits to sum to zero, what algebraic structure would you reach for to model a ledger, and what would you have to prove to claim that the books "cannot be silently altered"?



Question 3 is the real screen. I'm not looking for the right answer — I'm looking for how you think about the problem cold.



Shortlisted candidates get paid for a first review pass ($100–150) before any ongoing arrangement.

You won’t be stuck editing the same boring format for the next 5 months, almost every concept has something new which makes the editing process more fun, since you can leverage your creativity & storytelling skills.

title: Cold Caller Trainer | BDR Trainer | New Hire Trainer | Onboarding Specialist
description:
About StoryGen



StoryGen (storygen.agency) is a fast growing B2B lead generation agency that builds and manages outbound sales teams for companies across a range of industries. Cold calling is at the core of what we do, supported by structured processes, modern sales technology, automation, and AI-powered tools.



Strong BDR performance starts with the right foundation. Effective onboarding, hands-on coaching, and consistent feedback help new team members build confidence, sharpen their skills, and become productive faster.



That’s where this role comes in.



About the Role



We’re looking for a BDR / Cold Caller Trainer to take ownership of onboarding, training, and ongoing performance coaching for our Business Development Representatives.



You’ll help new BDRs learn our cold calling process, understand our tools and workflows, strengthen their communication skills, and become confident handling real prospect conversations.



Beyond onboarding, you’ll regularly review calls, identify areas for improvement, provide actionable coaching, and help maintain strong performance standards across the team.



You’ll also work closely with Account Managers and leadership to improve training materials, strengthen our coaching processes, and develop scalable systems as the BDR team continues to grow.



Success in this position means faster ramp-up, stronger call quality, consistent process adoption, and better overall BDR performance.



We’re open to candidates from different backgrounds. Formal training experience is valuable, but it isn’t the only path. Experience leading, mentoring, coaching, facilitating, or helping others improve whether through previous roles, internships, university organizations, or other leadership experiences can also be a strong fit.



What You'll Do



Onboard & Train New BDRs

•Lead onboarding and training sessions for newly hired BDRs

•Teach cold calling fundamentals, scripts, qualification, objection handling, and conversation flow

•Introduce new hires to the tools, systems, and workflows they’ll use every day

•Establish clear expectations around KPIs, activity levels, and quality standards

•Track progress throughout the ramp-up period and provide regular feedback

•Evaluate readiness before BDRs begin independently handling campaigns



Coach BDR Performance

•Review recorded calls and provide clear, actionable feedback

•Coach BDRs on tone, confidence, communication, objection handling, and call execution

•Help team members turn scripts into natural, engaging conversations

•Identify skill gaps and create focused coaching plans

•Support BDRs who need additional guidance to improve consistency and meeting outcomes

•Reinforce strong call quality and performance standards across campaigns



Develop Training Materials

•Create and update onboarding guides, training materials, and internal resources

•Build practical call frameworks, playbooks, and objection-handling guides

•Maintain organized script libraries and training documentation

•Capture successful techniques and turn them into repeatable best practices

•Update training content as our processes, tools, and strategies evolve

•Improve training systems to make onboarding more efficient and scalable



Improve Training & Sales Enablement

•Partner with Account Managers and leadership to strengthen coaching and onboarding

•Identify recurring performance challenges and recommend training solutions

•Help implement AI-assisted call review and coaching tools

•Use feedback and performance trends to improve training programs

•Help standardize training processes as the BDR team expands



What We're Looking For



You don’t necessarily need years of formal training experience. We’re also open to recent graduates and early-career candidates who can demonstrate strong communication, leadership, coaching, mentoring, or facilitation skills through internships, university organizations, volunteer work, or extracurricular activities.



You may be a strong fit if you have:



•Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

•Experience coaching, mentoring, training, or guiding others

•Strong leadership skills, whether formal or informal

•Confident and clear communicator

•The ability to give clear, constructive, and actionable feedback

•A structured and organized approach to training

•A collaborative, team-oriented mindset

•Strong attention to performance and measurable improvement

•Good documentation and training-content creation skills

•A positive and motivating presence while maintaining high standards and accountability

•Experience in cold calling, telesales, BPO training, outbound sales, sales coaching, or BDR/SDR environments is a plus.



Work Schedule

•Full-time

•Monday to Friday

•8:30 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time

•Availability during U.S. business hours is required



Compensation & Benefits

•USD $1,000 monthly base pay + performance incentives

•Fully remote setup

•Opportunity to directly shape and improve StoryGen’s BDR training program

•Meaningful impact on new-hire development and overall team performance

•Exposure to modern sales technology, automation, and AI-powered coaching tools

•Career growth opportunities in Sales Enablement, Training Management, and Performance Management

•Collaborative environment within a growing, technology-driven company



Application Process



To keep our hiring process consistent for every applicant, candidates will be asked to complete an assessment and submit the following through the application link:



•Updated resume

•Internet speed test result

•Short Loom audio recording (Guide questions are provided within the assessment)

title: Short-Term Rental Operations Manager / Supervisor
description:
Short-Term Rental Operations Manager / Supervisor

5+ Years Airbnb / STR Experience Required



We are looking for an experienced Short-Term Rental Operations Manager/Supervisor to lead the operations of a growing STR portfolio.



This is a leadership position.



You will not be hired as a regular Virtual Assistant.



You will manage one Operations VA, oversee systems and processes, maintain operational standards, and help the company grow.



Who We Are Looking For



You should have:



• 5+ years of recent hands-on experience in Airbnb / Short-Term Rental management

• Current STR experience or no gap longer than 6 months

• Previous experience managing or supervising employees

• Strong understanding of Airbnb, 
, VRBO and PMS systems

• Experience with automation and property-management technology

• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Ability to work independently and take responsibility for results



This position is for someone who already understands STR operations.



We are not looking for someone who needs to be taught the basics of Airbnb management.



About the Position



You will be responsible for keeping the company's operations organized, documented, automated, and performing at a high level.



You will directly supervise one Operations VA who handles most daily guest communication and routine operational tasks.



Your role is to make sure the VA, systems, vendors, properties, and internal processes are working correctly.



The owner should not have to constantly check routine operations.



Main Responsibilities

1. Managing the Operations VA



You will:



• Set daily and weekly priorities

• Monitor the VA's work

• Review task completion and quality

• Ensure company SOPs are followed

• Train and coach the VA when necessary

• Identify repeated mistakes and correct them

• Hold the VA accountable for performance

• Ensure important tasks are completed on time



You are responsible for the result of the operations team, not just your personal tasks.



2. Operations Oversight



You will monitor the operational performance of all properties.



This includes:



• Upcoming arrivals and departures

• Property readiness

• Cleaning completion

• Maintenance issues

• Guest escalations

• Refund-related situations

• Damage claims

• Vendor coordination

• Smart access systems

• Operational emergencies



You are expected to identify problems early and make sure they are resolved before they become bigger issues.



3. Documentation & SOPs



A major part of this position is building and maintaining organized company documentation.



You will:



• Create new SOPs

• Update existing SOPs

• Document repeatable processes

• Maintain property-specific instructions

• Build checklists

• Create training documents

• Maintain internal company documentation

• Keep operational information organized and current



We want the business to operate through systems and documentation, not through information stored only in someone's memory.



4. Automation & Technology Management



You will be responsible for monitoring and improving our technology stack.



Depending on the property and process, this may include:



• Guesty / PMS systems

• Airbnb

• 

• VRBO

• Smart locks

• Cameras

• Noise monitoring systems

• Automated guest messaging

• AI tools

• Zapier / Make or similar tools

• Google Workspace

• Notion

• Trello

• Stripe

• Guidebook systems

• Other STR software and integrations



Your responsibility is to make sure automations are working correctly and to continuously identify opportunities to reduce manual work.



5. New Property Onboarding



You will assist with launching new properties.



Responsibilities may include:



• Preparing operational documentation

• Setting up PMS workflows

• Preparing property information

• Setting up automated messages

• Creating check-in / check-out processes

• Preparing Guidebooks

• Coordinating cleaners and service providers

• Testing smart locks and property systems

• Creating property-specific SOPs

• Making sure the property is operationally ready before the first reservation



6. Financial & Business Performance



This is not only an administrative position.



We expect you to understand how operations affect revenue and profit.



You will help:



• Monitor operational expenses

• Reduce avoidable refunds

• Reduce unnecessary costs

• Improve vendor pricing where possible

• Improve operational efficiency

• Increase repeat guests

• Support direct-booking growth

• Improve upsell opportunities

• Monitor property performance

• Help increase company net profit



You should be comfortable working with reports, spreadsheets, and basic financial performance metrics.



7. Process Improvement



We expect you to continuously look for ways to improve the business.



Examples:



• Better automation

• Better reporting

• Better team organization

• Faster workflows

• Better vendor systems

• Better documentation

• Reduced manual work

• Reduced mistakes

• Improved profitability

• Easier property onboarding



We are looking for someone who sees a problem and thinks:



“How can we build a system so this problem does not happen again?”



What Success Looks Like



You are successful in this role when:



• The VA works independently and consistently

• SOPs are complete and updated

• Operational mistakes decrease

• Automations work reliably

• New properties launch smoothly

• Problems are identified before the owner has to find them

• Operational costs are controlled

• Direct bookings and profitability improve

• The company becomes less dependent on owner involvement



Interview Process



Candidates who meet our requirements will be invited to a video interview.



During the interview, you may be asked to:



• Share your screen

• Demonstrate STR platforms you have worked with

• Explain your previous responsibilities

• Show examples of systems or workflows you managed

• Explain how you supervised employees

• Discuss automation tools you have used

• Walk us through how you would solve real STR operational situations



Please be prepared to demonstrate real experience.



Work Conditions



• Full-time position

• 9-hour workday

• Long-term opportunity

• Hubstaff time tracking

• Remote position

• Direct communication with company management

• Opportunity to grow together with the portfolio



Important



We are looking for someone with real STR management experience, not someone who only handled guest messages.



If your background is primarily customer support or basic VA work, this position will probably not be a fit.



If you have managed STR operations, people, systems, automations, and property performance, we would like to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please contact me ONLY through WhatsApp.



I do not regularly review applications sent through OnlineJobs or
.



WhatsApp: +1 (213)

title: FREELANCE APPAREL DESIGNER & PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT ASSISTANT
description:
Remote – Philippines | Project-Based | Potential Ongoing Work



I am looking for an experienced Apparel/Fashion Designer to work with me on a project-by-project basis for my New Zealand clothing brand.



I create many of my own concepts using AI, images, sketches, photographs and creative direction. I need someone who can take what I have created and professionally recreate, refine and prepare it so that the finished product is ready for printing or manufacturing.



HOW I LIKE TO WORK



An important part of this role is being comfortable working with me live through AnyDesk or screen sharing when required.



Rather than going backwards and forwards with multiple messages and revisions, I would sometimes like us to work on the design together in real time.



For example, while you are working in Illustrator or Photoshop, I may ask you to:



Move an element

Change its size or placement

Remove part of a pattern

Adjust a colour

Change the shape of something

Separate an artwork element

Try the design on a different garment

Make the print larger or smaller

Make small changes until the design looks right



This allows us to make decisions on the spot, so you understand exactly what I am trying to achieve rather than having to guess my creative direction.



You therefore need to be comfortable communicating in English and working collaboratively through AnyDesk/screen sharing when needed.



PAYMENT



NZ$30 per completed design/piece – all inclusive.



This is freelance/project-based work, not an hourly position. There are no guaranteed weekly hours. I will provide projects as I need them.



Depending on the project, the NZ$30 includes:



Recreating/refining my AI-generated concept or artwork

Reasonable live adjustments through AnyDesk/screen sharing

Design revisions required to achieve the agreed concept

Cleaning and refining artwork

Vectorising artwork where required

Separating design elements where required

Colourways/colour adjustments

High-resolution transparent PNG

Print-ready/vector files

Editable/source files

Garment mockup

Correct print placement and dimensions

Technical flats where required

Complete manufacturer-ready tech pack where required

Fabric, trim, label and construction specifications where applicable

Final files organised and ready to send directly to my printer or overseas manufacturer



The goal is that when a piece is completed, I should not need another designer to finish or prepare it for production.



ADDITIONAL PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT



I would also prefer someone who has experience with, or can assist me with:



Clothing and garment sourcing

Finding suitable manufacturers

Ordering and developing samples

Fabric and trim sourcing

Communicating specifications to overseas manufacturers

Reviewing samples against our tech packs

Making production amendments

Preparing designs for embroidery, DTF, screen printing and sublimation



Larger sourcing or product-development projects can be discussed separately.



SKILLS I'M LOOKING FOR



You should have genuine experience in apparel/fashion design and production, not simply Canva or social-media graphic design.



Experience with the following is preferred:



Adobe Illustrator • Adobe Photoshop • Vector Artwork • Apparel Graphics • Tech Packs • Technical Flats • Garment Mockups • Print-Ready Artwork • Clothing Manufacturing



CLO 3D or similar garment-design experience would be an advantage.



TO APPLY



Please send:



Your apparel/fashion design portfolio

T-shirt or clothing designs you have personally created

Examples of vector/print-ready artwork

At least one tech pack you have personally created

Examples of technical flats or garment mockups

Examples of garments that have actually been manufactured from your designs, if available

Your experience working with clothing manufacturers

Confirmation that you are comfortable working via AnyDesk/screen sharing with me when required

Confirmation that you accept NZ$30 per completed design/piece

Your normal turnaround time



I would initially like to trial working together on individual projects.



If we work well together and you understand my design style and creative direction, there is potential for regular ongoing projects.

title: Admin Assistant / List Building Specialist

About the Role

Behind every successful outbound campaign is a high-quality contact list, and that’s where you come in.



As our List Building Specialist, you’ll be responsible for researching, validating, and maintaining prospect lists that fuel our outbound campaigns. This isn’t a basic data-entry job. We’re looking for someone technical, detail-oriented, and AI-savvy, someone who can combine deep research with automation and AI tools to deliver accurate, scalable data.



You’ll manage enrichment workflows, set up API integrations in Clay, and ensure finalized lists are ready for our BDRs. Your work directly impacts campaign performance and client success.



Key Responsibilities

- Prospect Research: Build targeted prospect lists aligned with each client’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

- AI-Powered Validation: Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Llama, Perplexity) to check whether contacts and companies meet ICP requirements through prompt-based validation.

- Technical Integrations: Set up and manage API connections within Clay and other enrichment platforms to expand data coverage.

- Database Management: Maintain and update contact databases in Supabase and HubSpot, ensuring accuracy, deduplication, and clean record-keeping.

- ICP Alignment: Work closely with Account Managers to refine targeting criteria and ensure list quality supports campaign goals.

- Quality Control: Verify accuracy, eliminate duplicates, and ensure lists meet agency standards.

- Self-Sufficiency: Learn new tools quickly and troubleshoot technical issues independently.



What We’re Looking For

- At least 1 year of experience in list building, lead research, or data enrichment (B2B sales/lead gen experience preferred).

- Strong technical ability — able to set up API integrations and troubleshoot workflows in tools like Clay.

- Highly interested with AI tools and eager to adopt new AI-driven workflows.

- Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar tools.

- Proficiency in managing and maintaining databases in Supabase and HubSpot.

- Strong spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets, Excel).

- Sharp attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

- Quick learner, independent, and resourceful — able to deliver without heavy oversight.

- Previous experience with enrichment tools (Forager, Prospeo, ContactOut, IcyPeas) is highly preferred.



Compensation & Benefits

- USD 1,000 to 1,200 starting monthly compensation depending on proven experience.

- Accelerated opportunities for pay increase once you’ve mastered the entire process and can function independently.

- Exposure to advanced AI and automation workflows.

- 100% remote position.

title: Business Systems Implementation Specialist
description:
If you're the person people hand a messy project to and say, “Here’s the outcome we need — figure out how to make it happen,” keep reading.



PestLaunch helps pest control companies across the U.S. grow and operate better. We work with owners to identify what needs to change in their business, then we actually help build and implement it.



We're hiring a Business Systems Implementation Specialist to own that implementation.



This is a hands-on role. You won't just create project plans, write recommendations, or tell other people what to do. You'll work directly inside our clients' CRMs, spreadsheets, software, financial data, workflows, scripts, and processes to get things built, launched, and working correctly.





What You'll Own



You'll be handed an approved outcome such as:

- Roll out a price increases for clients

- Build and launch a standardized sales process

- Clean up and implement a collections process

- Build office roles, responsibilities, and accountability systems

- Set up KPI tracking and reporting

- Build customer retention or cancellation processes

- Customize and implement SOPs

- Configure CRM workflows and automations

- Audit customer or financial data

- Build hiring, onboarding, or training systems



Your job is to take that outcome and make it real.





That means:



1. Build the plan - Determine the steps, dependencies, owners, deadlines, QA, and definition of done.



2. Do the work - Get inside the systems. Build the spreadsheet. Configure the CRM. Clean the data. Customize the SOP. Create the tracker. Set up the workflow. Test the automation.



3. Coordinate what you can't do yourself - Get what you need from our team or the client without allowing the project to stall.



4. QA everything - Catch errors before the client does. Test your work and verify that what was supposed to happen actually happened.



5. Finish the implementation - A document being created does not mean the project is done. It's done when the system is live, working correctly, being used, and the intended outcome has been achieved.





Requirements



We're looking for someone with real hands-on implementation experience, not just project coordination or process documentation.



You should have:



- 3+ years of relevant experience in business operations, systems implementation, CRM implementation, technical operations, project implementation, or a similar role

- Experience working with U.S.-based businesses, ideally small businesses, service businesses, agencies, or field-service companies

- Strong hands-on experience with CRMs and business software

- Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills and confidence working with large sets of customer or operational data

- Experience personally building or implementing things like workflows, automations, dashboards, trackers, SOPs, CRM processes, or operational systems

- Experience owning projects from assignment through launch and verification, not just completing one piece of a larger project

- Strong written and spoken English

- Ability to work full-time during U.S. Mountain Time business hours

- Reliable computer and internet connection suitable for full-time remote work



Experience with home services, pest control, field-service software, QuickBooks, GoHighLevel, Zapier, or 
 is a plus, but not required.





The Person We're Looking For



You're resourceful. When you don't know how to do something, your first instinct is to figure it out.

You're highly detail-oriented and naturally check your own work.

You can take an outcome with limited instructions and determine the steps required to accomplish it.

You move quickly without getting sloppy.

You're comfortable learning unfamiliar software and getting into the weeds.

You communicate early when something is blocked and bring possible solutions with you.

Most importantly, you take ownership of the result — not just your assigned tasks.





This Role Is Not



This is not a consulting role where you spend your time diagnosing what the business should do.

It's not a traditional project-management role where you create tasks and wait for other people to execute them.

It's not an SOP-writing role where success means producing documentation.

And it's not a VA role where you'll receive detailed step-by-step instructions for every project.

We determine what needs to happen. You own figuring out how to implement it and getting it completely done.





Tools You May Work In



Depending on the client:

- FieldRoutes and other field-service CRMs

- GoHighLevel

- QuickBooks Online

- Google Sheets / Excel

- Google Docs

- Slack

- 

- Zapier / automation tools

- Other client software



You do not need experience with every tool. You do need to be the kind of person who can learn a new system quickly and confidently work inside it.





What Great Looks Like



Within a few months, we should be able to hand you an approved client project and know: You will build the plan, execute the work, manage the dependencies, catch the mistakes, launch it, verify it worked, and close the loop — without us having to manage you through every step.





How to Apply



Please submit your application along with a 5 minute Loom video answering the questions below.



1. Why do you think you'd be exceptional in this role? Give us the short version of your background and the experience most relevant to hands-on systems implementation.



2. Tell us about one system or process you personally built and implemented. What was the problem? What did you personally build or change? How did you implement it? What was the result?



3. Show us something you've actually built. This could be a CRM workflow, automation, spreadsheet, dashboard, SOP, project tracker, process, or another operational system. Walk us through what you personally created and how it was used.





Important: We're much more interested in what you've actually done than a polished presentation. Please don't just tell us you're organized, detail-oriented, or good at systems. Show us evidence.



Include your Loom link with your application. Applications without a Loom submission will not be considered.

title: Experienced Funding Manager — Business Funding
description:
**Experienced Funding Manager & Appointment Setter — Business Funding**



We are hiring an experienced **Funding Manager & Appointment Setter** to qualify leads, book consultations, manage client files, build funding strategies, and guide clients through business funding applications.



This is a combined role. You must be comfortable following up with prospects and booking qualified appointments while managing active clients through the funding process.



This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who already understands credit repair, funding applications, lender requirements, and client communication.



Our company helps entrepreneurs and business owners improve their credit profiles and secure funding. We’re looking for someone who can keep leads and client files moving professionally, accurately, and efficiently.



**Responsibilities**



**Appointment Setting & Lead Follow-Up**



* Contact leads through calls, texts,
s, and approved messaging channels.

* Qualify prospects based on funding needs, credit profile, business history, and readiness to move forward.

* Explain our services clearly without promising approvals or specific funding amounts.

* Book qualified consultations on our team’s calendar.

* Send appointment confirmations and reminders.

* Follow up with unresponsive leads, missed appointments, and prospects who need more time.

* Answer common questions and handle initial objections professionally.

* Keep accurate notes, lead statuses, and follow-up tasks in our CRM.

* Work toward agreed goals for outreach, qualified appointments, and attendance.



**Funding Management & Client Support**



* Review client credit reports and assess funding readiness.

* Understand how utilization, inquiries, late payments, collections, charge-offs, and tradelines affect funding options.

* Help create funding plans based on credit, income, business profile, banking history, and lender requirements.

* Identify credit issues that need attention before applying.

* Collect and organize client documents.

* Prepare clients for applications and explain next steps.

* Assist with or submit funding applications where permitted, using proper client authorization and accurate information.

* Communicate with clients, banks, lenders, and funding partners.

* Track approvals, denials, pending applications, conditions, and funding amounts.

* Update client records and application statuses in our CRM.

* Follow up consistently on missing documents and outstanding requirements.

* Help improve our appointment-setting and funding processes.



**Required Experience**



You must already have experience with:



* Appointment setting, lead qualification, and prospect follow-up.

* Speaking with prospects by phone and handling common objections.

* Credit repair and credit report review.

* Business funding and personal credit-based funding.

* Credit card funding, business credit cards, and lines of credit.

* Funding applications and client file management.

* CRM systems, calendar scheduling, and application tracking.

* Bank or lender communication.

* Working remotely and handling sensitive financial information securely.



Experience with 0% APR funding, business credit building, underwriting, or funding broker operations is a major plus.



**Important Requirements**



We are looking for someone who is:



* Confident and professional on the phone.

* Clear and responsive in written communication.

* Organized enough to balance lead follow-up with active funding files.

* Detail-oriented when reviewing documents and applications.

* Reliable with daily outreach, reminders, and client updates.

* Comfortable following scripts, checklists, and established workflows.

* Able to explain funding steps clearly.

* Honest, professional, and accountable.



You must handle client information securely and complete applications only with proper consent and accurate information. False information, misleading promises, and questionable tactics are not acceptable.



**Compensation & Schedule**



* **Pay:** $5–$8 per hour, depending on experience.

* **Additional compensation:** Commission/bonus per successful funding file.

* **Position type:** Part-time to full-time.

* **Location:** Remote.

* **Start date:** ASAP.



This can grow into a long-term role for the right person.



**To Apply**



Please answer these five questions:



1. Briefly describe your experience with credit repair, business funding, and appointment setting.

2. What funding products have you helped clients get approved for, and what was your role in the application process?

3. How do you qualify leads, book appointments, and follow up with prospects who don’t respond?

4. What tools or systems have you used to manage leads and active client funding files?

5. What is your availability, time zone, and requested hourly rate? Are you comfortable with $5–$8/hour plus commission/bonuses per successful funding file?



**Ideal Candidate**



The ideal candidate has worked for a credit repair company, funding company, funding broker, or financial services business and has hands-on experience with both appointment setting and funding operations.



You can turn an inquiry into a qualified appointment, maintain consistent follow-up, and help clients move from credit review to funding strategy, applications, and decisions.



We want someone who can come in ready, follow our process, communicate well, and help us book more qualified appointments and complete more funding files.

title: Real Estate Operations & Community Assistant
description:
I run a U.S.-based real estate wholesaling business and an online community where I help people learn wholesaling and work through real deals.



I'm looking for a part-time assistant who can work directly with me and take ownership of several things that are currently taking up too much of my day.



One of your main responsibilities will be reviewing and comping properties submitted by members of my Skool community. You should be comfortable looking at comparable sales, determining a realistic property value, reviewing the numbers of a potential wholesale deal, and identifying whether or not an opportunity makes sense.



You'll also help manage my Skool community. This will include checking the community every day, engaging with members, answering basic questions, occasionally creating posts, and helping keep the group active.



An important part of this will be turning deal submissions into educational content for the community. For example, you may review a submitted property, comp it, gather relevant property photos and information, and create a simple post explaining the deal and why it does or doesn't make sense. I want members to be able to learn from the deals being submitted.



Outside of that, you'll work directly with me on a variety of smaller day-to-day tasks that come up throughout the real estate business. This could include updating information in the CRM, checking on something for a deal, organizing information, following up on an outstanding item, doing basic research, or handling another task that I would otherwise have to stop what I'm doing to complete.



I'm looking for someone who is:



Familiar with U.S. real estate wholesaling

Experienced with comping residential properties

Organized and able to keep track of multiple small tasks

A strong written communicator

Comfortable interacting with and helping community members

Proactive and able to figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions every time

Reliable and responsive during our overlapping work hours



Experience with transaction coordination is a big plus, as there is an opportunity for this role to eventually help manage transactions after properties go under contract.



This will start at approximately 10 hours per week. I am looking for someone who can generally be available between 12 PM and 5 PM Pacific Time so that our schedules overlap and I can communicate with you throughout the day.



This is a long-term growth position. If you're great at the role and continue taking things off my plate, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility and grow your hours with the business.



When applying, please tell me about your experience with U.S. real estate wholesaling, comping properties, community management, and transaction coordination. Please also include the tools you've used and your normal working hours in Pacific Time.

title: Canva Template Editor — Daily Flyer & Marketing Material Updates (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Hi, I'm Joey. 



I run a small US-based lead generation company. 



We build marketing materials for local home service contractors, and I need one reliable person to handle the day-to-day production.



The work itself is simple. I already have the Canva templates built. 



Your job is to open them, swap in the correct information for each business — company name, phone number, service area, offer details, contact info — export them, and organize them. 



Then once a week you send me the finished batch.



That's it. 



No design from scratch. No copywriting. No sales. 



If you can follow instructions carefully and you don't make careless mistakes, you will do well here.



What you'll do every day:



• Open assigned Canva templates and update them with the specific details I provide

• Keep text inside the layout — resize and adjust so nothing overflows, overlaps, or looks off

• Export finished files as PNG and PDF at the correct sizes

• Save everything into the right Google Drive folder using the naming format I give you

• Send me one organized batch every Friday with a short summary of what was completed



What I need from you:



• Solid working knowledge of Canva (you should be comfortable with text boxes, elements, resizing, brand colors, and exporting)

• Very strong attention to detail — a wrong phone number on a flyer is a real problem for me

• Good written English, enough to understand instructions and ask a clear question when something isn't obvious

• Reliable internet and a computer that runs Canva without lagging

• Available at least 4 hours per day, Monday through Friday

• You check messages and respond the same day



Nice to have but not required:



• Google Drive / Google Sheets experience

• Any exposure to home services, contractors, or local marketing

• Basic photo editing



Why you'd want this job:



This is repetitive, predictable work with no surprises. 

Same task, every day. 

If you're dependable, this is a long-term position with a pay review at 60 days and more hours available as we grow. 

I pay on time, every time, twice a month.



How to apply — read carefully:



Applications that skip these steps get deleted without a reply.



• Start your message with the words green flamingo so I know you actually read this

• In 2–3 sentences, describe one Canva project you've done and what you had to change or update in it

• Attach or link 2–3 samples of Canva work you've produced (flyers, social posts, or similar)

• Tell me your typical hours of availability in Philippine time

• Answer this: If I send you a template and one of the details I gave you is clearly wrong — for example a phone number with too few digits — what do you do?



I read every application that follows these steps. Thanks for your time.

This is not a traditional caretaker CFO or advisory role. Experience managing finance across multiple brands, locations, or business units

Client-facing advisory or consulting experience

Experience building finance teams that can operate independently without constant executive intervention

See finance as a business decision-making tool, not just a compliance function

Are comfortable being both a strategic leader and hands-on operator
