title: PERSONAL ASSISTANT + CUSTOMER SUPPORT — FLEXIBLE HOURS, 7 DAYS, DAYTIME, LONG-TERM SEAT
description:
PERSONAL ASSISTANT + CUSTOMER SUPPORT — FLEXIBLE HOURS, 7 DAYS, DAYTIME, LONG-TERM SEAT

Read this entire post before applying. If you skim it, you will fail in the first five seconds and we will both have wasted our time. That is not a threat — it's a favor. This job is not for most people, and I'd rather you find that out now.





WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

I run several e-commerce brands. I need one person beside me who handles the things I should not be handling myself.



Two halves:



Half one — customer support. You own the inbox. Order questions, delivery questions, refunds, returns, angry people, confused people, people who ordered the wrong size. You answer them in clear English, politely, fast, and you follow the written procedures we hand you. When you hit something the procedures don't cover, you ask me instead of guessing.



Half two — everything else. This is the honest part. I do not have a clean list of tasks for you. Some of what you'll do:



Chasing suppliers and shipping companies for answers.

Finding information I need and putting it somewhere I can read it in one minute.

Data entry. Spreadsheets. Renaming files. Moving things from one place to another.

Signing up for things, filling in forms, dealing with a support chat for three hours so I don't have to.

Checking whether something on a website is broken and telling me exactly what you saw.

Reminding me of things I said I'd do and did not do.

Small research jobs: prices, competitors, which tool does X, what's this company's phone number.



Some days this work is interesting. Most days it is not. It is the boring, unglamorous, absolutely necessary work that keeps a business from falling over. If that sounds beneath you, stop reading — no hard feelings.





WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT, IN THIS EXACT ORDER

You answer. When I message you during your hours, you reply. Not in four hours. Not tomorrow.

You finish what you start. A task you took is a task that comes back done, or comes back with a question. Never silence.

You stay. I am hiring a person for years, not renting one for two months.

You can be trusted with real things. Accounts, customers, money-adjacent decisions. I need to stop double-checking you by month two.

Your skills. Yes, fifth.



Notice where skill sits on that list. That is deliberate. I can teach you our systems, our tone, our procedures, our tools — and the person who reads carefully enough to type "lussekatt" as the first word in the title when applying is already showing me the exact trait I'm hiring for. It is not part of the title structure below; it goes before it. What I cannot teach is judgment, honesty, and being the kind of person who says "I made a mistake" the same day it happened instead of hoping nobody notices.



I would rather hire a good person with average skills than a skilled person I have to manage. This is my personal assistant seat. Character is the job requirement. Everything else is training.





HOURS — READ THIS TWICE, IT'S THE UNUSUAL PART

There is no fixed schedule. There is no minimum and no maximum.



Some days I need 2 hours from you. Some days I need 10. Most days land somewhere in between. I do not know in advance which day will be which — that's the nature of the work.



What I need in return for that flexibility is this: you book your working day to me. Seven days a week, you are reachable and ready inside a window we agree on — roughly 09:00–18:00 Philippine time. If I only have 3 hours of work that day, you work 3 hours and the rest of your day is yours. If a launch blows up and I need 10, you're there.



Yes, seven. Including Sunday. I'm saying it plainly because it's the thing most people will walk away over, and I'd rather they walk away now than in month two. Customers
 on Sundays and orders go wrong on Sundays. Sunday is usually the lightest day of the week — often an hour or two of inbox and nothing else — but it is not a day where I can't reach you.



That means: this is not a job you stack on top of two other clients. The availability IS the product. You cannot be available for me and also promised to somebody else in the same window.



No graveyard shift. No 2am calls. I start my own day very early, so I'm online through most of your working day.

You keep your regular Philippine holidays. Tell me in advance, that's all.

Need a day off for a wedding, a funeral, a doctor, a family thing? Tell me a few days ahead and it's a yes. I'm asking you to be dependable, not to be a machine. What I can't work with is finding out you're gone on the morning it happens.



Over a normal month this lands around full-time hours. Some months more, some less. Which is exactly why I pay the way I pay:





PAY — READ THIS PART SLOWLY

Hourly, with a guaranteed floor. I'm not going to ask you to hold your whole day open and then pay you nothing when I happen to be quiet.



$3.50 USD per hour, for every hour you work.

Guaranteed floor of $350 USD per month. That's 100 hours paid whether or not I send you 100 hours of work. If I go quiet, that's my problem, not your rent.

Paid twice a month, on time, every time. We have never missed a payment and we never will.



In a normal month you'll work 150–200 hours, which is $525–$700. A heavy launch month is more. There is no cap.



On top of that:



$40 USD responsiveness bonus, every month where you answered inside your hours every single working day. This is the easiest money in the job and it is entirely in your control.

$40 USD ownership bonus, in any month where you spotted and fixed something I never asked you to look at. I d
 this one, and I'd rather pay it than not.



Your first raise comes after ONE month. Not six. Not "we'll see." One month.



The raise ladder, in writing:



When                Hourly rate    A ~170-hour month, with bonuses

Start               $3.50          ~$595–675

After 1 month       $3.75          ~$640–720

After 3 months      $4.00          ~$680–760

After 6 months      $4.35          ~$740–820



Every step is automatic as long as you're still doing the job. It goes into your agreement on day one. You will never have to ask me for a raise, and I will never "forget."



I put the first raise at one month on purpose. Most employers dangle a raise at six months and half of them never pay it. I'd rather prove to you inside four weeks that when you deliver, the number actually moves — and then keep proving it.



How hours are tracked: you log them honestly, in a simple shared sheet, on the day you work them. I am not going to install spyware on your computer and I am not going to count your mouse clicks. In exchange, I need the number in that sheet to be true. If that trust ever breaks, the job ends the same day. That is the only hard rule in this entire post.





WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

Please save us both the time. Do not apply if:



You cannot be reachable seven days a week, Sunday included.

You have other clients in the same hours and this would be "one of them."

You need a predictable 9-to-5 with a fixed task list to feel secure.

You go quiet when you're stuck, embarrassed, or behind.

Boring repetitive work makes you resentful.

Your English is not comfortable enough to write to an upset customer without me rewriting it.

Your internet is unreliable and you have no backup connection.

You have no plan for brownouts or power cuts.

You want to negotiate the rate upward before you've worked a single month.

You are looking for a placeholder while you search for something better.

You want to grow into a marketing or creative role. That's not this seat.



I'm not being harsh for fun. I've hired before and lost good people because they wanted a different job than the one I actually had. This time I'm describing it exactly.





HOW TO APPLY — THIS IS THE FIRST TEST

Ninety percent of applicants will get this wrong. That's the point.



1. Subject line, formatted EXACTLY like this:



[codeword] | [hours you could work on a heavy day] | [how soon you can start] | [your written English, 1-10] | [your spoken English, 1-10] | [your download speed from speedtest.net]



Example: XXXXXX | 10 | 3 days | 8 | 7 | 45mbps



The codeword is written somewhere in this post. I'm not telling you where. If you actually read the whole thing, you already have it.



Wrong format, missing codeword, missing a field — deleted unread. No exceptions, no second chances.



2. Your message must contain these six things, in this order, and nothing else:



Line 1 — The most boring, annoying or tedious task you have ever done for an employer or client. What was it, how long did it go on, and how did you feel about it. Be honest. "I love all tasks equally" is a failed answer.



Your setup — Computer and specs. Internet provider and speed. Backup internet. What you do when the power goes out. Be specific and boring. "I have good internet" is a failed answer.



Longevity — The longest you have ever stayed in one role or with one client. How long, and why it ended. A short history with an honest reason beats an inflated one.



The customer test — A customer writes: "This is the THIRD time I'm
ing you. My order was supposed to arrive 9 days ago, there's no tracking update, and nobody answers. I want my money back NOW." Write your actual reply. 40–60 words. Don't explain what you'd do — write the
.



Two honest answers — (a) Tell me about a time you were stuck on a task and didn't know what to do. What did you do in the first 30 minutes? (b) What would make you quit this job? Everyone has a breaking point. I trust the person who names it far more than the person who says "nothing."



Last line — A link to a voice recording of yourself, 60 seconds, unscripted, answering one question: what did you do yesterday, from when you woke up until you went to bed. Loom, Google Drive, WhatsApp voice note, anything I can open. No script, no retakes — I am listening to how you talk, not what you did.



Do not attach a generic CV. It will not be read.





THE THREE STAGES

Stage 1 — The application above. Takes 20 minutes if you're serious. Most people won't do it.



Stage 2 — The real-day test. Unpaid, about 2 hours of work, 24 hours to deliver. I send you three things: a few real customer
s to answer, one small research job, and one deliberately boring task. One of them will have instructions that are missing a detail on purpose. I am not grading beauty. I am grading: did you follow instructions exactly, did you deliver on time, and did you ASK about the missing piece instead of guessing. This is an honest preview of the daily job.



Stage 3 — Paid trial week. Real work, real access, real feedback, paid at the full rate. This is where the seat is won.





WHAT YOU GET IF YOU WIN IT

One employer. Daytime hours. Real flexibility on the days it's quiet, and a guaranteed floor so quiet days never cost you money. Paid twice a month, on time, without ever having to ask. A raise on a schedule, not on a whim — the first one after four weeks. Direct feedback from someone who will tell you exactly what's wrong so you can fix it and get better fast. And over time: more trust, more responsibility, and a real seat in a business that is growing.



If you're the kind of person who wants one place to belong, work that actually matters to someone, and to be paid reliably for being dependable — this is that.



Show me you can follow instructions. That's the whole first test.

description:
We’re looking for an Administrative Agent to help support our sales and recruiting teams. This is an entry-level position that is eligible for promotion after 12 months of tenure.



***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********

***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********

***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********



You will fail the application process if you don't read the entire job description.



***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********

***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********

***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********





About Us



Started in 2017, and we're growing like crazy.

We expect to hire at least 4 salespeople, 3 admins, and 3 marketers in 2026.

Growing FAST - We sold 2663 lessons in 2025, and we're on pace to sell 3328 lessons in 2026.

A small team of 1 American and 10 Filipinos.

We sell manual transmission driving lessons in the United States. Yes, really.

100% inbound leads from Organic Search (SEO). We don’t do cold calling.

No competition - in 90% of the markets we serve, we have no competitors. Because of this, our sale is pretty easy to make.





Type of Employment

Full Time

40 hours per week

Schedule - 9 AM to 5 PM EST





Compensation and Benefits

Competitive commission package - $4.00 per hour



Benefits to be provided after completion of 3 months:

Health Insurance





Entry Level Details

Note that this is an entry-level job.

We do NOT expect you to have any prior admin experience.

If you’re looking to switch careers and get your foot in the door, this could be great for you.

This is a great opportunity for anyone with a background in any of the following areas: Customer Service, VA Admin, Admin Data Processing, Clerk,
 Communications, General VA, Admin Support, Sales and Admin Specialist, Administrative Support, Operations Admin, Executive Admin Assistant, Sales Assistant.





Duties and Responsibilities

New Orders - Processing Product Order (Gift Certificate)

New Orders - Initial Order Confirmation (Level 3)

Instructor Onboarding, Offboarding and Reonboarding

Reactivate Unavailable Instructor

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINK ELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

Duplicate Record Check

Updating the "Daily Tracking" Process

CTM Prospect Staging





Qualifications

At least 2-3 years of minimum work experience in a relevant or equivalent role

Comprehensive background in Customer and Administrative support

High level of accuracy and attention to detail

Excellent English communication and comprehension

Proficiency in using and managing Google applications - Gmail, Calendar, Documents, Drive

Preferably with knowledge in using cloud-based CRM

Organized and has careful attention to detail

Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively

Strong Problem-Solving skills

Customer Service Oriented and the ability to adapt/respond properly to different types of scenarios

Equipped with good skills in office/admin management, and can suggest process improvements

Must have your own computer, reliable high-speed internet, and a good quality headset and microphone.





What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: Marketing manager
description:
I’ve updated the role to distinguish the two service areas clearly and added TikTok account, content and TikTok Shop development as a substantial responsibility.



MARKETING MANAGER – SHORT-LET, HOSPITALITY & E-COMMERCE



Location: Remote, with a strong focus on the North West England market

Role type: Part-time contract position, with potential to grow

Company: Turnkey Linen Hire



ABOUT TURNKEY LINEN HIRE



Turnkey Linen Hire provides professionally laundered, hotel-quality linen and towels to Airbnb hosts, serviced-accommodation operators, property managers and other accommodation providers.



Our linen hire and delivery service is available throughout North West England.



We also provide changeover cleaning and consumables support. Our cleaning service is currently available within Greater Manchester only.



Linen hire is our lead service. Our core proposition is that hiring professionally managed linen can be more cost-effective, consistent and scalable than purchasing, washing, storing, replacing and managing linen in-house.



Alongside growing our established business-to-business services, we are exploring a future direct-to-consumer market for hotel-quality linen for the home. We want the successful candidate to establish Turnkey on TikTok and help us assess, develop and potentially launch a TikTok Shop for this new market.



THE PURPOSE OF THE ROLE



This is not a basic social-media scheduling or website-maintenance position.



We are looking for an experienced, commercially focused and hands-on Marketing Manager who can take ownership of Turnkey’s marketing and turn our existing business, brand, website and services into measurable growth.



The successful candidate will be expected to develop the strategy, create the content, manage the channels, build relationships with potential customers, monitor performance and clearly explain what is working and what needs to change.



Marketing success will be measured by qualified enquiries, commercial relationships, quotation requests, bookings and revenue opportunities—not simply follower numbers, impressions or the number of posts published.



OUR MARKETS



Our established B2B target customers include:



* Airbnb and short-let hosts

* Serviced-accommodation operators

* Property-management companies

* Multi-property hosts and landlords

* Letting agents managing short-term accommodation

* Holiday-let operators

* Hotels and other accommodation providers

* Businesses requiring reliable linen hire and laundry support



Our developing consumer market will include:



* Consumers wanting hotel-quality linen and towels for their homes

* Customers interested in premium sleep, home and hospitality products

* TikTok users shopping for high-quality home and bedroom products

* Content creators and affiliates operating within interiors, home, lifestyle and hospitality



Applicants must understand how B2B service marketing differs from consumer e-commerce marketing and be capable of developing appropriate strategies for both.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



MARKETING STRATEGY AND OWNERSHIP



* Take ownership of Turnkey’s marketing strategy and day-to-day implementation.

* Create and manage clear 30-, 60- and 90-day marketing plans.

* Proactively identify campaigns, content opportunities, partnerships and growth opportunities.

* Research our customers, competitors, locations and commercial search behaviour.

* Keep linen hire positioned as Turnkey’s lead and most scalable service.

* Support cleaning and consumables as complementary services within Greater Manchester.

* Develop a separate strategy for the potential hotel-quality home-linen consumer market.

* Work independently without requiring the business owner to continually provide ideas, copy or step-by-step direction.

* Present recommendations clearly and explain the commercial reasoning behind them.

* Communicate early if information, assets or decisions are needed or a deadline may be affected.



SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT AND CONTENT CREATION



* Develop original, platform-specific content for Instagram,
, LinkedIn and TikTok.

* Create professional posts, carousels, reels, short-form videos, stories, captions and campaigns.

* Produce complete content, including final copy, carousel slides, scripts, hooks, calls to action and creative direction.

* Plan the photographs, videos, customer proof and operational content required.

* Adapt content appropriately for each platform rather than repeatedly publishing the same material.

* Create content around cost savings, linen quality, reliability, guest experience, operational convenience, stock management, replacements and portfolio growth.

* Develop educational, commercial, behind-the-scenes, social-proof and lead-generating content.

* Maintain an organised content calendar with deadlines, asset requirements and approval stages.

* Ensure all facts, dates, prices, testimonials and operational claims are checked before publication.

* Monitor performance and use the results to improve future content.



TARGETED INSTAGRAM ENGAGEMENT AND RELATIONSHIP BUILDING



The Marketing Manager will be expected to do more than publish posts and wait for engagement.



Responsibilities will include:



* Identify and follow relevant property managers, short-let operators, serviced-accommodation businesses, Airbnb hosts, letting agents, developers and hospitality businesses.

* Engage consistently and genuinely with relevant accounts.

* Comment thoughtfully on posts, respond to stories and participate in appropriate industry conversations.

* Build familiarity and credibility with prospective customers before a direct sales approach.

* Monitor followed accounts for potential linen, cleaning, changeover or operational requirements.

* Identify new property launches, portfolio growth, supplier complaints, operational problems and other potential buying signals.

* Record relevant prospects and useful information in our lead tracker.

* Create a pipeline of warm prospects for the business to follow up.

* Recommend appropriate opportunities for an introduction, direct message, quotation or sales conversation.

* Respond promptly and professionally to comments and inbound messages.

* Avoid automated, generic, repetitive or spam-like engagement.



The purpose of this activity is to create genuine relationships and commercially useful opportunities—not artificial engagement figures.



TIKTOK ACCOUNT AND AUDIENCE DEVELOPMENT



The Marketing Manager will be responsible for establishing and developing Turnkey’s TikTok presence.



This will include:



* Set up and fully optimise the Turnkey TikTok business account.

* Develop a clear TikTok content strategy for both linen-hire awareness and the future consumer market.

* Research relevant TikTok trends, search behaviour, competitors, creators and product categories.

* Create platform-native short-form content rather than simply reposting static Instagram material.

* Produce videos demonstrating linen quality, fabric specifications, bed presentation, towel quality, packing, laundry processes and hotel-style results.

* Develop educational and aspirational content around creating a hotel-quality bedroom at home.

* Test different content hooks, styles, presenters, product demonstrations and calls to action.

* Build an engaged and commercially relevant audience.

* Monitor TikTok analytics, audience behaviour, enquiries and buying signals.

* Report clearly on whether the platform is demonstrating genuine potential for the consumer offer.



TIKTOK SHOP AND CONSUMER E-COMMERCE DEVELOPMENT



The successful candidate must have practical experience of TikTok Shop or demonstrable social-commerce experience.



When the products and operational arrangements are ready, responsibilities will include:



* Develop a launch plan for a Turnkey hotel-quality linen and towel shop.

* Support the setup and optimisation of TikTok Shop.

* Research the consumer market, competing products, pricing, customer expectations and opportunities.

* Help define the strongest initial products, bundles and offers.

* Create accurate, compelling and search-optimised product listings.

* Develop product descriptions, photographs, videos and demonstrations.

* Plan organic product-launch campaigns.

* Explore appropriate TikTok creator, affiliate and user-generated-content opportunities.

* Develop a process for approaching and managing suitable affiliates or creators.

* Ensure promotional claims, fabric specifications, thread counts, GSM information, pricing and delivery information are accurate.

* Monitor product views, clicks, basket additions, conversions, returns and customer feedback.

* Identify which products, content formats and offers produce the strongest commercial response.

* Recommend improvements based on sales and customer behaviour.



The TikTok Shop must not be treated as simply uploading products. We need someone who understands the relationship between platform-native content, audience trust, creators, product presentation and sales conversion.



LOCAL SEO AND WEBSITE OPTIMISATION



* Improve Turnkey’s visibility for high-intent searches relating to linen hire throughout North West England.

* Target relevant searches such as “linen hire Manchester,” “Airbnb linen hire North West,” “serviced accommodation linen hire,” “holiday-let linen hire” and location-specific commercial searches.

* Develop useful, genuinely local service and location content rather than thin or duplicated pages.

* Ensure it is clear that linen hire is available throughout the North West, while cleaning is currently limited to Greater Manchester.

* Review website titles, descriptions, headings, internal links and calls to action.

* Identify technical and content issues affecting indexing, visibility and conversions.

* Monitor performance through Google Search Console and Google Analytics.

* Work with a developer where technical implementation is required.

* Treat the website as a lead-generating asset rather than an endless web-development project without a commercial objective.



GOOGLE BUSINESS PROFILE AND LOCAL VISIBILITY



* Fully optimise and actively manage the Google Business Profile.

* Publish varied updates and genuine business photographs.

* Maintain accurate services, descriptions, locations and contact information.

* Develop an ethical process for requesting client reviews.

* Respond professionally to reviews and turn genuine feedback into approved marketing content.

* Monitor profile visibility, calls, messages, website visits and other customer actions.



CAMPAIGNS AND ENQUIRY GENERATION



* Develop campaigns designed to generate quote requests, portfolio discussions, samples and service trials.

* Create offers and lead magnets such as linen cost comparisons, portfolio pricing reviews and trial-pack campaigns.

* Support appropriate
-marketing and prospect-nurture activity.

* Recommend and manage Google Search, Meta or TikTok advertising when commercially justified.

* Create suitable landing pages, advertising copy and conversion routes.

* Ensure every campaign has a defined audience, objective, offer, call to action and measurement method.

* Produce qualified opportunities and effective collateral for the business’s follow-up and sales activity.



SOCIAL PROOF AND BRAND CREDIBILITY



* Develop a process for gathering genuine reviews, testimonials, photographs and client feedback.

* Turn verified customer experiences into professional case studies and marketing content.

* Obtain approval before publishing client names, quotations, screenshots, results or property information.

* Never invent, assume or exaggerate testimonials, customer results, operational claims or statistics.



REPORTING AND ACCOUNTABILITY



Provide a concise weekly report covering:



* Work completed

* Content created and published

* Relevant accounts followed and engaged with

* New prospective businesses identified

* Warm leads added to the prospect tracker

* Inbound enquiries and their sources

* Calls, quote requests and portfolio discussions generated

* Website traffic and conversion activity

* Search visibility and SEO progress

* Google Business Profile performance

* Reviews requested and received

* Social reach, engagement and audience growth

* TikTok audience development and content performance

* TikTok Shop progress and sales data once launched

* Paid campaign performance where applicable

* What performed well and why

* What did not perform well

* Priorities and recommendations for the following week



All reporting must connect activity to meaningful business outcomes.



ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



Applicants must demonstrate:



* At least three years of hands-on digital or social-media marketing experience.

* Proven experience marketing within the UK short-let, serviced-accommodation, property, hospitality or a closely related B2B service market.

* Evidence of campaigns that generated enquiries, appointments, quotations, trials or sales.

* Strong working knowledge of Instagram,
, LinkedIn and TikTok.

* Practical TikTok content-creation experience.

* TikTok Shop or relevant social-commerce experience.

* Experience using strategic social engagement to build relationships and identify prospects.

* The ability to personally create professional written and visual content.

* Strong understanding of UK local SEO and Google Business Profile management.

* Experience using Google Analytics and Google Search Console.

* Excellent written English, using accurate UK spelling and natural commercial language.

* Strong fact-checking and quality-control habits.

* The ability to interpret performance data and improve activity accordingly.

* Excellent organisation, communication and deadline management.

* The confidence to take ownership, make recommendations and act proactively.



DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE



* Direct experience within linen hire, commercial laundry or hospitality supplies.

* Knowledge of the North West short-let and property-management market.

* Experience marketing to multi-property operators.

* Experience launching or growing home, interiors, bedding or lifestyle products.

* TikTok creator or affiliate-management experience.

* Google Ads, Meta Ads or TikTok Ads experience.

*
-marketing and lead-nurture experience.

* Canva, photography or video-editing skills.

* Experience creating B2B case studies, cost comparisons and lead magnets.



RESPONSIBLE AI USE



We are comfortable with AI being used as a supporting tool.



However, generic AI-generated strategies, repeated template content and unchecked copy will not be accepted. The Marketing Manager remains personally responsible for ensuring every deliverable is original, accurate, fact-checked, commercially relevant and tailored to Turnkey Linen Hire.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



This role is not suitable for someone who:



* Is primarily a web developer rather than an experienced marketer.

* Only schedules generic social-media posts.

* Requires the business owner to provide all ideas, strategy and copy.

* Measures success only through reach, impressions or follower numbers.

* Recycles identical content to create the appearance of volume.

* Cannot demonstrate previous commercial marketing results.

* Provides vague reporting about completed work.

* Submits work without checking it thoroughly.

* Waits to be prompted before taking action.

* Cannot communicate early when a deadline may be missed.



WHAT SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE



Within the first 90 days, we expect to see:



* A clear, commercially focused marketing strategy in operation.

* Linen hire established as Turnkey’s lead offer throughout North West England.

* Cleaning promoted accurately within Greater Manchester.

* Improved visibility for relevant commercial searches.

* A fully optimised and actively managed Google Business Profile.

* Distinctive, varied and professional content across all platforms.

* Consistent engagement with relevant target accounts.

* A growing pipeline of warm, qualified prospects.

* More genuine reviews, testimonials and customer proof.

* A properly established TikTok account with a clear audience and content strategy.

* A commercially sound TikTok Shop development and launch plan.

* Clear tracking of every enquiry’s source.

* Measurable growth in qualified enquiries, quotation requests and portfolio conversations.

* Reliable weekly reporting and proactive recommendations.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A brief explanation of your relevant UK short-let, serviced-accommodation, property-management or hospitality experience.

2. Links to social-media accounts and campaigns you have personally managed.

3. Examples of content you personally created, including the strategy behind it.

4. A case study showing the objective, your individual contribution and measurable results.

5. Evidence such as anonymised analytics, enquiry numbers, campaign reports or ranking improvements.

6. An example of how you used social engagement to build a relationship or identify a commercial lead.

7. Evidence of your TikTok content and TikTok Shop or social-commerce experience.

8. Details of your local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Analytics and Search Console experience.

9. Your availability, expected rate and normal UK working hours.

10. Contact details for a relevant professional reference.



Please clearly identify which parts of each campaign you completed personally. Generic portfolios or work created predominantly by another team will not be sufficient.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to discuss a previous campaign in detail and complete a small paid Turnkey-specific marketing exercise. This will assess market knowledge, strategic thinking, content quality, TikTok capability, local SEO understanding, commercial awareness and attention to detail.

title: Marketing Technology & Web Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are a growing US-based healthcare organization looking for a hands-on Marketing Technology & Web Specialist to join our team full-time.



This person will be the primary technical resource for our marketing team. You will report directly to the CMO and be responsible for implementing and maintaining the technology behind our websites, landing pages, forms, tracking, attribution, and marketing integrations.



This is a hands-on role. We need someone who can take a request and actually implement it, whether that means modifying a Webflow form, building a landing page, fixing a tracking pixel, connecting a new marketing platform, configuring a subdomain, or troubleshooting why attribution data is missing.



You will also work directly with our vendors and other specialists when systems connect. For example, you may work with our call-tracking provider’s engineers to complete an integration, meet with our paid media team to troubleshoot conversion tracking, or work with our CRM & Automation Specialist to make sure lead data is passing correctly into our internal systems.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Websites, Forms & Landing Pages



* Maintain and update our Webflow website

* Build and modify pages, forms, fields, dropdowns, and other website elements

* Build, duplicate, and modify landing pages in Unbounce

* Implement technical and layout changes for conversion-rate tests

* Ensure pages and forms work properly across desktop and mobile

* Maintain existing designs and styling provided by our creative team

* Monitor and improve page performance and load speed

* Troubleshoot website and form issues



Marketing Tracking & Attribution



* Configure, test, and maintain Google Ads conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, GA4, and other marketing tracking

* Manage our Google Tag Manager environment

* Audit and troubleshoot tags, triggers, variables, data layers, and tracking scripts

* Identify duplicate, conflicting, or broken tracking

* Verify that forms, phone calls, and other conversions are attributed to the correct sources and campaigns

* Troubleshoot discrepancies between advertising platforms and actual leads

* Make sure new pages, forms, and campaigns launch with the appropriate tracking in place



Call Tracking & Marketing Integrations



* Maintain the technical side of our WhatConverts call-tracking and attribution setup

* Manage Dynamic Number Insertion (DNI) and related tracking

* Connect and configure new marketing tools and integrations

* Work directly with software vendors and their technical teams when needed

* Implement required changes on our side of integrations

* Test integrations to verify that data is flowing correctly in both directions

* Troubleshoot UTMs, GCLIDs, lead IDs, webhooks, forms, and other attribution data



Experience with WhatConverts specifically is not required if you have experience with similar platforms such as CallRail and can learn new systems quickly.



Working With Our Other Specialists



You will work closely with our paid media team, creative agency, software vendors, and CRM & Automation Specialist.



We have a separate CRM & Automation Specialist responsible for ClickUp, Make, Zapier, lead routing, internal workflows, and backend automations. You will not be responsible for taking over that role.



Where the systems connect, you will work together. For example, if a Webflow form captures a UTM parameter but it does not appear correctly in our CRM, you may troubleshoot the website and tracking side while the CRM & Automation Specialist checks the backend automation and field mapping.



Similarly, our paid media partners manage Google Ads and Meta campaigns. You will not manage the campaigns themselves, but you will work with them to make sure the technical tracking supporting those campaigns is implemented and working correctly.



Our creative partners handle primary branding and graphic design. You should be able to implement and modify existing designs, but you do not need to be a graphic designer.



Must-Have Skills



* Webflow: Strong hands-on experience with Webflow, including forms, CMS, responsive layouts, styling, and modifying existing websites

* Google Tag Manager: Strong experience with tags, triggers, variables, custom events, data layers, Preview Mode, and debugging

* Conversion Tracking: Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting Google Ads, Meta Pixel, and GA4 tracking

* Technical Troubleshooting: Ability to investigate technical problems, identify the root cause, implement a solution, and verify that it works

* Marketing Integrations: Comfortable working with forms, webhooks, attribution data, tracking scripts, and connections between marketing platforms

* English Communication: Strong written and spoken English. You must be comfortable speaking directly with the CMO, vendors, developers, and other technical specialists



Strongly Preferred



* Unbounce

* JavaScript, HTML, and CSS

* Chrome DevTools or similar browser debugging tools

* Cloudflare and DNS management

* WhatConverts, CallRail, or other DNI/call-tracking platforms

* Experience with UTMs, GCLIDs, and marketing attribution

* API and webhook integrations

* Experience troubleshooting website-to-CRM data flows



What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who is hands-on, technically curious, and takes ownership.



If the CMO asks you to modify a form, you should be able to make the change. If a tracking pixel is not working, you should be able to investigate it. If a new platform needs to be integrated, you should be able to implement the technical work on our side and work directly with the platform’s engineers when necessary.



You are not replacing our paid media team, CRM & Automation Specialist, or creative agency. You are the technical person on the marketing team who makes sure the technology they depend on works correctly.



How to Apply



Please include a brief 5–8 sentence answer to the following scenario in your application:



Imagine you are auditing our Google Ads tracking and suspect that our lead conversion tag is double-counting conversions, causing Google Ads to report more leads than we are actually receiving. Describe the exact step-by-step process you would use to determine whether duplicate conversions are actually firing on the website, what you would examine to identify the root cause, and how you would verify that the issue has been resolved.



Applications that do not answer the screening scenario will not be considered.

title: Systems & Automation Project Manager
description:
# Systems, Automation & AI Project Manager



**Full-Time | Remote | $6 USD/hour**



We are a growing CPA and financial consulting firm looking for a highly analytical and technically capable **Systems, Automation & AI Project Manager** to help build the operating infrastructure of our organization.



This is **not a traditional project manager, virtual assistant, or basic automation role.**



We are looking for someone who can understand how an entire business operates, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and turn those problems into **systems, automations, integrations, SOPs, dashboards, and clearly defined workflows.**



You will work hands-on with leadership and every member of the organization.



Your responsibility is simple:



**Understand how work moves through the company and continuously find ways to organize it, automate it, document it, and improve it.**



## What You’ll Own



You will help design, implement, document, test, and continuously improve systems across the entire client lifecycle, including:



• Lead generation and lead capture

• CRM architecture and pipeline management

• Automated lead follow-up sequences

• Sales workflows and sales handoffs

• Appointment scheduling

• Proposal generation

• Engagement letter workflows

• Payment and billing workflows

• New-client onboarding

• Client document collection

• Internal task creation and assignment

• Tax and accounting fulfillment workflows

• Recurring client-service workflows

• Client communication and follow-up

• Project and deadline management

• Internal dashboards and reporting

• SOP creation and documentation

• AI-assisted workflows

• Cross-platform integrations

• Quality-control processes

• Client renewals and offboarding



You will not simply manage existing processes.



**You will be expected to build better ones.**



## Technical & Automation Experience Is Required



This is a highly technical operations position.



You must understand how modern SaaS applications communicate with each other and be capable of building workflows across multiple platforms.



### You Must Understand



• **Zapier**, including multi-step Zaps, filters, paths, triggers, actions, and troubleshooting

• **APIs and API keys**

• REST APIs and basic API concepts

• Webhooks

• GET, POST, PUT/PATCH requests

• JSON and structured data

• Authentication and securely managing API credentials

• Data mapping between applications

• Conditional logic

• Error handling and workflow troubleshooting

• Testing automations before deployment

• AI prompts and structured AI outputs

• Building workflows that incorporate AI

• Connecting applications that do not have simple native integrations



You do not necessarily need to be a software engineer.



However, if we tell you:



> “When X happens in System A, we need to pull this information, send it through AI, determine what type of client it is, update System B, create a project in System C, assign the appropriate team member, and trigger a follow-up sequence.”



You should understand **how to figure out how to build it.**



## AI Experience Is Mandatory



We want someone who actively uses AI as an operational tool.



Experience should include:



• **Claude**

• ChatGPT

• AI-assisted workflow creation

• Prompt engineering

• Structured AI outputs

• AI agents

• Using AI for SOP creation and documentation

• Using AI to analyze or transform business data

• Incorporating AI into automated workflows

• Understanding when AI should and should not replace deterministic automation



Simply knowing how to ask ChatGPT questions is **not sufficient.**



We want someone who understands how to make AI part of a repeatable business process.



## Software Experience



### Required or Strongly Preferred



• **Zapier**

• **Claude**

• **ChatGPT / OpenAI tools**

• **GoHighLevel**

• **Viktor AI**

• **Google Sheets**

• **Google Workspace**

• Gmail

• Google Drive

• Google Docs

• Google Forms



### Additional Experience Is a Major Plus



• **
**

• **n8n**

• Airtable

• ClickUp

• Asana

• 

• Slack

• Calendly

• HubSpot

• QuickBooks Online

• TaxDome or similar accounting practice-management software

• DocuSign / e-signature platforms

• Stripe or other payment platforms

• Twilio / SMS automation

• Looker Studio or similar dashboard tools

• Postman or similar API testing tools



We do not expect you to have used every platform listed above.



We **do expect you to understand technology well enough to learn new platforms quickly and figure out how to connect them.**



## What This Looks Like in Practice



### Lead Management



A new lead enters through a website, advertisement, referral, or form.



You design a system that can:



**Lead Captured → CRM Created → Lead Categorized → Salesperson Assigned → Automated Follow-Up → Appointment Scheduled → Pipeline Updated → Management Visibility**



### New Client Onboarding



A prospect becomes a client.



Instead of the team manually coordinating everything, you build:



**Engagement Letter Signed → Payment → Client Record Created → Onboarding
 → Document Request → Internal Project → Tasks Assigned → Deadlines Created → Team Notified**



### AI Automation



Information comes into the organization that requires classification or analysis.



You may create:



**Form Submission → API/Webhook → AI Analysis → Structured Output → CRM Update → Appropriate Workflow Triggered**



### Internal Operations



A team member performs the same repetitive process every week.



You sit with them, understand exactly what they are doing, map the process, and determine whether it should be:



**Automated → Standardized → Delegated → Improved → Eliminated**



## SOP & Process Development



One of your most important responsibilities will be getting processes **out of people's heads and into documented systems.**



You will work directly with employees to understand:



What do you do?



Why do you do it?

title: Virtual Business Analyst
description:
Virtual Business Analyst



Pure Dental Spa & Chicago Dental Specialists



Pure Dental Spa and Chicago Dental Specialists are growing — and growth creates opportunity.



We are a fast-paced, systems-driven dental organization focused on building something bigger than just dental offices. We create opportunities for people, develop leaders, and are committed to delivering the most comfortable dental experience possible.



As our organization continues to expand, we are looking for a highly capable, detail-oriented, and analytical **Virtual Business Analyst based in the Philippines** to support our leadership team across multiple dental offices.



This is not a basic data-entry role. This role is for someone who loves numbers, understands how businesses operate, catches discrepancies, and turns information into clear, actionable insights that help leadership make better decisions.



What You’ll Do:

* Identify discrepancies and coordinate with the appropriate team members to resolve them.

* Track deadlines, action items, and accountability across departments.

* Assist with SOPs, checklists, workflows, and process improvements.

* Organize information and help ensure leadership has accurate data when needed.

* Research business solutions and assist with special projects.



Who You Are:

* Highly analytical and exceptionally detail-oriented.

* Strong with spreadsheets, formulas, and organizing large amounts of data.

* Comfortable working with numbers and identifying errors.

* Able to handle confidential payroll and business information with professionalism.

* Proactive, resourceful, and able to work independently.

* Strong written and verbal English communication.

* Organized and comfortable managing multiple deadlines.

* Able to explain data clearly to non-technical team members.

* Tech-savvy and quick to learn new systems.

* Experience with Google Workspace, task management tools, and AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.

Work Schedule:

Remote — Philippines



Must be available to overlap with **U.S. Central Time business hours**.



Compensation:

Competitive and based on experience.



Why Join Us:

At Pure Dental Spa, businesses don’t grow — people do.



This is an opportunity to become a key part of a growing organization where your work directly supports business decisions, operational improvement, and leadership success. If you enjoy working with numbers, building systems, and helping a business operate at a higher level, we want to meet you.



To Apply:

Please send your resume and a short video introduction (2–3 minutes) telling us about your experience with payroll, business reporting, and supporting leadership teams. We’d also love to hear about a time you identified a discrepancy or used data to improve a process.



**If you love numbers, systems, and helping leaders make better decisions — apply now.**

title: Lead SEO Strategist — Nationwide US Lead-Gen Website (Site Architecture, Page Specs, Programmatic SEO)
description:
Salary: $[1,000–2,500]/month depending on experience, paid twice monthly. 90-day trial, then permanent.





About the project

We are building a nationwide US auto transport (car shipping) lead-generation website from scratch on a custom Next.js stack. Competitors: Montway, Sherpa, AmeriFreight, uShip, A-1 Auto Transport, RoadRunner. The site will rank across all 50 states through service pages, cost pages, state/city pages, and thousands of programmatic route pages.



You are the SEO brain of the project. A Project Manager handles scheduling, tracking, and hiring logistics. You d
 what gets built and why.



What you'll do



Phase 1 — Before design starts (first 30 days)



Full keyword research and competitor teardown: what the top sites rank for, their page types, URL patterns, and content depth

Define the complete site architecture: every page type, URL structure, internal linking, sitemaps

Write a page-by-page section spec for the designer: for each template (home, quote flow, service, cost, state, city, route, guide) list the sections in order, what each section must contain, which sections are required for ranking and conversion, and which to leave out

Review every design draft and approve or send back with specific changes — you own "does this page have what it needs to rank?"



Phase 2 — Build



Write the technical SEO spec for the developer: metadata rules, schema types per template, canonical logic, sitemap structure, Core Web Vitals targets, crawl/index controls for programmatic pages

Define the route dataset: which data fields each route/city/state page needs so pages are unique and rankable, not thin

QA the staging site before launch: crawl it, check rendering, indexability, speed, and internal links



Phase 3 — Growth (ongoing)



Content plan and briefs for writers; quality review of every published page

Link building and digital PR strategy; brief and manage the link builder

Monthly ranking, indexing, and traffic analysis with clear next actions

Continuous optimization of top pages and the quote flow



Requirements



5+ years in SEO with at least one site you ranked nationally in a competitive niche (proof required: Search Console screenshots or a reference)

Programmatic SEO experience: you have built or specified location/route/service-area page systems at 1,000+ pages and can explain how you kept them from being thin

You have written page section specs or wireframes for designers before, and technical SEO specs for developers on custom-coded sites (Next.js/React or similar)

Expert with Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, Screaming Frog

Strong written English; you communicate in clear documents, not long calls

Available 40 hours/week with at least 4 hours overlapping US Eastern time

Delegated access only; the company owns all accounts



Nice to have



Auto transport, moving, logistics, or home-services SEO experience

Digital PR / data-study link building

Conversion rate optimization for lead forms



How we work



You set the strategy; the PM tracks it; specialists execute. Weekly written update, monthly review with the owner. Long-term role for someone who wants to build and own a national site.



How to apply



Your application must include:



One site you ranked nationally: niche, main keywords, proof you can share

One programmatic page system you built or specified: how many pages, what data made them unique, how they performed

A short sample (5–10 lines) of a section spec for a "Ship a car from [City] to [City]" route page: list the sections in order and say which two you'd cut if the designer wanted a shorter page

Your monthly salary expectation and available start date

Start your application with the word ROUTE

title: Fitness Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator
description:
Here’s a ready-to-post version focused on content production. I’ve kept the full-time schedule and Pacific Time overlap from your original listing.



JOB TITLE: Fitness Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator — Reels, 4K Video & RAW Photo Editing



JOB OVERVIEW



Bellcore Fitness is a premium fitness studio in Santa Clara, California, built around expert personal training and complemented by boxing, yoga, strength training, and calisthenics.



We are looking for a skilled creative professional who can turn our training footage and photography into polished, engaging social media content.



You should understand fitness content, have strong editing skills, and know how to create reels that capture attention while maintaining a consistent brand identity. You must have your own computer capable of reliably editing 4K footage and processing RAW photos.



We provide footage, photos, brand guidelines, and creative priorities. You bring ideas, sound judgment, and the ability to take content from raw files to finished assets.



POSITION DETAILS



- Full-time, remote: 40 hours per week.

- Minimum working overlap: 9:00 AM–2:00 PM Pacific Time, including US daylight saving changes.

- Compensation: Competitive monthly rate based on experience and portfolio. Include your expected monthly salary in USD.

- We are looking for someone interested in a long-term role.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



1. FITNESS REELS & VIDEO EDITING



- Create Instagram Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts from footage we provide.

- Review raw footage and select the strongest moments to tell a clear story.

- Edit personal training sessions, exercise demonstrations, coach tips, client stories, and studio content.

- Build strong opening hooks, purposeful pacing, accurate subtitles, and clear calls to action.

- Handle color correction, color grading, audio cleanup, music selection, and sound design.

- Work confidently with 4K source footage, using proxies when appropriate and exporting clean final files.

- Adapt content for different platforms, aspect ratios, and placements.

- Use music and other assets with appropriate rights for the intended use.

- Suggest content ideas and filming guidance to help our team capture better footage.



2. RAW PHOTO EDITING



- Edit original camera RAW files using Lightroom, Photoshop, Camera Raw, or equivalent professional software.

- Correct exposure, white balance, color, contrast, cropping, and composition.

- Match photos across different shoots for a consistent brand appearance.

- Retouch distractions while preserving natural skin tones and realistic physiques.

- Prepare images for social media, our website, and marketing campaigns.

- Organize original files, editable versions, and final exports.



3. BRAND CONSISTENCY & SOCIAL CONTENT



- Follow the Bellcore Fitness brand guidelines across every deliverable.

- Create reel covers, thumbnails, carousels, and supporting graphics.

- Apply our fonts, colors, logo, and visual style consistently.

- Write clear captions in our confident, expert, refined, and direct voice.

- Maintain a content calendar and prepare approved content for scheduling and publishing.

- Review content performance and use the results to improve future edits.



OUR CREATIVE STANDARD



Our content should feel polished, athletic, and intentional. Strong storytelling, clean typography, natural photo editing, and thoughtful pacing matter.



You should be comfortable adapting trends to a premium fitness brand and making creative choices that support the message.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



- A portfolio demonstrating strong short-form video editing and photo editing.

- Experience creating content for fitness, personal training, sports, or wellness brands.

- Proficiency in a professional video editor such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro.

- Proficiency in Lightroom, Photoshop, Camera Raw, or equivalent software for RAW photo editing.

- Practical experience working with 4K footage, color correction, audio, captions, and export settings.

- Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing, and viewer retention.

- Ability to follow a brand guide and maintain consistency across video, photography, and graphics.

- Strong written English and accurate caption proofreading.

title: Video Editor for Direct Response Ads
description:
We are looking for a fast, reliable video editor to join our team and help us produce direct-response video ads at a consistent volume.



This is a pure video editing and execution role.



Speed Is Extremely Important



Speed is everything in this role.



We have intentionally removed almost every time-consuming task from the editor's plate so that you can focus entirely on editing.



You will NOT need to:



Find or source footage

Search through folders for the right clips

D
 which clips should be used

Generate AI videos or images

Write scripts

Come up with creative concepts

Do creative research

Figure out the structure of the video



We will provide everything to you in an organized format.



You will receive the footage, assets, voiceovers, scripts, and clear instructions showing exactly what footage/frame goes where.



There should be very little time wasted figuring things out.



Your primary responsibility is to take everything we provide, put it together properly according to our SOPs, and deliver the finished video quickly and accurately.



We want editors spending their time editing, not searching, organizing, researching, or figuring out what to do.



What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:



Putting provided footage together in the correct sequence

Syncing footage with voiceovers

Adding subtitles/captions

Adding text overlays

Adding transitions where appropriate

Adding basic motion graphics when required

Adding sound effects and music where required

Adjusting pacing and cuts to keep the video engaging

Following our existing editing style and SOPs

Making revisions when required

Exporting and delivering finished videos in the required formats



We will provide clear instructions for each video, including what footage goes where.



You do not need to figure out the creative direction yourself.



What We're Looking For



We want someone who:



Edits quickly without sacrificing quality

Is highly efficient with their editing workflow

Has strong attention to detail

Can follow instructions exactly

Understands pacing for short-form/direct-response video ads

Can create clean, readable subtitles

Knows how to make cuts and transitions feel natural

Can consistently follow an established editing style

Can handle a consistent volume of videos

Does not unnecessarily overcomplicate simple edits

Communicates clearly

Meets deadlines consistently

Can take an SOP and execute without needing constant supervision



Experience editing
, Instagram, TikTok, UGC, or direct-response ads is a big plus.



You can use Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut Desktop, or another professional editing workflow as long as you can produce the required quality quickly.



Our Philosophy



We don't want an editor wasting 30 minutes looking for the right clip, another 20 minutes figuring out the script, and another hour trying to understand the creative direction.



We handle all of that.



Our team will take care of the preparation and creative decisions so that when the work reaches you, your job is straightforward:



Open the project → follow the instructions → edit → polish → export → move to the next video.



The more efficiently we can move through videos while maintaining our quality standards, the better.



Because of this, turnaround time and output will be important parts of how we evaluate performance in this role.



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself

Your video editing experience

Examples of short-form ads or similar videos you've edited

What editing software you use

Your current availability

Your expected monthly salary/rate

Approximately how many short-form videos you believe you could edit in a normal 8-hour working day if all footage, scripts, and instructions were already prepared for you

We're looking for someone we can work with long-term who is fast, dependable, easy to work with, and consistently delivers good work.

title: Full-Stack Next.js Developer — Build a Nationwide US Car Shipping Website (Project → Permanent Role)
description:
Pay: $[2,000–8,000] fixed for the build, paid in four milestones. After launch: permanent role at $[800–2,000]/month depending on hours. We want one developer who owns this site for years, not a contractor who disappears after delivery.



About the project



We are launching a nationwide US auto transport (car shipping) lead-generation website. It is not a brochure site. It is a programmatic SEO site that will grow to thousands of pages: 50 state pages, hundreds of city pages, and thousands of route pages ("Ship a car from Los Angeles to Dallas"), all generated from a database, plus service pages, cost pages with a calculator, guides, and a multi-step quote form that sends leads to our CRM.



You will receive: a complete Figma design with a component library, a written technical SEO spec, and a route dataset. You build it exactly, fast, and clean.



What you will build



Core



Next.js (App Router, TypeScript) with static generation for all location and route pages and ISR so pricing updates regenerate pages without a full rebuild

PostgreSQL database for cities, routes, distances, transit times, price bands, FAQs

Headless CMS (Sanity, Payload, or Strapi) so writers can edit service pages and guides without touching code

Page templates from Figma: home, quote flow, service, cost + calculator, state, city, route, guide, legal, 404, thank-you

Multi-step quote form with server-side validation, spam protection, and delivery to our CRM via API/webhook

Cost calculator and transit-time estimator using the route data



SEO (from our spec — you implement, our SEO lead verifies)



Per-page metadata, Open Graph, JSON-LD schema per template

Sitemap index split by page type, canonical rules, robots controls for programmatic pages

Breadcrumbs, internal linking blocks (related routes/cities), pagination

Core Web Vitals green on mobile: image optimization, font loading, no layout shift



Infrastructure



Hosting on Vercel or DigitalOcean behind Cloudflare (we'll d
 with you)

Staging + production environments, GitHub repo under our account, versioned deploys

Error monitoring, uptime alerts, automated backups

Documentation: setup, deploy, how to add a page type, how to update data



Milestones



Setup + database + CMS + core components (week 1–2)

Home, quote flow, service, and cost pages live on staging (week 3–4)

State, city, route templates generating from data; guides; sitemaps and schema (week 5–6)

QA fixes, performance pass, SEO verification, launch, documentation (week 7–8)



After launch (permanent role)

New tools (carrier lookup, tracking pages), new page types, CRM and analytics integrations, performance tuning, monthly maintenance. If you are good, this becomes your long-term site.



Requirements



4+ years full-stack; 2+ years production Next.js with App Router

At least one site you built with 1,000+ programmatically generated pages from a database — we will ask to see it and how it performs in Google

PostgreSQL, Prisma or Drizzle, TypeScript

Headless CMS integration experience

You understand technical SEO well enough to implement a spec correctly: schema, sitemaps, canonicals, rendering, Core Web Vitals

Pixel-accurate Figma-to-code, mobile first

Git workflow, staging/production discipline, clear commit history

Good written English; you ask questions early and give short daily updates

Delegated access only; repo, hosting, and domains stay under our accounts



Nice to have



Lead-gen or marketing sites with high-traffic forms

Vercel + Cloudflare setup experience

Google Maps/Distance Matrix or similar APIs

Playwright or Cypress testing



How we work



Figma + spec on day one. Daily short update in the tracker, weekly demo on staging. Our PM tracks tasks; our SEO lead reviews SEO; our QA tester checks releases. Code reviews are light but real. Milestone payments, on time, every time.



How to apply



Your application must include:



Link to one live Next.js site you built with 1,000+ generated pages — say what it generates from and how many pages Google has indexed

Link to your GitHub (or a private repo you can share) showing recent Next.js work

In 5–8 sentences: how you would structure the route pages so 10,000 of them stay fast, indexable, and unique

Your fixed price for the build, your monthly rate for the permanent role, and your start date

title: Medical-Legal Virtual Receptionist (REMOTE)
description:
Medical-Legal Virtual Receptionist (REMOTE)



Graduates or students from top universities in the Philippines are HIGHLY encouraged to apply (UP, Ateneo, DLSU, UST, etc.), or experienced Medical VAs.



Pay Rate: $6.00/ hour



Shift: US Pacific Time (PST) — Operating on scheduled California Medical Evaluation days (Weekdays & Occasional Saturdays as needed).



About the Role

We are seeking a highly articulate, organized, and confident Virtual Receptionist to act as a vital remote assistant to our California Doctors on Qualified Medical Evaluator (QME) evaluation days.



In this role, you will be the real-time operational bridge between applicants (patients), doctors, and our core management team. You will handle live day-of communications, track applicant attendance and evaluation status, flag no-shows immediately, and ensure our AI scribing software is actively running, verified for accuracy, and properly filed for every case.



Key Responsibilities

1. Applicant Attendance & Status Tracking:

- Track applicant (patient) check-in times, evaluation progress, and check-out status in real-time across all scheduled appointments.

- Immediately flag and report no-shows, late arrivals, or cancellations to the doctor and admin team according to protocol.

- Maintain accurate live logs of evaluation day activity and patient status updates.



2. Live Evaluation Day Coordination:

- Serve as the doctor’s right-hand assistant on evaluation days—managing patient intake workflows, doctor alerts, and schedule flow.



3. Patient & Doctor Communications:

- Handle professional, friendly, and clear communications with California applicants, law firm representatives, and evaluating physicians via phone, chat, or video call.



4. AI Scribing Management & Filing:

- Ensure AI scribing software is properly initiated and active during doctor-applicant evaluations.

- Verify audio capture clarity and review AI-generated notes for accuracy.

- Make minor formatting adjustments as needed and ensure final transcripts and reports are properly uploaded and filed in our system.



5. Team Collaboration:

- Maintain real-time sync with our US-based ops team to flag missing legal paperwork, schedule adjustments, or immediate doctor requests.



Candidate Requirements (IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ)

1. Native / Near-Native American Accent: Exceptional spoken English skills with a clear, natural American accent (Mandatory & Non-Negotiable).

2. Confidence & Poise: Outstanding communication skills with the ability to maintain composure and authority when interacting with US doctors, law firms, and applicants.

3. Meticulous Organization: Strong multitasker who can track real-time attendance, monitor AI tools, and keep patient records organized under fast-paced conditions.

4. Educational Background: Graduates or students from top Philippine universities (UP, Ateneo, DLSU, UST, etc.) or applicants with strong healthcare/medical VA backgrounds are preferred.



Technical Setup:

1. High-speed, reliable fiber internet.

2. Professional noise-canceling headset (USB with active noise cancellation).

3. Dual-monitor setup preferred* (for simultaneous patient tracking and system management).

4. Backup power source (UPS/generator) and backup internet connection.



How to Apply (IMPORTANT: READ CAREFULLY)

To be considered for this position, you must submit a GOOGLE DRIVE LINK to the following:

1. Updated Resume (PDF format).

2. Short Video Introduction (1–2 minutes max) via Loom or Google Drive link covering:

- A brief introduction about yourself and your educational background.

- Why you are a perfect fit for a fast-paced, real-time Virtual Assistant role supporting US doctors and tracking patient clinic flows.

3. Diploma/TOR.



Note: Please ensure your video is recorded in a quiet environment with your camera turned on.



STRICT APPLICATION NOTICE:



Applications that do not meet all requirements, fail to include a video, or submit a generic/reused video will be automatically disqualified without review. Clear, authentic American English pronunciation is strictly required.

title: Business Operations Coordinator
description:
Business Operations Coordinator



We are a US-based e-commerce furniture and home décor business that is seeking an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Business Operations Coordinator to support our day-to-day operations. This is a hands-on, varied role that touches logistics, inventory and product management, customer service, and marketing support.



The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, comfortable working with data and technology, and able to manage multiple priorities independently. This position is well suited for someone who enjoys problem-solving, keeping things organized, and seeing tasks through from start to finish.



Key Responsibilities



Logistics & Order Management



Work with vendors to track orders and production timelines.

Obtain shipping and freight quotes and help select the appropriate carrier.

Coordinate and schedule shipments with carriers and delivery partners.

Track shipments through delivery and troubleshoot delays or issues.

Keep customers informed about production timelines, shipping status, and delivery.



Inventory & Product Management

Complete weekly inventory updates and data uploads.

Update product pricing as needed.

Remove or disable discontinued products.

Review product and inventory data for accuracy and identify discrepancies.



Customer Service



Respond to customer inquiries by phone and
 regarding product availability, order status, shipping, and general product questions.

Coordinate non-furniture returns with customers and vendors.

Follow up with customers who have requested product samples.

Respond to trade and designer inquiries and provide appropriate follow-up.

Provide friendly, professional, and timely communication throughout the customer experience.



Marketing Support



Create, schedule, and publish social media posts for
, Instagram, and Pinterest.

Assist with basic marketing content, promotions, and other marketing initiatives as needed.



Required Skills

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, including sorting, filtering, basic formulas, and working with spreadsheets and CSV files.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Strong general computer skills and ability to learn new software and systems quickly.

Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and customer conversations simultaneously.

Comfortable working independently, taking initiative, and following through on tasks.

Willingness to track and log daily hours worked accurately using time-tracking tools (e.g., Time Doctor, Hubstaff) as well as a shared Google Sheet, as required by the employer.

High level of integrity and accountability — this role is remote and largely unsupervised, so honest time reporting and reliable, focused work during logged hours is essential.



Preferred Skills

Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve productivity, communication, research, and day-to-day workflows.

Experience with an e-commerce platform such as BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, or similar.

Experience using Canva to create or edit basic marketing and social media content.

Comfortable following up with customers by phone, not just

Compensation

Hours

You should be comfortable moving between different types of work—from following up with a vendor about an order, to updating a spreadsheet, to answering a customer's question, to preparing a social media post.

This is a broad role with the opportunity to learn many aspects of running and growing an e-commerce business.

title: Video Editor for Italian E-commerce Ads | Italian Brand Experience Required
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Video Editor with proven experience in e-commerce advertising and paid social creatives.



IMPORTANT: We are only looking for candidates who have already worked with Italian brands and have previously created video ads in Italian.



Since our brand operates in the Italian market, all creatives must be produced in Italian, including voiceovers, on-screen text, captions, and subtitles. For this reason, previous experience creating ads specifically for Italian brands and Italian audiences is mandatory.



This role is for someone who knows how to turn raw footage, UGC content, voiceovers, product shots, B-roll, and AI-generated assets into professional, engaging, conversion-focused video ads.



We are not looking for a basic editor. We need someone who understands performance advertising and knows how to create videos that capture attention, maintain retention, and are structured to drive conversions across Meta,
, Instagram, and TikTok.



You will be responsible for creating:



UGC-style ads

Voiceover + B-roll videos

Product-focused ads

Direct response creatives

AI-generated and AI-animated ads

VSL / advertorial-style creatives

Hook, angle, and CTA variations

Creative iterations for testing



A strong understanding of e-commerce, DTC brands, paid advertising, buyer psychology, hooks, retention, pain points, social proof, and CTAs is essential.



We will provide scripts, product information, creative briefs, competitor references, and available footage. However, we are looking for someone who can also bring creative ideas and independently select B-roll, visuals, music, sound effects, subtitles, and AI assets when needed.



This is intended to be a long-term collaboration.



When applying, please include:



Your portfolio

Examples of e-commerce ads you have edited

Examples of videos created in Italian

Examples of previous work with Italian brands

Any experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, UGC, AI video, and direct response advertising



Applications without previous experience with Italian brands and Italian-language video ads will not be considered.
